title: M&As and Innovation: A New Approach to Classifying Technology
affiliations: German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin) and University College Dublin (UCD)

detail.title: M&As and Innovation: A New Approach to Classifying Technology

declarations.funderStatement: We acknowledge funding from the European Union’s Joint Research Council Project JRC/SVQ/2023/VLVP/3027. Skatteforsk’s Working Paper Series is financed through support from The Research Council of Norway (Grant number 341289).

publicationDetails.journalName: Skatteforsk Centre for Tax Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: A large literature considers the interplay between mergers and acquisitions (M&A) by multinationals and innovation, typically measured as patents. One theme that emerges is that technological similarity plays a role in which M&As occur. The challenge then becomes how to measure technological similarity. Typically, this is done by using either firms' sectors or the technological classifications of their patents. The first is a coarse measure of business activity and overlooks supply chains. The second may incorrectly match technical features with no overlapping business relation. In contrast, we offer an alternative based on a machine learning approach using patent technology descriptors. This decants over 600 technological codes into 21 technical business areas (TBAs). Similarity in this more parsimonious measure is highly related to the probability of a given M&A occurring. This provides a more intuitive approach to understanding the literature's findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的方法，使用专利技术描述符来衡量企业间的技术相似性，将600多个技术代码浓缩为21个技术业务领域，为理解并购与创新关系提供了更直观的方法。
AI.research_question: 如何更准确地衡量企业间的技术相似性以理解并购行为？
AI.motivation: 现有技术相似性测量方法存在局限：行业分类过于粗略且忽视供应链关系，专利分类可能错误匹配技术特征而无实际业务重叠。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨国企业并购与创新的关系理论，技术相似性在并购决策中的作用。
AI.method: 基于机器学习的专利技术描述符分析方法，将600多个技术代码浓缩为21个技术业务领域。
AI.findings: 基于这种更简洁的测量方法，技术相似性与特定并购发生的概率高度相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了更准确的技术相似性测量框架，改进了并购与创新关系的研究方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业并购决策提供了更直观的技术相似性评估工具，有助于理解并购模式。

detail.abstract: The use of leaked data is becoming increasingly common in empirical research, particularly in public finance. Although these data can be an enormously powerful tool for investigating behavior that is otherwise difficult to measure, their use also generates substantial ethical and legal risks. In this paper, we (i) present the growing body of social science research that relies on leaked data, (ii) discuss the ethical, legal and privacy hurdles faced by projects relying on such data and (iii) offer a practical roadmap for researchers looking to enter the space.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了泄露数据在社会科学研究中的使用，分析了其伦理、法律和隐私风险，并为研究者提供了实用指南。
AI.research_question: 如何在社会科学研究中负责任地使用泄露数据？

publicationDetails.journalName: Skatteforsk Centre for Tax Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Cryptocurrencies pose substantial challenges to tax enforcement due to their anonymous and decentralized properties, undermining conventional regulatory practices. We study the impact of an ambitious new enforcement initiative aimed at addressing these challenges: domestic third-party reporting of crypto income. We estimate tax compliance and behavioral responses to this new policy by combining unique Danish microdata from domestic crypto platforms, administrative tax records, and cross-border bank transfers. Despite the introduction of domestic third-party reporting, over 90% of crypto investors do not declare crypto income. Moreover, we identify a significant and persistent evasion response to the policy as investors shift trading activity from domestic platforms, subject to third-party reporting, to foreign platforms outside regulatory reach. Our findings underscore the limits of domestic enforcement strategies in addressing tax evasion for decentralized, borderless assets like cryptocurrencies, highlighting the need for international coordination.

AI.tldr: 尽管丹麦实施了国内第三方报告政策，但超过90%的加密货币投资者仍不申报加密收入，且投资者将交易活动从受监管的国内平台转移到不受监管的国外平台，凸显了国内执法策略在应对加密货币逃税方面的局限性。
AI.research_question: 国内第三方报告政策对加密货币税收合规和投资者行为有何影响？
AI.motivation: 加密货币的匿名性和去中心化特性对传统税收执法构成重大挑战，需要研究新的执法措施的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收合规理论、监管规避行为理论、第三方报告机制有效性理论
AI.method: 结合丹麦国内加密平台微数据、行政税务记录和跨境银行转账数据的实证分析
AI.findings: 1) 90%以上投资者不申报加密收入；2) 投资者显著且持续地将交易从国内平台转移到国外平台以逃避监管
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了国内执法策略在应对去中心化、无国界资产逃税方面的理论局限性
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了国际协调在加密货币税收执法中的必要性，为政策制定者提供了实证依据

detail.abstract: On April 2, 2025, President Donald Trump announced a wide-ranging set of "reciprocal tariffs" against many of its trading partners. The calculation of these tariffs have elicited a largely negative reaction in part due to the simple formula used to calculate them. In this note, I provide a model which, under the proper assumptions, does indeed result in the administration's formula. I, however, leave it to the reader to judge whether these assumptions are reasonable.

title: From Profits to Paperwork: Multinationals and the Cost of Transfer Pricing Regulation
affiliations: Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU) and Norwegian University of Life Sciences

detail.title: From Profits to Paperwork: Multinationals and the Cost of Transfer Pricing Regulation

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support from The Research Council of Norway (Grant numbers 325720 and 341289) is gratefully acknowledged.

publicationDetails.journalName: Skatteforsk Centre for Tax Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: How costly is transfer pricing (TP) regulation for firms? Drawing on administrative tax return and trade data linked with employment records, we estimate how multinational enterprises (MNEs) in Norway responded to an increase in TP documentation requirements. We analyze the monetary amount that MNEs spent on tax advisory services-both on external consultants and in-house lawyers and accountants-after the reform. Difference-indifferences event study designs show that the regulation significantly raised tax payments, reported profits, and spending on tax advisors. This includes a 25% increase in expenditures on external consultants and a 50% increase in expenditures on in-house advisors. Smaller MNEs bear a disproportionately large compliance-and administrative burden, raising important considerations for the design and implementation of anti-tax avoidance measures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过挪威的行政税务数据研究发现，转移定价法规显著增加了跨国企业的合规成本，包括外部咨询费用增加25%和内部顾问费用增加50%，同时提高了税收支付和报告利润，对小企业造成不成比例的负担。
AI.research_question: 转移定价法规对企业造成了多大的成本负担？
AI.motivation: 了解反避税措施对企业的实际影响，特别是转移定价法规带来的合规成本
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于转移定价理论和合规成本理论，分析法规对企业行为的影响
AI.method: 使用双重差分事件研究设计，结合行政税务申报数据、贸易数据和就业记录
AI.findings: 法规显著提高了税收支付、报告利润和税务顾问支出，外部咨询费用增加25%，内部顾问费用增加50%，小企业负担更重
AI.theory_contributions: 为转移定价法规的合规成本提供了实证证据，完善了反避税措施影响的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计反避税措施提供了重要参考，特别是需要考虑小企业的承受能力

title: Skjermingsfradraget: en skattegave til de få?
affiliations: Norwegian University of Life Sciences

detail.title: Skjermingsfradraget: en skattegave til de få?

declarations.funderStatement: Skatteforsk’s Working Paper Series is financed through support from The Research Council of Norway (Grant number 341289).

publicationDetails.journalName: Skatteforsk Centre for Tax Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Som følge av aksjonærmodellen skattlegges utbytte og gevinst fra aksjer kun når det tas ut på personlig hånd, og kun på beløp som overstiger aksjonærens skjermingsfradrag, som skal tilsvare risikofri avkastning. I denne analysen undersøker jeg hvordan skjermingsfradraget har blitt brukt siden innføringen i 2006. Jeg analyserer utvikling i skjermingsfradrag og -grunnlag over tid, og hvordan dette er fordelt i befolkningen, særlig ved rangering på formue.
Jeg finner at skjermingsfradragene er skjevt fordelt. 95 prosent av alle aksjonærer har årlige skattebesparelser under 15 000 kr, mens et fåtall kan ta ut millioner i skattefrie aksjeinntekter. De 10 prosent med størst formue mottar rundt 70 prosent av totale skjermingsfradrag. På selskapsnivå er det eldre, veletablerte selskaper som gir de største skjermingsfradragene for sine eiere.
Effektiv gjennomsnittlig skatt på utbytte og gevinst ser ut til å være relativt lik for ulike formuesgrupper, men det kan variere mye mellom aksjonærer innad i samme gruppe. De med store skjermingsfradrag har lavere effektiv skatt på utbytte og gevinst enn de med små skjermingsfradrag.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了挪威股东模型下税收屏蔽扣除的使用情况，发现扣除额在人口中分布极不均衡，前10%的富人获得了约70%的总扣除额，而95%的股东年税收节省低于15,000挪威克朗。
AI.research_question: 自2006年引入以来，税收屏蔽扣除是如何被使用的？其在不同财富群体中的分布情况如何？
AI.motivation: 了解股东模型下税收屏蔽扣除的实际使用情况和分布公平性，评估税收政策的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 股东模型税收理论，税收公平理论，财富分配理论
AI.method: 时间序列分析税收屏蔽扣除和基础的变化，按财富等级进行人口分布分析，公司层面分析
AI.findings: 税收屏蔽扣除分布极不均衡：95%股东年税收节省<15,000克朗，前10%富人获得70%总扣除额；老牌成熟公司为所有者提供最大扣除额；有效平均税率看似相似但个体差异大
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了税收屏蔽扣除在实际使用中的不平等分布，为税收公平理论提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了税收屏蔽扣除使用情况的详细分析，有助于评估和优化税收政策设计

title: Multinational Network, Innovation and The Growth of Employment
affiliations: University College Dublin (UCD), Centre d'Etudes Prospectives et d'Info. Internationales (CEPII), Université Paris Dauphine and Université Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne

detail.title: Multinational Network, Innovation and The Growth of Employment

declarations.funderStatement: This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under grant agreement No. 101061123. Skatteforsk’s Working Paper Series is financed through support from The Research Council of Norway (Grant number 341289).

publicationDetails.journalName: Skatteforsk Centre for Tax Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: There is a long-standing recognition that innovating firms often have higher employment growth. More recently, there is increasing understanding that innovation is concentrated among a small number of generally large firms. We contribute to this debate by showing that the innovation-employment link for a firm is dependent on its multinational status. While we find that more innovative firms are also faster growing ones-even after accounting for size-there is an even greater effect from innovation for multinationals. While we do find evidence suggesting that such firms benefit from innovation done by other affiliates of the same parent, we nonetheless find that they benefit more from their own innovation as well. Thus, this points to important features of multinationals such as integrated global supply chains that are key to understanding the relationship between innovation and employment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，创新与就业增长之间的关系取决于企业的跨国地位。虽然创新型企业通常就业增长更快，但跨国企业从创新中获得的就业增长效应更为显著。跨国企业不仅受益于同一母公司其他子公司的创新，更重要的是受益于自身创新，这与其全球供应链整合等特征密切相关。
AI.research_question: 企业的跨国地位如何影响创新与就业增长之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，创新型企业通常具有更高的就业增长率，但创新主要集中在少数大型企业。本文旨在探讨跨国地位在这一关系中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新与就业增长关系的现有理论，结合跨国公司理论，特别是全球供应链整合和知识转移等概念。
AI.method: 实证分析方法，通过企业层面数据检验创新与就业增长的关系，并区分跨国企业和非跨国企业。
AI.findings: 创新型企业就业增长更快，但跨国企业从创新中获得的就业增长效应更为显著；跨国企业不仅受益于同一母公司其他子公司的创新，更重要的是受益于自身创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对创新与就业增长关系的理解，强调了企业跨国地位的重要调节作用，扩展了跨国公司理论在创新就业效应方面的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何通过支持创新来促进就业的见解，特别强调了跨国企业在创新驱动就业增长中的关键作用。

title: Pennies from Haven: Tax Havens and Employee Compensation
affiliations: School of Economics and Business, NMBU, Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU), University College Dublin (UCD) and Norwegian University of Life Sciences

detail.title: Pennies from Haven: Tax Havens and Employee Compensation

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support from The Research Council of Norway (Grants 326720 and 341289) is gratefully acknowledged.

publicationDetails.journalName: Skatteforsk Centre for Tax Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The ability of multinationals to avoid taxes by shifting profits to tax havens has drawn increasing criticism on both revenue and equity grounds. Using a staggered difference-indifferences approach and matched Norwegian employer-employee data, we show that haven-using firms pay higher compensation. This is particularly apparent in services where the haven pay premium is nearly 2%. Further, there is substantial within-firm heterogeneity with high-skill occupations earning higher premia. These estimates suggest that income inequality growth would have been 13% lower without havens. Finally, we estimate that higher employee tax payments offset 8% of the corporate tax loss due to haven use.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现使用避税天堂的跨国公司向员工支付更高薪酬，特别是服务业中避税天堂薪酬溢价接近2%，高技能职业获得更高溢价。如果没有避税天堂，收入不平等增长将降低13%，员工缴纳的更高税收可抵消8%因避税天堂使用造成的公司税收损失。
AI.research_question: 避税天堂使用如何影响跨国公司的员工薪酬和收入不平等？
AI.motivation: 跨国公司通过将利润转移到避税天堂来避税的能力在收入和公平方面受到越来越多的批评，需要研究其对员工薪酬和收入不平等的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于避税天堂使用与薪酬溢价的理论联系，关注公司内部薪酬分配和收入不平等机制。
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分方法和匹配的挪威雇主-雇员数据。
AI.findings: 使用避税天堂的公司支付更高薪酬，服务业避税天堂薪酬溢价接近2%，高技能职业获得更高溢价；收入不平等增长将降低13%；员工更高税收支付抵消8%公司税收损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了避税天堂使用对薪酬结构和收入不平等的影响机制，丰富了跨国公司避税行为的社会经济后果研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了避税天堂使用对收入分配影响的经验证据，有助于设计更有效的税收和收入分配政策。

title: The Uneven Regional Geography of Telecommunication Standard Essential Patents
affiliations: Te Pūnaha Matatini, University College Dublin (UCD), University College Dublin (UCD), ipQuants AG and University College Dublin

detail.title: The Uneven Regional Geography of Telecommunication Standard Essential Patents

declarations.funderStatement: Skatteforsk’s Working Paper Series is financed through support from The Research Council of Norway (Grant number 341289).

publicationDetails.journalName: Skatteforsk Centre for Tax Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper explores the role of Standard Essential Patents (SEPs) in shaping technological development and regional innovation in Europe's telecommunications sector. Results reveal strong geographic concentration, particularly in Helsinki and Stockholm, which account for one-third of multi-generation cellular network technology SEPs. Unlike other technologies, SEP distribution does not scale with population or prior technological expertise. Findings further suggest a winner-takesall dynamic, where early SEP leadership reinforces future dominance, yet this advantage weakens across generations. The study offers new insights into standardization's spatial dynamics and underscores the need for long-term perspectives when modeling technological competition and diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了标准必要专利在欧洲电信行业技术发展和区域创新中的作用，发现SEPs呈现强烈的地理集中性，赫尔辛基和斯德哥尔摩占据了三分之一的多代蜂窝网络技术SEPs。SEP分布不随人口或技术专长而扩展，呈现赢家通吃动态，但优势随技术代际更替而减弱。
AI.research_question: 标准必要专利如何影响欧洲电信行业的技术发展和区域创新格局？
AI.motivation: 理解标准化过程的空间动态特征，以及SEPs在塑造技术竞争和扩散模式中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准必要专利理论、技术扩散理论、区域创新系统理论、赢家通吃动态
AI.method: 实证分析方法，基于SEPs的地理分布数据和多代蜂窝网络技术数据
AI.findings: 1. SEPs呈现强烈地理集中性，赫尔辛基和斯德哥尔摩占三分之一多代蜂窝网络技术SEPs；2. SEP分布不随人口或技术专长扩展；3. 存在赢家通吃动态，早期SEP领先地位强化未来优势；4. 这种优势随技术代际更替而减弱
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了标准化过程空间动态的新见解，完善了技术竞争和扩散模型，强调了长期视角的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于技术标准制定和区域创新政策的参考，帮助企业理解技术竞争格局

detail.abstract: Innovation is widely believed to play an important role in addressing climate change. Nevertheless, estimating such effects is difficult due to the endogeneity of innovation measures. I use a novel shift-share instrument building from cross-border patent citations to deal with this endogeneity. Using data for 27 European countries across 20 manufacturing industries from 1995-2019, I find evidence of significant endogeneity bias that overstates the causal effect of patents on emissions. Further, if anything, it seems that new non-green patents may increase emissions. This then suggests that relying on new technologies alone to solve the climate crisis is potentially ineffective.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建基于跨国专利引用的工具变量，发现专利对碳排放的因果效应存在显著的内生性偏误，非绿色专利可能增加排放，表明仅依赖新技术无法有效解决气候危机。
AI.research_question: 创新（特别是专利）对气候变化（碳排放）的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 创新在应对气候变化中扮演重要角色，但由于创新指标的内生性问题，准确估计其效应存在困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生性偏误理论、工具变量方法（基于跨国专利引用的shift-share工具变量）

detail.abstract: The hope that multinational firms will improve local employment and productivity is a driving force behind policy efforts to attract investment. Such spillovers are often motivated by technological spillovers from foreign to domestic firms. We address this possibility by using the patenting activity of foreign multinationals in Europe as a measure of affiliate activity alongside more traditional proxies. We find that local firms' employment and labour productivity is higher when FDI activity increases, particularly when those multinationals are upstream of locals. Furthermore, this effect is particularly significant among domestic patenting firms. Thus, it seems that the benefits of inbound investment are greatest for local innovators who are exposed to inbound innovating foreigners.

title: Contesting State Capture
affiliations: Boston College - Law School

detail.title: Contesting State Capture
detail.abstract: State capture poses a distinctive challenge to democracy in the United States. As well-resourced individuals and interest groups exert ever-increasing influence over public policymaking, the American legal system loses its moorings in majority will and democratic faith. The costs of this process are borne by the poor and working classes. Unlike most public-law scholarship concerned with state capture, this Article surfaces potential remedies in the underutilized tools of state constitutional law. Drawing on state constitutional history and political-economic scholarship, it argues that when confronted with legislation suspected of capture, state courts should abandon rational basis scrutiny in favor of more searching forms of anticapture review. Their authority to do so may be located in restraints on legislative power common to every state constitution. State constitution-makers created these restraints in the nineteenth century in order to empower courts to check their captured legislatures. Still very much good law, they can and should be mobilized to contest state capture today.

detail.abstract: This study examines the interplay between trade policy, in particular non-tariff measures (NTMs), and revealed technological comparative advantage (RTA) at the NUTS2 level as drivers of foreign direct investment (FDI) over time. Combining data from the Orbis database (Bureau Van Dijk), the NTMs database (WTO I-TIP) and the European Patent Office (EPO PATStat), we construct a comprehensive panel database of European firms owned by foreign EU and non-EU firms. This database includes financial information for both parent companies and subsidiaries, as well as detailed country and sector-specific trade barriers from the perspective of both the home and host economies. Furthermore, this database allows us to compute tailored RTA variables reflecting firm-specific technological interests proxied by firms' patent production across technology classes. Using a Poisson Pseudo Maximum Likelihood (PPML) estimator, our analysis reveals a heterogeneous impact of NTMs and RTAs on FDI investment in the EU regions. Specifically, while increasing regulatory distance Technical Barriers to Trade (TBT) and Sanitary and Phytosanitary Standards (SPS) measures hampers FDI investment from extra-EU companies, the results on tariffs support the regulatory jumping motive. Furthermore, local technological capabilities significantly support FDI, especially when RTAs reflect the technological interests of the foreign-owned subsidiary, while the effect is reversed when accounting for the innovation portfolio of the parent company.

title: Eine Untersuchung der bilanziellen Abbildung und bestehender Rechnungslegungspraktiken bei tokenisierten Geschäftsvorfällen anhand ausgewählter Beispiele (An Analysis of Accounting Treatment and Financial Reporting Practices for Tokenized Transactions Based on Selected Case Studies)

detail.title: Eine Untersuchung der bilanziellen Abbildung und bestehender Rechnungslegungspraktiken bei tokenisierten Geschäftsvorfällen anhand ausgewählter Beispiele (An Analysis of Accounting Treatment and Financial Reporting Practices for Tokenized Transactions Based on Selected Case Studies)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no competing interests.

detail.abstract:
German Abstract: Diese Arbeit untersucht die bilanzielle Abbildung und bestehende Rechnungslegungspraktiken im Zusammenhang mit tokenisierten Geschäftsvorfällen, insbesondere im Kontext virtueller Welten und der Blockchain-Technologie. Ziel der Arbeit ist es, die Auswirkungen der Tokenisierung von Vermögensgegenständen – etwa Kryptowährungen, NFTs und virtuelle Grundstücke – auf die nationale Rechnungslegung nach HGB zu analysieren und praxisrelevante Herausforderungen aufzuzeigen. Nach einer technischen Einführung in die Funktionsweise von Distributed-Ledger-Systemen, Smart Contracts und virtuellen Vermögenswerten erfolgt eine detaillierte Untersuchung der Bilanzierung von Bitcoin-Beständen sowie von weiteren verschiedenen Transaktionen in virtuellen Welten. Anhand ausgewählter Fallbeispiele werden sowohl die Aktivierungsfähigkeit und (Folge-)Bewertung digitaler Vermögensgegenstände als auch Fragen der Risikosteuerung durch Bitcoin-Hedging und der bilanzrechtlichen Abbildung von korrespondierenden Derivaten analysiert. Die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass die bestehenden handelsrechtlichen Regelungen erhebliche Interpretationsspielräume lassen und eine systematische Weiterentwicklung der Bilanzierungsvorschriften für digitale Vermögenswerte erforderlich ist. Die Arbeit schließt mit einem Ausblick auf künftige Entwicklungen der Rechnungslegung im Metaverse und die Notwendigkeit einer internationalen Harmonisierung der Standards im Umgang mit tokenisierten Geschäftsvorfällen.

English Abstract: This thesis examines the accounting representation and existing financial reporting practices related to tokenized transactions, particularly in the context of virtual worlds and blockchain technology. The objective is to analyze the effects of asset tokenization—such as cryptocurrencies, NFTs, and virtual real estate—on German accounting standards (HGB) and to identify practical challenges arising from their application. Following a technical introduction to the functioning of distributed ledger systems, smart contracts, and virtual assets, the paper provides an in-depth analysis of Bitcoin accounting and various other transactions within virtual environments. Selected case studies explore both the recognition and subsequent measurement of digital assets, as well as risk management through Bitcoin hedging and the accounting treatment of corresponding derivatives. The findings indicate that current commercial accounting regulations leave significant interpretive gaps and highlight the need for a systematic development of accounting standards for digital assets. The thesis concludes with an outlook on future developments in Metaverse accounting and emphasizes the necessity of international harmonization of standards governing tokenized transactions.


This paper was originally published open-access on Zenodo (DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17543599) under a Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial 4.0 International License (CC BY-NC 4.0).

detail.title: Public Choice And Public Trust

publicationDetails.detailsText: New York University Journal of Law and Liberty, Vol. 19, pp. 138-182

detail.abstract: The public trust doctrine, originally a legal principle designed to protect public access to navigable waters for commerce and navigation, has been expanded far beyond its historical scope. Courts and policymakers now use the doctrine as a broad instrument of environmental intervention, often invoking it to justify sweeping regulatory mandates and restrictions on private property. This expansion facilitates rent-seeking, allowing interest groups and regulators to pursue policy objectives without bearing the attendant costs. By shifting control over natural resources, the modern doctrine allows political actors to redistribute property rights under the false guise of public benefit, yielding inefficiencies and discouraging private conservation. This Article examines the historical development of the doctrine, criticizes its contemporary applications, and argues against its continued expansion. A more restrained approach, grounded in the doctrine's original justifications, would better balance public and private interests while reducing rent-seeking behavior.

detail.title: Examining ACG Culture under Engels’s “Marriage–Prostitution” Framework: The Reproduction of Sexual Commodification and Dominative Logic
detail.abstract:
As the influence of ACG (Anime–Comic–Game) culture continues to expand globally, accompanying issues such as the objectification of women, sexual degradation, and depictions of characters resembling minors have drawn increasing attention. As a significant derivative form of this culture, the portrayal of sexual violence in adult anime (Hentai) warrants serious consideration.

This paper takes Friedrich Engels’ concept of “prostitution” from The Origin of the Family, Private Property, and the State as its theoretical starting point, examining the dual social mechanism of “marriage–prostitution” and elucidating how this mechanism is reactivated and expanded under late capitalism through the commodification of sex and emotion. Building on this foundation, it proposes a comprehensive analytical framework—spectacularization, the logic of cuteness, moral disengagement, and sexual scripting—to reveal how this logic operates within Hentai and related ACG texts.

The study argues that such works are not merely harmless cultural consumption but constitute the mediated reproduction of “prostitution” in Engels’ sense. Drawing on Marx, Ueno Chizuko, Althusser, and Goffman, it further analyzes the mechanisms reproducing female subjugation in ACG games and the operational logics of character production, revealing how contemporary ACG culture perpetuates a patriarchal gender order through its fictional sphere.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Abuja Journal of Humanities, volume 6, issue 1, 2025[10.70118/TAJH0006]

detail.abstract: This study investigates the role of social media platforms-Facebook, WhatsApp, and X-in creating awareness about domestic violence against women in the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Abuja, Nigeria. Domestic violence remains a pervasive and underreported issue in many parts of Nigeria, often perpetuated by entrenched cultural norms and systemic inequalities that marginalise women. With the rapid proliferation of digital communication tools, social media has emerged as a potent channel for disseminating information, mobilising public opinion, and advocating for victims' rights. Guided by the Cultivation Theory and the Feminist Theory, this study employed a quantitative survey design using a purposive sampling technique to collect data from 384 women across the six area councils of the FCT. The findings revealed that respondents frequently encountered posts related to domestic violence on these platforms. These posts served multiple purposes: educating women about their rights and available support systems, encouraging public discourse, and influencing attitudes toward domestic violence prevention. Posts identified included those providing psychological and legal assistance, highlighting survivor experiences, and those advocating for stronger institutional responses. Respondents perceived these messages as both informative and empowering. The analysis further affirmed that consistent exposure to such content shaped users' perceptions, in line with the propositions of Cultivation Theory, while also reinforcing the emancipatory aims of Feminist Theory. The study concludes that social media platforms are significant tools for raising awareness and fostering behavioural change regarding domestic violence. It recommends that government agencies, non-governmental organisations, and individuals intensify their use of digital platforms to combat domestic abuse. Future research should consider broader geographical contexts and examine the intersection of social media use with traditional communication channels. The study contributes to the ongoing discourse on digital activism, gender equity, and the transformative potential of technology in addressing human rights violations against women in Nigeria.

title: Contributions of Facebook, WhatsApp and X Posts on Creating Awareness on Domestic Violence against Women in Abuja, Nigeria

detail.title: Contributions of Facebook, WhatsApp and X Posts on Creating Awareness on Domestic Violence against Women in Abuja, Nigeria

publicationDetails.detailsText: Abuja Journal of Humanities, volume 6, issue 1, 2025[10.70118/TAJH0006]

detail.abstract: This study investigates the role of social media platforms-Facebook, WhatsApp, and X-in creating awareness about domestic violence against women in the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Abuja, Nigeria. Domestic violence remains a pervasive and underreported issue in many parts of Nigeria, often perpetuated by entrenched cultural norms and systemic inequalities that marginalise women. With the rapid proliferation of digital communication tools, social media has emerged as a potent channel for disseminating information, mobilising public opinion, and advocating for victims' rights. Guided by the Cultivation Theory and the Feminist Theory, this study employed a quantitative survey design using a purposive sampling technique to collect data from 384 women across the six area councils of the FCT. The findings revealed that respondents frequently encountered posts related to domestic violence on these platforms. These posts served multiple purposes: educating women about their rights and available support systems, encouraging public discourse, and influencing attitudes toward domestic violence prevention. Posts identified included those providing psychological and legal assistance, highlighting survivor experiences, and those advocating for stronger institutional responses. Respondents perceived these messages as both informative and empowering. The analysis further affirmed that consistent exposure to such content shaped users' perceptions, in line with the propositions of Cultivation Theory, while also reinforcing the emancipatory aims of Feminist Theory. The study concludes that social media platforms are significant tools for raising awareness and fostering behavioural change regarding domestic violence. It recommends that government agencies, non-governmental organisations, and individuals intensify their use of digital platforms to combat domestic abuse. Future research should consider broader geographical contexts and examine the intersection of social media use with traditional communication channels. The study contributes to the ongoing discourse on digital activism, gender equity, and the transformative potential of technology in addressing human rights violations against women in Nigeria.

title: Tourists' Emotional Misattribution Behavior under Public Health Emergencies' Haze: Insights from a Quasi-Experiment
affiliations: , Harbin Institute of Technology, University of Macau and Harbin Institute of Technology

detail.title: Tourists' Emotional Misattribution Behavior under Public Health Emergencies' Haze: Insights from a Quasi-Experiment
detail.abstract: Tourists' emotions can be triggered by external stimuli, subsequently impacting their attitudes and behavior. However, whether and how tourist review changes as a result of public health emergencies and their emotional arousal remains unknown. Hence, this study utilizes the emotional misattribution theory and reveals the influence of public health emergencies on the generation of tourist reviews through a quasi-experiment constituted by the COVID-19 outbreak. The difference-indifferences analysis reveals that tourist reviews became more positive during the pandemic, which can be attributed to the nostalgia aroused by the public health emergencies, leading to emotional misattribution behavior. We further analyzed the sources of tourist review changes and identified whether a review was based on purchase orders and tourist reviewer status as factors contributing to changes in rating and review. These findings contribute to tourist behavior literature within the tourism management field and provide practical implications for tourism practitioners and platform operators.

title: An Explainable and Theory-Driven Deep Learning Architecture for Consumer Search and Consideration Sets
affiliations: , New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, Dartmouth College - Tuck School of Business and New York University - Stern School of Business

detail.title: An Explainable and Theory-Driven Deep Learning Architecture for Consumer Search and Consideration Sets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Understanding how consumers form consideration sets is crucial for marketers, yet the complexity of modern search environments makes this challenging to capture. We develop an explainable deep learning architecture that embeds marketing theories into Recurrent Neural Networks to model consumer search dynamics during the consideration stage. A key feature of our model is that it simultaneously captures learning about both product attributes and preference weights through search, rather than learning about only one of these primitives as assumed in prior work. We apply this model to a dataset of consumers searching for smartphones, which includes attribute-level eye-tracking data and search refinement tool usage. We find that our model achieves predictive performance comparable to or better than more flexible but atheoretical deep learning models and maintains high accuracy even for small data samples. Through ablation studies, we demonstrate that these gains emerge from the synergistic integration of all model components within a theory-based framework. Leveraging our model's explainability, we show that consumers primarily learn their preference weights early in search and switch to learning product attributes about 40% into their search process. We find that greater choice complexity, while offering more options, can reduce search efficiency and lead to poorer choices.

title: Beyond the Laugh: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of Consumer Responses to Branded Memes on TikTok
affiliations: Louisiana State University Shreveport and Sungkyunkwan University

detail.title: Beyond the Laugh: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of Consumer Responses to Branded Memes on TikTok
detail.abstract: This study employs a mixed-methods design to investigate how branded meme relatedness on TikTok influences consumer purchase intention within social commerce environments. Quantitatively, an online survey of 473 U.S.-based TikTok users was analyzed using structural equation modeling to test the hypothesized pathways. Results indicate that branded meme relatedness enhances users’ sense of liberation, perceived trendiness, and perceived uniqueness. Liberation significantly increases psychological engagement, while trendiness elevates perceived fun; both engagement and fun predict purchase intention. Uniqueness alone does not directly increase engagement or fun without authenticity and contextual relevance. Complementing these findings, qualitative analysis of 377 open-ended responses reveals four explanatory themes: (1) trendiness functions as social currency that boosts sharing behavior, (2) liberation serves as micro-escapism that encourages engagement beyond humor, (3) uniqueness is effective only when linked to brand authenticity, and (4) attention converts into purchase intention when memes align timely trends with explicit brand cues. Integrating schema theory with the liberating engagement theory of consumer fun, this study presents a theoretical model explaining how branded meme relatedness drives consumer co-creation and purchase behavior on short-form video platforms. The findings extend electronic commerce research by offering actionable insights for brands seeking to design meme-based campaigns that resonate with consumers in online marketplaces.

title: Ethical Accountability Under Republic Act No. 6713: A Critical Examination of Non-Responsive Conduct by Public Officials

detail.title: Ethical Accountability Under Republic Act No. 6713: A Critical Examination of Non-Responsive Conduct by Public Officials
detail.abstract: Republic Act No. 6713, otherwise known as the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees, outlines the core values expected of government personnel, including professionalism, responsiveness, and accountability. Despite this statutory mandate, various instances illustrate how officials verbally acknowledge receipt of communications-such as letters, petitions, or complaints-without taking appropriate administrative action. This paper critiques this practice, arguing that such inaction undermines public trust, violates statutory duties, and perpetuates bureaucratic inefficiency. It draws on legal provisions, jurisprudence, and ethical governance frameworks to call for stronger enforcement mechanisms and institutional reforms.

title: New Approaches to Teaching Foreign Languages in a Modern Educational Environment
affiliations: МГИМО

detail.title: New Approaches to Teaching Foreign Languages in a Modern Educational Environment
detail.abstract: The modern educational environment, characterized by globalization and rapid technological advancement, necessitates a paradigm shift in the methodologies of foreign language (FL) teaching. Moving beyond traditional grammar-translation and audio-lingual methods, contemporary pedagogy emphasizes the development of genuine communicative competence and intercultural awareness. This abstract explores the key new approaches that are reshaping FL instruction, focusing on their integration within a technology-rich learning context. The central evolution lies in the move from teacher-centered to student-centered, active learning models. While the Communicative Language Teaching (CLT) approach remains a foundational principle, it has been enhanced by more specific methodologies: Technology-Enhanced Language Learning: Digital tools are no longer supplementary but integral to the learning process. This includes the use of: Immersive Technologies: Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) create simulated environments for authentic, low-anxiety language practice. Mobile-Assisted Language Learning (MALL): Apps for vocabulary (e.g., Anki), language exchange (e.g., Tandem), and interactive exercises enable learning anytime, anywhere. Artificial Intelligence (AI): AI-powered chatbots provide unlimited conversational practice, while adaptive learning platforms tailor content to individual student proficiency and pace. Blended and Flipped Classroom Models: These models optimize classroom time. In a flipped classroom, students acquire foundational knowledge (e.g., grammar, vocabulary) through online materials at home, freeing up in-class time for interactive, communicative activities like debates, project work, and collaborative problem-solving. Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL): This approach teaches a subject (e.g., science, history) through the medium of a foreign language, allowing students to acquire language skills naturally while engaging with meaningful, non-linguistic content. This fosters both linguistic and cognitive development. Personalized and Differentiated Learning: Recognizing learner diversity, modern approaches leverage technology and data analytics to create individualized learning paths. This ensures that instruction addresses the specific needs, interests, and goals of each student, increasing motivation and efficiency. Gamification and Task-Based Learning (TBL): Incorporating game-design elements (badges, leaderboards, challenges) and structuring learning around real-world tasks (e.g., planning a trip, solving a mystery) significantly boosts student engagement, motivation, and the practical application of language skills. In conclusion, the modern approach to teaching foreign languages is a synergistic blend of constructivist pedagogical principles and cutting-edge technology. The focus has decisively shifted from rote memorization to fostering agile, confident, and interculturally competent communicators. The successful implementation of these new approaches requires educators to act as facilitators and guides, continuously adapting their practices to leverage the dynamic tools and student-centered strategies that define the contemporary educational landscape. The future of FL teaching lies in creating flexible, engaging, and deeply personalized learning experiences that prepare students for a interconnected world.

title: Contractual Performance under Pandemic Pressure: Force Majeure, Renegotiation, Remedies and Insurance – Legal Options for Businesses

detail.title: Contractual Performance under Pandemic Pressure: Force Majeure, Renegotiation, Remedies and Insurance – Legal Options for Businesses
detail.abstract: This paper outlines practical legal options for companies struggling to meet contractual obligations during the COVID-19 pandemic. It clarifies the scope and operation of forcemajeure clauses, distinguishes them from frustration and related doctrines, and summarises renegotiation techniques and amendment tools. It then surveys available contractual remedies and the interplay with insurance coverage (notably business interruption), before closing with guidance on dispute resolution pathways (litigation vs. ADR). The focus is on clear decision criteria and documentation standards that preserve rights while promoting commercially sensible outcomes. The paper is a practice-oriented synthesis intended for inhouse counsel and commercial managers.

AI.tldr: 本文为在COVID-19疫情期间难以履行合同义务的公司提供了实用的法律选择，包括不可抗力条款、合同落空原则、重新谈判技巧、合同救济措施、保险覆盖范围以及争议解决途径。

title: Solar Heat for Industrial Processes (SHIP): An Overview of Its Categories and a Review of Its Recent Progress
affiliations: University of Buraimi

detail.title: Solar Heat for Industrial Processes (SHIP): An Overview of Its Categories and a Review of Its Recent Progress
detail.abstract: The term SHIP (solar heat for industrial processes) or SHIPs (solar heat for industrial plants) refers to the use of collected solar radiation for meeting industrial heat demands, rather than for electricity generation. The global thermal capacity of SHIP systems at the end of 2024 stood slightly above 1 GWth, which is comparable to the electric power capacity of a single power station. Despite this relatively small presence, SHIP systems play an important role in rendering industrial processes sustainable. There are two aims in the current study. The first aim is to cover various types of SHIP systems based on the variety of their collector designs, operational temperatures, applications, radiation concentration options, and solar tracking options. SHIP designs can be as simple as unglazed solar collectors (USCs), having a stationary structure without any radiation concentration. On the other hand, SHIP designs can be as complicated as solar power towers (SPTs), having a two-axis solar tracking mechanism with point-focused concentration of the solar radiation. The second aim is to shed some light on the status of SHIP deployment globally, particularly in 2024. This includes a drop during the COVID-19 pandemic. The findings of the current study show that more than 1300 SHIP systems were commissioned worldwide by the end of 2024 (cumulative number), constituting a cumulative thermal capacity of 1071.4 MWth, with a total collector area of 1,531,600 m 2. In 2024 alone, 120.3 MWth of thermal capacity was introduced in 106 SHIP systems having a total collector area of 171,874 m 2. In 2024, 65.9% of the installed global thermal capacity of SHIP systems belonged to the parabolic trough collectors (PTCs), and another 22% of this installed global thermal capacity was attributed to the unevacuated flat plate collectors (FPC-Us). Considering the 106 SHIP systems installed in 2024, the average collector area per system was 1621.4 m 2 /project. However, this area largely depends on the SHIP category, where it is much higher for parabolic trough collectors (37,740.5 m 2 /project) but lower for flat plate collectors (805.2 m 2 /project), and it is lowest for unglazed solar collectors (163.0 m 2 /project). The study anticipates large deployment in SHIP systems (particularly the PTC type) in 2026 in alignment with gigascale solar-steam utilization in alumina production. Several recommendations are provided with regard to the SHIP sector.

detail.abstract: We examine the impact of an election campaign on the labor market outcomes of incumbent party supporters. Using unique data on voters' political preferences during a critical pre-election period in Albania, our difference-indifferences estimates show that supporting the ruling party prior to elections significantly improves individuals' employment and earnings. This labor market premium is particularly pronounced among individuals with low costs of campaign participation, whereas patronage jobs are concentrated in lower-tier public sector positions. Administrative data further show that job distribution to party supporters strongly correlates with increased vote shares for the incumbent. Our findings suggest that parties strategically allocate public employment to mobilize grassroots supporters and secure votes-a practice that fosters corruption and weakens democratic institutions.

title: A Data-driven Optimization Approach to Designing Parsimonious Treatment Guidelines

detail.title: A Data-driven Optimization Approach to Designing Parsimonious Treatment Guidelines

detail.abstract: Clinical treatment guidelines play a central role in managing chronic diseases by providing standardized recommendations to support medical decision-making. While many guidelines incorporate some patient stratification, these stratifications are not necessarily optimal for maximizing population-level health outcomes. Fully personalized treatment policies, while theoretically optimal, are often impractical to implement due to their complexity and resource demands. We introduce the Treatment Guideline Design Problem (TGDP), a novel data-driven optimization framework that simultaneously stratifies a population into a pre-specified number of subgroups and determines an optimal treatment policy for each group. We model each patient in the population as their own Markov Decision Process to capture heterogeneous disease progression and treatment response. We prove that the TGDP is NP-hard and show that expected population-level utility is non-decreasing in the number of stratifications. To solve TGDP, we develop exact and heuristic solution methods. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our heuristics achieve near-optimal outcomes while scaling efficiently to large populations. In a case study on hypertension treatment in a nationally representative U.S. population, we show that a small number of stratifications yields improvements in population-level outcomes over current clinical guidelines. Our data-driven framework enables managers and policymakers to design effective treatment guidelines that account for patient heterogeneity while achieving near-optimal population health outcomes with a small, implementable set of treatment policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了治疗指南设计问题(TGDP)，这是一个数据驱动的优化框架，用于将患者群体划分为预定数量的亚组，并为每个亚组确定最优治疗策略，以在考虑患者异质性的同时实现接近最优的群体健康结果。
AI.research_question: 如何设计能够同时考虑患者异质性并实现接近最优群体健康结果的治疗指南？
AI.motivation: 现有临床治疗指南中的患者分层不一定能最大化群体健康结果，而完全个性化治疗策略又因复杂性和资源需求而难以实施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将每个患者建模为马尔可夫决策过程，以捕捉异质性疾病进展和治疗反应。
AI.method: 开发了精确和启发式求解方法来解决TGDP问题，并通过数值实验验证方法的有效性。
AI.findings: 少量分层就能在群体水平结果上优于现有临床指南，启发式方法能够实现接近最优的结果并扩展到大规模人群。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了TGDP问题是NP难的，并证明了期望群体效用随分层数量非递减。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和政策制定者提供了设计有效治疗指南的数据驱动框架，能够在考虑患者异质性的同时使用少量可实施的治疗策略实现接近最优的群体健康结果。

detail.abstract: In recent months, the federal government has waged war on a few different cities across the U.S., including Washington D.C., Los Angeles, and Chicago, by deploying the National Guard. These deployments have come weeks after the federal government pushed false political narratives describing those cities as having high crime rates which require federal intervention. The use of this tactic is straight out of the authoritarian playbook and does not protect democracy in any way. This episode of Justice Above All explores the historical and ongoing dynamics of state and federal intervention in U.S. cities, particularly in those with large Black populations and in those that are led by Black mayors. We recorded this episode live at the Congressional Black Caucus Foundation's fifty-fourth Annual Legislative Conference.

AI.research_question: 联邦政府如何以及为何对特定美国城市进行军事干预，特别是针对黑人社区和黑人市长领导的城市？

title: Determinants of Customer Loyalty in Mobile Commerce: An Artificial Neural Network Analysis
affiliations: SDM Institute for Management Development

detail.abstract: The m-commerce market, particularly in India, is expanding rapidly, necessitating a heightened focus on customer loyalty by mobile shopping application marketers to secure a sustainable competitive advantage amid increased competition. This study, employing both multiple regression analysis (MRA) and artificial neural networks (ANNs), aims to identify and understand the relative importance of determinants influencing customer loyalty. Data from 535 Indian mobile shopping customers were collected through an online survey for empirical validation. MRA results indicated the significant impact of perceived risk, satisfaction, price-saving orientation, perceived usefulness, and perceived trust on customer loyalty, with hedonic motivation showing no statistical significance. The subsequent ANN analysis revealed satisfaction as the most critical factor, followed by perceived risk, price-saving orientation, perceived usefulness, and perceived trust in shaping customer loyalty. This research contributes to the understanding of m-commerce loyalty in India, one of the world's fastest-growing markets. By emphasizing unique characteristics and dynamics specific to India, the study provides valuable insights for marketers navigating this expanding market. In summary, the study not only underscores the importance of conventional factors but also highlights the nuanced interplay of elements in shaping customer loyalty within the Indian m-commerce landscape. The mixed-method approach enhances the findings' robustness, contributing to a more comprehensive understanding of fostering and sustaining customer loyalty in the competitive realm of Indian m-commerce.

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming organizations by driving efficiency and innovation. However, its rapid adoption also brings ethical, regulatory, and governance challenges. This paper presents the AI-C2C (Conscious to Conscience) Governance Framework-a practical, phased model designed to help organizations navigate ethical AI integration. The framework consists of three stages: AI-Conscious adoption, AI+Human Intelligence (HI) collaboration, and AI-Conscience governance. It evolves with AI maturity, focusing on transparency, accountability, and role-based oversight. The framework is built on insights from expert interviews, sector case studies (IBM, AstraZeneca, Mastercard), and a thorough literature review. It outlines key roles, including the Chief AI Officer (CAIO), the creation of AI ethics committees, and the use of Explainable AI (XAI). Additionally, the framework proposes seven Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to assess ethical compliance, transparency, workforce readiness, and regulatory alignment. This paper provides a clear roadmap for organizations to adopt AI responsibly, foster stakeholder trust, and create long-term value through ethical innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI-C2C治理框架，这是一个分阶段的实用模型，帮助组织在AI成熟度演进过程中实现负责任的AI集成，重点关注透明度、问责制和基于角色的监督。

AI.theory_contributions: 发展了AI治理理论，提出了基于AI成熟度演进的阶段性治理模型，丰富了AI伦理治理的理论框架。

title: Gender Differences in Digital and Psychological Drivers of Consumer Behavior: Evidence from India
affiliations: SDM Institute for Management Development

detail.title: Gender Differences in Digital and Psychological Drivers of Consumer Behavior: Evidence from India
detail.abstract: The present study investigates the impact of digital and psychological factors, including Impulsive buying behavior (IBB), Fear of Missing Out (FOMO), Social Media Addiction (SMA), and Materialism (MAT) on Online Compulsive Buying (OCB), focusing on gender differences among Indian consumers. The study adopted a quantitative and descriptive design, and the data was collected from 189 participants who responded to the online survey launched between February and May of 2022. The research has applied descriptive statistics, reliability analysis, exploratory factor analysis, and multiple regression for data analysis. The results show that IBB and FOMO significantly affect OCB, with IBB having a more positive effect on females and FOMO on males. It also revealed that materialism has less influence on OCB. This study identifies the facilitating role of digital technologies in impulsive online shopping behavior and points out remarkable differences in the effects of various factors based on gender. The results provide an understanding of consumer behavior in the digital era that marketers and policymakers can use to meet the challenges of online compulsive buying.

title: Borrowing Goodwill

detail.title: Borrowing Goodwill
detail.abstract: The elusive intangible property right known as "goodwill" serves as the central organizing concept for U.S. trademark and unfair competition laws. It also plays an important, but very different, role in the common law tort of passing off in the United Kingdom and Commonwealth countries. Yet the full history of goodwill has not been explored, and many historical accounts of American trademark law have incorrectly identified the concept of commercial goodwill as a nineteenth-century legal creation. The term goodwill, however, was used to describe an intangible property right as far back as the sixteenth century. Commercial goodwill existed as a valuable cultural and market reality for generations-eventually finding its way into the common law by the eighteenth century. During the nineteenth century, American courts often relied on the various strands of doctrine developed by British law and equity courts, but the Supreme Court took U.S. law in a new direction when it placed goodwill at the center of its trademark regime in 1916. By doing so, the United States committed to resolutely use-based trademark protection, in contrast to the formal trademark registration models favored by most jurisdictions around the world. This article explores the earliest origins of commercial goodwill to show that it was already a well-established property right before the advent of modern trademark law and to demonstrate how goodwill protection had an impact on the further development of U.S. trademark law. By reframing the historical narrative of American trademark law to contextualize the relationship between goodwill and trademark law doctrines, and contrasting that relationship with the U.K. law, it sheds light on some of the challenges and tensions seen in U.S. trademark law today.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了商誉概念的历史起源，揭示其早在16世纪就已作为无形财产权存在，而非19世纪的法律创造。文章对比了美国以使用为基础的商标保护模式与英国等地的注册模式，探讨了商誉对商标法发展的影响。
AI.research_question: 商誉作为无形财产权的历史起源是什么？它如何影响美国商标法的发展，并与英国法律形成对比？
AI.motivation: 现有历史叙述错误地将商誉视为19世纪的法律创造，忽视了其更早的历史渊源，需要重新构建商誉与商标法关系的准确历史叙事。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史法学和比较法学框架，分析商誉作为无形财产权的演变过程及其在不同法域中的差异化发展。
AI.method: 历史文献分析和比较法研究，追溯商誉概念从16世纪到现代的发展轨迹，对比英美法系的不同路径。
AI.findings: 商誉作为无形财产权早在16世纪就已存在，18世纪进入普通法；美国最高法院1916年将商誉置于商标制度核心，确立了以使用为基础的商标保护模式，与英国的注册模式形成鲜明对比。
AI.theory_contributions: 修正了商誉历史起源的传统观点，揭示了商誉在商标法形成前就已作为独立财产权存在，为理解商标法的理论基础提供了新视角。

detail.abstract:
Purpose: This study conducts a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of pharmaceutical marketing and branding research, focusing on the transformative period of the last 15 years (2009 to 2023), particularly during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. The purpose of this analysis is to highlight key shifts and trends in the field over this period. 

Design/Methodology/Approach: This study examined 329 research papers sourced from JSTOR and PubMed. It explores the evolution of the field, emphasizing significant shifts and trends. 

Findings: The analysis identified 2009 and 2014 as pivotal years for research activity, with The British Medical Journal and BioMed Central emerging as key publication platforms. Contributions from the United States, led by authors like Joel Lexchin, were particularly notable. The study also highlighted a shift toward AI-driven marketing, digital transformation, and personalized medicine, especially in the post-COVID-19 period (2020 onwards). Co-authorship networks and keyword analysis emphasized the growing focus on regulatory compliance, patient engagement, and the integration of digital tools in pharmaceutical marketing. 

Originality: This study charts the historical and current state of pharmaceutical marketing and branding and sets the foundation for future research, emphasizing the increasing role of digitalization and AI.

AI.motivation: 分析药物营销与品牌研究领域的演变，强调该领域在数字化转型和AI技术影响下的重要变化。

detail.abstract:
This paper explores the evolution of classical market wave theory through the lens of modern liquidity behavior. While Ralph Nelson Elliott’s Wave Principle revolutionized technical analysis in the early 20th century by describing market movements as repeating fractal patterns, this study proposes that those patterns are not driven by collective emotion but by an underlying liquidity algorithm maintaining equilibrium — what rises must rebalance, what falls must restore. Through empirical observation and model development, the Liquidity Tree Framework redefines the market’s structure as a two-wave equilibrium system, balanced by mirrored liquidity branches that grow, contract, and periodically harvest liquidity in perpetual rhythm.

This perspective suggests that markets operate not as chaos shaped by sentiment, but as quantum-like systems of equilibrium, where liquidity flows according to systemic design.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过现代流动性行为重新审视经典市场波浪理论，提出市场波动不是由集体情绪驱动，而是由维持均衡的底层流动性算法驱动，建立了流动性树框架来描述市场的两波均衡系统。

AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性树框架、两波均衡系统理论、量子化系统平衡理论
AI.method: 实证观察和模型开发
AI.findings: 市场运作不是由情绪塑造的混沌，而是类似量子系统的平衡体系，流动性按照系统设计流动。市场结构可重新定义为由镜像流动性分支平衡的两波均衡系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了市场波浪理论的驱动机制，从集体情绪转向流动性算法，提出了流动性树框架和两波均衡系统理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为技术分析提供了新的理论框架，帮助投资者更好地理解市场波动背后的流动性机制，改进交易策略。

title: Shifting Powers: Geopolitics and Their Ripple Effect on Global Operations

detail.title: Shifting Powers: Geopolitics and Their Ripple Effect on Global Operations
detail.abstract:
The year 2025 finds the world of international business in the middle of a massive shake-up, thanks to the most significant geopolitical shifts we've seen in a long time.

The old dream of a truly unified, barrier-free global market that drove modern trade is being taken apart. We're seeing a rise in new trade wars, sanctions, and alliances (or a lack of them) that aren't just high-level political drama anymore—they are now very real, tangible problems for daily business operations. This means companies can no longer rely on simple, seamless global trade; they have to prioritise agility and resilience as the new normal.

These shifts in the international order have a huge impact on global operations, affecting everything from where a single component is sourced to the entire financial system. This article dives into the spiraling effects of these changes on global operations, looking at what's driving them, how they impact businesses and trade, and what they mean for cross-border trade and insulating your business.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年地缘政治剧变对国际商业的深远影响，指出传统全球化模式正在解体，企业需要转向敏捷性和韧性策略来应对贸易战、制裁和联盟重组等新挑战。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治剧变如何影响全球运营，以及企业应如何应对这些变化？
AI.motivation: 随着地缘政治格局的重大转变，传统的无壁垒全球市场梦想正在瓦解，贸易战、制裁和联盟重组已成为企业日常运营的现实挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地缘政治经济学和国际商务理论，分析全球化逆流对企业运营的影响。
AI.method: 理论分析和案例研究，探讨地缘政治变化对全球供应链、贸易和金融系统的影响。
AI.findings: 地缘政治剧变导致全球运营环境复杂化，企业需要从简单无缝的全球贸易转向强调敏捷性和韧性的新策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 为地缘政治变化下的国际商务理论提供了新的分析框架，强调企业战略需要适应新的全球秩序。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了应对地缘政治风险的实用指导，包括供应链多元化、风险管理和运营韧性建设等策略。

detail.title: Decluttering

keywords.keywords: trademark; trade mark; registration; filing; clutter; deadwood

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in Ilanah Fhima and Anke Moerland (eds), Research Agendas in Trade Mark Law (Edward Elgar, 2026)

detail.abstract: This chapter examines the problem of trade mark 'clutter', where registrations remain wholly or partly unused, inflating registers and obstructing legitimate new filings. Section 2 defines clutter, distinguishing it from related phenomena such as registry saturation, depletion and congestion. It also identifies its economic and doctrinal harms. Section 3 surveys empirical methods used to measure unused or over-claimed marks. Section 4 analyses the causes of clutter, including procedural incentives, defensive filings, and evergreening strategies, before evaluating potential legal and administrative responses, such as bad-faith doctrines, proof-of-use audits, and improved registry gatekeeping. Section 5 concludes by identifying open questions and a future research agenda for achieving more accurate registers that better align with trade mark law’s normative foundations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究商标'堆积'问题，即未使用或部分未使用的商标注册导致注册簿膨胀并阻碍新申请。文章定义了堆积现象，分析其经济危害，调查测量方法，探讨成因（程序激励、防御性申请、常青策略），评估法律和行政应对措施，并提出未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 商标堆积问题如何定义、测量、成因分析及应对策略？
AI.motivation: 未使用商标的堆积导致注册簿膨胀，阻碍合法新申请，损害商标制度的效率和公平性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于商标法的规范性基础，结合经济学分析框架，探讨商标堆积对市场效率和制度完整性的影响。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，包括定义区分、实证方法调查、成因分析和政策评估。
AI.findings: 商标堆积由程序激励、防御性申请和常青策略等多因素导致，可通过恶意注册原则、使用证明审计和改进注册管理等措施应对。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确定义商标堆积概念，区分相关现象，构建分析框架，丰富商标制度理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商标管理机构提供政策建议，帮助实现更准确的注册簿，提升商标制度的运行效率。

title: Sustainability of Digital Health Entrepreneurship in Bangladesh: A Review of Current Evidence
affiliations: , Eastern University and Uddog o Uddokta

detail.title: Sustainability of Digital Health Entrepreneurship in Bangladesh: A Review of Current Evidence
detail.abstract: Approximately 98 out of 100 HealthTech startups fail, despite the sector's strong market potential. While digital health offers significant opportunities to transform healthcare delivery in resource-limited settings-particularly in developing countries-the sustainability of these ventures remains uncertain. Digital health can bridge critical healthcare gaps through innovative solutions, and many young entrepreneurs are entering the space with enthusiasm. However, important questions arise: Are these entrepreneurs aware of the long-term sustainability challenges? How will these businesses survive in the long run? Are current policies, government support, and other ecosystem components conducive to sustaining digital health enterprises? Sustaining such ventures remains a major challenge due to policy fragmentation, limited funding opportunities, infrastructure deficits, and workforce constraints. This review assesses the current landscape of digital health entrepreneurship in Bangladesh, using the WHO-ITU National eHealth Strategy Toolkit to evaluate sustainability across key domains: governance, investment, service delivery, interoperability, infrastructure, and human resources. The SPIDER tool was used to guide evidence selection aligned with the study's objectives. Key findings highlight both systemic barriers and emerging enablers, such as hybrid care models, increasing investor interest, and agent-based delivery innovations. This study provides actionable insights for entrepreneurs, policymakers, and investors aiming to build a resilient and scalable digital health ecosystem in Bangladesh and other LMICs.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了孟加拉国数字健康创业现状，使用WHO-ITU国家电子健康战略工具包分析可持续性挑战，发现政策碎片化、资金限制等系统性障碍，但也识别了混合护理模式等新兴推动因素。
AI.research_question: 数字健康创业企业如何在资源有限的环境中实现长期可持续发展？当前的政策、政府支持和生态系统是否有利于数字健康企业的生存？

AI.method: 使用SPIDER工具指导证据选择，进行文献综述，评估孟加拉国数字健康创业现状。
AI.findings: 发现系统性障碍包括政策碎片化、资金机会有限、基础设施不足和人力资源约束；同时识别了混合护理模式、投资者兴趣增长和基于代理的交付创新等新兴推动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资源有限环境下的数字健康创业可持续性提供了理论框架和分析工具，丰富了发展中国家数字健康生态系统研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者、政策制定者和投资者提供了建设弹性和可扩展数字健康生态系统的可行见解，适用于孟加拉国和其他中低收入国家。

title: Simple and Effective: A Deterministic Auction with Support Information
affiliations: Universite du Luxembourg - Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance, Universite du Luxembourg and Luxembourg Centre for Logistics and Supply Chain Management (LCL)

detail.title: Simple and Effective: A Deterministic Auction with Support Information
detail.abstract: We study an auction design problem where a seller aims to sell a single item to multiple bidders with independent private values. The seller knows only an upper bound on these values and does not know their distribution. The objective is to devise a deterministic auction mechanism effective across a broad set of distributions. We propose a second-price auction with a reserve price set at half of the upper bound. Even though no deterministic mechanism can achieve a positive fraction of the maximum achievable expected revenue across all distributions, we show that our mechanism achieves at least 1/ κ (1/ 2 under i.i.d. values) of the maximum expected revenue for a broad range of distributions of practical importance, where κ depends on the number of bidders and takes values in [2, 2.87). Numerical experiments under randomly generated distributions demonstrate the superior performance of our mechanism in the vast majority of the generated instances compared to benchmark mechanisms from the literature. We also account for errors in the upper bound estimate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单物品拍卖设计问题，卖家仅知道竞标者估值的上界而不知其分布。提出了一种基于上界一半作为保留价的第二价格拍卖机制，在多种实际重要分布下能获得至少1/κ的最大期望收益比例。
AI.research_question: 在卖家仅知道竞标者估值上界而不知分布的情况下，如何设计有效的确定性拍卖机制？
AI.motivation: 传统拍卖机制设计通常假设知道估值分布，但在实际中卖家往往只有估值上界信息，需要设计对分布不敏感的稳健机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机制设计理论和鲁棒优化框架，研究在最小信息假设下的拍卖机制设计。
AI.method: 理论分析结合数值实验，提出第二价格拍卖加保留价机制，并与文献基准机制进行性能比较。
AI.findings: 所提机制在广泛的实际重要分布下能获得至少1/κ的最大期望收益，数值实验显示在大多数情况下优于基准机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了确定性机制在最小信息假设下的性能保证，扩展了鲁棒拍卖设计的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际拍卖场景提供了简单有效的机制设计方法，即使在上界估计存在误差时仍能保持良好性能。

title: From Multipolar to Zero Polar: Proposing a Global Equilibrium Based on Moral Maturity
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: From Multipolar to Zero Polar: Proposing a Global Equilibrium Based on Moral Maturity
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the transition of the world order from a Multi-Polar system, driven by the Pole of Power Theory, toward global stability. The Multi-Polar order has demonstrably failed to produce stability; instead, it has fueled new competitive rivalries. We propose Zero Polar Equilibrium as a new paradigm where balance is determined by collective moral maturity, not merely the accumulation of power. We argue that the shift in global public sentiment (with 72% favoring diplomacy) legitimately reflects a transfer in the basis of soft power legitimacy, justifying the claim of moral evolution. This theory is rooted in Generational Evolution and supported by OZINomy-a socioeconomic model that aligns incentives through the principle of "dignified togetherness." The manuscript concludes with a Proposed Methodology that includes specific examples of policy simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了世界秩序从多极体系向全球稳定的转变，提出了零极平衡作为新范式，认为平衡应由集体道德成熟度而非权力积累决定。
AI.research_question: 世界秩序如何从多极体系转向基于集体道德成熟的稳定平衡？
AI.motivation: 多极秩序未能产生稳定，反而加剧了新的竞争对抗。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极权理论、代际进化理论、OZINomy社会经济模型
AI.method: 政策模拟方法，包括具体案例研究
AI.findings: 72%的全球公众舆论支持外交，反映了软权力合法性的转移，证明了道德进化的主张。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了零极平衡理论，将平衡基础从权力积累转向集体道德成熟。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于"尊严共处"原则的政策模拟方法，为全球治理提供实践指导。

title: Government Funding Allocation in Anti-Obesity Medicine R&D: Theory and Experiments
affiliations: Duke University - Fuqua School of Business, Dalian University of Technology and Cornell University - Samuel Curtis Johnson Graduate School of Management

detail.title: Government Funding Allocation in Anti-Obesity Medicine R&D: Theory and Experiments
detail.abstract: As obesity remains one of the most prevalent health concerns in the United States, the government and other public sectors have increasingly invested in pharmaceutical R&D for anti-obesity medicine. Beyond maximizing expected payoff, the government has broader responsibilities, such as collecting accurate market information (e.g., private R&D costs) to support the design of effective subsidies and policy interventions for obesity treatment. However, pharmaceutical firms may misreport their private costs when competing for public funding, complicating efficient allocation. We therefore design an allocation mechanism that captures the key features of public investment in anti-obesity medicine R&D. In a static setting with a government with a limited budget and multiple firms, this mechanism incentivizes truthful reporting while maximizing the government’s expected payoff. We then conduct laboratory experiments comparing our mechanism with two benchmarks: a threshold mechanism and a first-price auction-based (FPA-based) mechanism. The results show that the proposed mechanism induces more truthful reporting of private information and that its empirical performance aligns well with theoretical expectations. In contrast, the FPA-based mechanism exhibits substantial discrepancies between theory and experiment. A second experimental study suggests that risk aversion and ambiguity aversion induce agents to adopt more conservative reporting strategies under the FPA-based mechanism. Supported by both theoretical and experimental evidence, our proposed mechanism offers guidance for designing funding policies and subsidy schemes that align pharmaceutical R&D incentives with broader public health objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文设计了一种激励制药公司真实报告研发成本的机制，通过实验室实验验证其有效性，为政府制定肥胖治疗药物研发资助政策提供指导。

AI.method: 理论机制设计+实验室实验，比较提出的机制与阈值机制和首价拍卖机制的绩效。
