AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一种在公共投资背景下激励真实成本报告的机制设计框架，丰富了信息不对称环境下的机制设计理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府设计肥胖治疗药物研发资助政策提供具体机制，帮助更好地将制药研发激励与公共卫生目标对齐。

title: Constructing the Circular Economy: Marketing as a Constitutive Force for Market Creation, Maintenance, and Growth
affiliations: University of Portsmouth

detail.title: Constructing the Circular Economy: Marketing as a Constitutive Force for Market Creation, Maintenance, and Growth
detail.abstract: The circular economy (CE) represents a paradigm shift from the linear 'take-make-waste' model, yet its widespread adoption remains nascent. This conceptual paper argues that prevailing marketing paradigms, which often operate within pre-existing markets, are insufficient to drive this systemic transition. Drawing on a reconceptualization of marketing as "the art and science of market creation, maintenance, and growth" (Kamel, 2025), we propose a novel framework that positions marketing's primary role in the CE as actively constituting the markets for circular products, services, and models. We delineate how marketing functions as a generative, institutional practice through three interdependent processes: (1) Market Creation (framing new value propositions (Fehrer & Wieland, 2021), building reverse logistics infrastructures (Aarikka-Stenroos et al., 2022), and shaping consumer subjectivities (Gupta & Sheth, 2023)); (2) Market Maintenance (establishing trust in refurbished goods (Andrews et al., 2019), standardizing circular claims to combat greenwashing (Kemper & Ballantine, 2023), and repairing legitimacy (Baker et al., 2019)); and (3) Market Growth (scaling circular offerings (Verleye et al., 2024), enrolling new actor networks (Kaipainen et al., 2022), and shaping supportive policy environments (Leenders et al., 2024)). By integrating this framework with key CE challenges, we advance a research agenda that reorients marketing from a responsive tool to a central, transformative force in building a sustainable future.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将营销重新概念化为市场创造、维护和增长的艺术与科学，构建了一个新框架，将营销在循环经济中的主要角色定位为积极构建循环产品、服务和模式的市场。
AI.research_question: 营销在推动循环经济系统转型中应扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 循环经济代表了从线性'取-用-弃'模式的范式转变，但其广泛采用仍处于初级阶段。现有的营销范式往往在既有市场中运作，不足以推动这种系统性转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将营销重新概念化为"市场创造、维护和增长的艺术与科学"（Kamel, 2025），整合制度理论、价值共创理论和网络理论。
AI.method: 概念性论文，通过文献综述和理论构建方法。
AI.findings: 营销作为生成性制度实践，通过三个相互依赖的过程发挥作用：市场创造（构建新价值主张、建立逆向物流基础设施、塑造消费者主体性）、市场维护（建立翻新商品信任、标准化循环声明、修复合法性）、市场增长（扩大循环产品规模、吸纳新参与者网络、塑造支持性政策环境）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将营销重新定位为循环经济中的核心变革力量，而非响应性工具；构建了营销作为市场构成实践的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在循环经济中实施营销策略提供实践指导；帮助政策制定者理解营销在推动循环经济转型中的关键作用。

title: Inside the Progressive Alliance Network
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Inside the Progressive Alliance Network
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the evolving transnational networks of political influence structured through the Progressive Alliance and their connections to philanthropic and ideological ecosystems led by figures such as George Soros and affiliated organizations. Through an interdisciplinary lens combining international political economy, digital diplomacy, and global governance theory, the study investigates how ideological synchronization occurs across over 140 political parties spanning Europe, Latin America, and South Asia. Using India and South America (Brazil, Colombia, Peru, and Chile) as comparative case studies, the paper highlights the interplay between soft power, strategic philanthropy, and hybrid political mobilization.


The analysis maps four layers of influence — organizational, geographical, temporal, and network-based — to demonstrate how civil society institutions, think tanks, and policy advisors function as intermediaries in shaping global political discourse. The study further traces connections between high-profile actors such as George and Alex Soros, Sam Pitroda, and Rahul Gandhi, exploring how Progressive Alliance meetings and regional conferences reflect a broader design of ideological globalization.


By combining open-source intelligence (OSINT), event chronologies, and social network mapping, this research contributes to the emerging literature on networked internationalism and post-sovereign political coordination. It concludes that the Progressive Alliance functions as a new architecture of political connectivity that transcends borders and leverages narrative warfare, strategic funding, and civil institutions to engineer systemic political alignment in the global South.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析进步联盟的跨国网络，揭示了乔治·索罗斯等人物领导的慈善和意识形态生态系统如何通过组织、地理、时间和网络四层影响力，在全球南方实现意识形态同步和政治协调。
AI.research_question: 进步联盟如何通过跨国网络构建政治影响力，并在全球南方实现意识形态同步？
AI.motivation: 研究进步联盟等跨国政治网络如何通过慈善、智库和民间社会组织塑造全球政治话语，特别是在全球南方国家的政治协调机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际政治经济学、数字外交、全球治理理论、网络化国际主义、后主权政治协调
AI.method: 比较案例研究（印度和南美国家）、开源情报分析、事件时间线追踪、社会网络映射
AI.findings: 进步联盟通过组织、地理、时间和网络四层影响力结构，利用软实力、战略慈善和混合政治动员，在全球南方实现系统性政治协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了网络化国际主义和后主权政治协调理论，提出了四层影响力分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了跨国政治网络运作机制，为理解当代全球政治协调提供了实证基础，对政策制定者和研究人员具有参考价值。

title: The Great Escape: Physicians Leaving the Public Sector
affiliations: University of Verona and Sapienza University of Rome

detail.title: The Great Escape: Physicians Leaving the Public Sector
detail.abstract: In many countries, public healthcare systems are facing the unprecedented challenge of attracting new physicians and retaining existing physicians. Given that the role of noneconomic factors in responding to such a challenge is as important as the role played by economic factors, we use outbreaks of healthcare scandals from 2000 to 2020 in approximately 100 Italian provinces to address the impact of perceived corruption on the density of public hospital physicians. The outbreak of a scandal is associated with a 3.6% decrease in the presence of public hospital physicians. The effect is explained mainly by so-called supply-side drivers, such as ethical concerns (i.e., a scandal related to a malpractice case), a lack of motivation in the workplace, concerns about the high salience of the scandal (e.g., more media coverage), and more outside options. Demandside drivers, such as a lower level of trust on the patient side, which affects the patient distribution and, indirectly, the physician distribution, do not seem to play a crucial role within the institutional setting analyzed. Our results are robust to different staggered DID estimators, the inclusion of trends to capture potential time-varying attitudes toward corrupt behaviors, and the inclusion of variables that are expected to affect both the density of public hospital physicians and the occurrence of scandals. Healthcare scandals do not seem to affect the density of other types of civil servants, such as teachers or firefighters.

AI.tldr: 本文利用意大利100个省份2000-2020年的医疗丑闻数据，研究发现医疗丑闻爆发会导致公立医院医生密度下降3.6%，主要原因是供应方因素（伦理担忧、工作动机缺乏、媒体关注度高、外部选择多），而非需求方因素（患者信任度下降）。
AI.research_question: 感知腐败（医疗丑闻）如何影响公立医院医生的密度？
AI.motivation: 许多国家公共医疗系统面临吸引和留住医生的挑战，非经济因素与经济因素同等重要
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应方驱动因素（伦理担忧、工作动机、丑闻显著性、外部选择）与需求方驱动因素（患者信任）的理论框架
AI.method: 利用意大利100个省份2000-2020年医疗丑闻爆发的准自然实验，采用交错DID估计方法
AI.findings: 医疗丑闻爆发导致公立医院医生密度下降3.6%，主要受供应方因素驱动，需求方因素影响不显著
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对非经济因素在医生职业选择中作用的理解，特别是感知腐败对医疗人力资源的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共医疗系统管理者提供政策启示，强调改善工作环境伦理和减少丑闻发生的重要性

title: The Long Shadow of the Conquest of 1760 on Quebec's Relative Poverty
affiliations: University of Montreal and George Mason University - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Long Shadow of the Conquest of 1760 on Quebec's Relative Poverty
detail.abstract: Quebec's enduring poverty relative to North America is often blamed on the British Conquest of New France, said to have caused "social decapitation" as French elites fled, pushing French-Canadians into subsistence farming (a retreat from markets) which stopped "normal" development. Yet recent research shows they actually became more market-oriented over time, undermining that view. We argue instead that the Conquest's physical destruction drove relative poverty. Using parish-level variation in burning and pillage during 1759-60 as localized treatment, and a difference-indifferences approach with censuses, tithe records, literacy microdata, and vital registers (1734-1800), we examine impacts on infant mortality, multiple births, livestock, output, and literacy. Results show immediate shocks-higher mortality and temporary agricultural decline-and lasting harms to child health and literacy. Thus, the Conquest mattered, but as a war-induced shock.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统观点，认为魁北克相对贫困的原因不是英国征服导致的社会精英流失和自给自足农业，而是战争期间物理破坏的直接冲击。通过使用教区层面的燃烧和掠夺数据，研究发现征服战争造成了婴儿死亡率上升、农业产出下降以及长期对儿童健康和识字率的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 英国征服新法兰西对魁北克经济发展的真实影响是什么？是传统认为的社会精英流失导致的自给自足农业，还是战争物理破坏的直接冲击？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将魁北克的相对贫困归因于英国征服导致的社会精英流失，但近期研究表明法裔加拿大人实际上变得更加市场化，这挑战了传统解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会精英流失理论 vs 战争冲击理论；使用教区层面的物理破坏作为局部处理变量来识别因果关系
AI.method: 使用双重差分法，结合教区层面的燃烧和掠夺数据（1759-60年）、人口普查、什一税记录、识字率微观数据和生命登记数据（1734-1800年）
AI.findings: 1. 立即冲击：婴儿死亡率上升，农业暂时衰退；2. 持久影响：儿童健康和识字率受到长期损害
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统的"社会精英流失"解释，提出了战争物理破坏作为替代解释机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史冲突对经济发展的长期影响提供了新的实证证据，对历史经济研究和政策制定有启示意义

title: Correlational Study of Students' Achievement in Educational Research Methodology and Performance in Project Work in F.C.E Okene, Kogi State
affiliations: and Federal College of Education Okene

detail.title: Correlational Study of Students' Achievement in Educational Research Methodology and Performance in Project Work in F.C.E Okene, Kogi State
detail.abstract: Undergraduates are taught research in education as a course to sensitize the students with the research methods in education. The knowledge obtained is expected to be applied in the undergraduate students' project report. Thus, this study examined the correlation between the students' project work scores and their achievement scores in educational research methods and statistics. The study adopted correlational design. The population for the study comprised all the students from 2008 to 2019 academic session of Federal College of Education, Okene, Kogi State of Nigeria, affiliates of University of Ibadan, Oyo State of Nigeria. Purposively, 560 students from the Guidance and Counselling department were selected for the research, and the data used in the study came from their test results. The research instrument consists of the secondary source of the scores in educational research methodology and scores in the students' project work. The reliability of the instrument was established using Kuder-Richardson and the index was 0.74. Data collected were analyzed with SPSS using Pearson Moment Correlation analysis and Simple regression analysis. The results indicated low positive (0.167) and direct interaction between the independent and dependent variables; and that students' achievement in educational research methodology contributed significantly (2.6%) to the students' performance in project work. Recommendations were also highlighted.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了教育研究方法成绩与项目工作成绩之间的相关性，发现两者存在低度正相关关系（0.167），教育研究方法成绩仅能解释项目工作成绩变异的2.6%。
AI.research_question: 学生的项目工作成绩与教育研究方法和统计学成绩之间是否存在相关性？
AI.motivation: 本科生学习教育研究课程是为了让他们熟悉教育研究方法，期望这些知识能应用于本科生的项目报告中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相关性研究设计框架，关注变量间的统计关系。
AI.method: 采用相关性研究设计，从尼日利亚联邦教育学院指导与咨询系2008-2019学年中抽取560名学生，使用二手数据（教育研究方法成绩和项目工作成绩），通过Kuder-Richardson检验信度（0.74），使用SPSS进行皮尔逊相关分析和简单回归分析。
AI.findings: 独立变量与因变量之间存在低度正相关（0.167）和直接交互作用；学生在教育研究方法方面的成绩对其项目工作表现有显著贡献（2.6%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了教育研究方法课程学习与实际研究应用之间的关联性，但发现这种关联相对较弱。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构改进研究方法课程教学提供了实证依据，建议需要加强理论与实践的结合。

title: The Neighbourhood Store -Seeking Bigger Basket Sizes
affiliations: Independent and FLAME University

detail.title: The Neighbourhood Store -Seeking Bigger Basket Sizes
detail.abstract: India's modern retail market stood at US Dollar (USD) 27 billion in 2012 and is expected to grow to USD 220 billion by 2020, with a Compounded Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 14.9% (FICCI, 2012). Though food and grocery comprises 60% of the total retail sales, it contributes to only about 11% of the modern retail sales (IBEF, 2013). Supermarkets comprise 70% of the total modern grocery retailing formats in India (Bose, 2012). Despite this, not all supermarkets perform well. For instance in Hyderabad, while few regional supermarket chains such as Ratnadeep, Ghanshyam have added more outlets, few national supermarket chains such as Spencer's, Food World have closed down or relocated few of their stores (Mukherjee, 2012). In 2012, Mr. Narang established a supermarket known as 'Neighbourhood store' in Pune, India. Post three years of full operation, this store was enmeshed in problems due to a poor customer base, low basket sizes and moderate revenue figures. To worsen matters, high rent expenditure and high cost stuck in inventory took a toll on the business. Against this backdrop, competitors such as SMart (hypermarket) and Patel stores (a small mom and pop 'kirana' store) flourished. The case includes data that can trigger off rich classroom discussions about a) Comparative analysis of Neighbourhood Store with its direct competitors-SMart and Patel stores-in terms of performance, merchandise mix, and service offerings, b) Analysis of the Neighbourhood Store's key customer profiles and finding the reason for their not shopping the entire grocery basket from the Store c) Recommending changes in the merchandise mix and the service offerings at the Neighbourhood Store in order to increase the basket sizes of each of the Store's customer segments.

AI.tldr: 该案例研究分析了印度浦那一家名为'邻里商店'的超市在运营三年后面临的困境，包括客户基础薄弱、购物篮规模小、收入中等，以及高租金和高库存成本问题。通过与竞争对手SMart（大型超市）和Patel商店（小型杂货店）的比较分析，探讨如何通过调整商品组合和服务来提高客户购物篮规模。
AI.research_question: 为什么邻里商店在竞争激烈的印度零售市场中表现不佳？如何通过调整商品组合和服务来提高其客户购物篮规模？
AI.motivation: 印度现代零售市场快速增长，但并非所有超市都能成功。邻里商店面临客户基础薄弱、购物篮规模小、收入中等的问题，同时面临来自大型超市和小型杂货店的激烈竞争。
AI.theoretical_framework: 零售管理理论、竞争分析框架、客户细分理论、商品组合优化理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，包括对邻里商店及其竞争对手SMart和Patel商店的比较分析，以及客户行为分析
AI.findings: 邻里商店在商品组合和服务提供方面存在不足，无法满足不同客户群体的需求，导致客户只购买部分商品而非整个购物篮
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场中的中小型零售企业提供了竞争策略框架，特别是在面对大型零售商和小型传统商店双重竞争时的生存策略
AI.practical_contributions: 为邻里商店提供了具体的商品组合调整建议和服务改进方案，帮助提高客户购物篮规模和整体盈利能力

title: The Goal Setting and Planning Framework - B Planning

detail.title: The Goal Setting and Planning Framework - B Planning
detail.abstract:
The Behnam Behzadifar Goal Setting Framework is an innovative and practical methodology designed to help individuals and organizations achieve their objectives efficiently and systematically. Developed based on over 16 years of experience in strategy, customer experience, and performance management, this framework provides a step-by-step process to:

  • Define clear, measurable goals aligned with personal or organizational priorities

  • Break down complex objectives into actionable tasks

  • Monitor progress and adjust actions dynamically

  • Enhance motivation, focus, and accountability throughout the goal achievement journey

The framework is versatile and scalable, suitable for use by individuals, teams, and organizations of all sizes, from simple personal planning to structured corporate goal management. It combines practical exercises, checklists, and structured feedback loops to ensure that goals are not only set but also effectively achieved.

By publishing this framework on Zenodo, the author ensures official documentation and ownership, making it accessible to educators, professionals, and researchers worldwide.

AI.tldr: Behnam Behzadifar目标设定框架是一个基于16年战略、客户体验和绩效管理经验开发的创新方法论，帮助个人和组织系统高效地实现目标。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个系统化的目标设定框架来帮助个人和组织更有效地实现目标？
AI.motivation: 基于16年战略、客户体验和绩效管理实践经验，开发一个实用且可扩展的目标设定方法论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 目标设定理论、绩效管理理论、系统化方法论
AI.method: 基于实践经验的框架开发方法，包括步骤化流程、实用练习、检查表和结构化反馈循环
AI.findings: 开发出了一个包含明确目标定义、任务分解、进度监控和动态调整的完整目标设定框架
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结合目标设定理论和实践经验的综合性框架，丰富了目标管理方法论
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人、团队和组织提供了可操作的目标设定工具，增强动机、专注度和责任感

title: The Ragsdale Framework for Autonomous Organizations: The Story Model
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Ragsdale Framework for Autonomous Organizations: The Story Model

declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted without external funding or institutional sponsorship. It represents the independent scholarly work of Marc Ragsdale and is not commissioned, financed, or owned by Kaamfu Inc. or any affiliated organization. While Kaamfu applies elements of the Framework in practice, the Framework itself is authored and maintained independently, and all rights to its theoretical development remain with the author.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Story Model as the narrative layer of the Ragsdale Framework for Autonomous Organizations (RFAO). It formalizes how daily activity is transformed into structured stories that preserve institutional memory, provide context to data, and support real-time insight generation. The Story Model defines stories as structured and compact representations of organizational activity that allow both human and artificial intelligence to reason without returning to the raw data layer. Like a cache in computing, these summaries give immediate access to the current state of work, reducing delay and enabling instant understanding across time, roles, and functions. Through the continuous creation of daily stories, organizations maintain a living record of what occurred, why it mattered, and how it evolved. Over time, this archive becomes a coherent institutional memory that connects data with meaning and record with reflection, allowing organizations to understand themselves as they act and to evolve with clarity and continuity.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了故事模型作为Ragsdale自主组织框架的叙事层，将日常活动转化为结构化故事以保存机构记忆、提供数据背景并支持实时洞察生成。
AI.research_question: 如何将组织日常活动转化为结构化故事，以支持机构记忆保存和实时洞察生成？
AI.motivation: 解决组织活动中信息碎片化、缺乏上下文和难以形成连贯机构记忆的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ragsdale自主组织框架，故事模型作为叙事层，借鉴计算机缓存概念。
AI.method: 定义故事为结构化、紧凑的组织活动表示，支持人机推理而无需返回原始数据层。
AI.findings: 故事模型能够有效保存机构记忆，提供数据背景，支持实时洞察，减少延迟，实现跨时间、角色和功能的即时理解。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了故事模型作为组织叙事层的理论框架，将日常活动系统性地转化为结构化故事。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了持续创建日常故事的方法，建立活态记录，连接数据与意义，支持组织在行动中自我理解并持续进化。

title: Algorithmic Time and the Discipline of Digital Capitalism

detail.title: Algorithmic Time and the Discipline of Digital Capitalism

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) received no financial support for the research, authorship and/or publication of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: The author(s) received no financial support for the research, authorship and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract:
This study diagnoses the structural failure of John Maynard Keynes's 15-hour workweek prophecy, arguing that technological time savings have been systematically reclaimed by capital through novel mechanisms of temporal appropriation. Theoretical triangulation—spanning Marx's surplus value, Foucault's discipline, Deleuze's control, and Han's psychopolitics—reveals a shift in capital’s target towards colonizing cognitive recovery time. Longitudinal data (1980–2024) confirms a historic decoupling between productivity growth and working-hour reduction (OECD, 2024; ILO, 2024).

The analysis introduces three core political economy mechanisms: Financialized Time Collateralization (FTC), where systemic debt mortgages workers' future labor time as long-term collateral; The Algorithmic Political Economy (APE), a techno-governance system extending capital's power through real-time modulation and data rent extraction; and Survival Time Colonization (STC), capturing necessity-driven time appropriation in the Global South. Through comparative analysis, the paper reveals glocalized forms of digital time discipline—from credit-driven burnout and hyper-competitive involution to acute time poverty.

The paper concludes that the struggle for Temporal Sovereignty has become the defining political challenge against capital's total capture of human time. By conceptualizing time itself as a communicative infrastructure of control, this article contributes a critical framework for understanding the political economy of digital capitalism.

AI.tldr: 该研究诊断了凯恩斯15小时工作周预言的失败，指出技术节省的时间被资本通过新的时间占用机制系统性地重新占有。理论分析揭示了资本目标转向殖民认知恢复时间，实证数据证实了生产率增长与工作时间减少的历史性脱钩。
AI.research_question: 为什么技术发展带来的时间节省没有实现凯恩斯预言的15小时工作周？资本通过哪些新机制重新占有技术节省的时间？
AI.motivation: 理解凯恩斯工作周预言失败的根本原因，揭示当代资本主义如何通过新型时间占用机制维持和强化工作时间制度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克思的剩余价值理论、福柯的规训理论、德勒兹的控制社会和韩炳哲的精神政治学，形成理论三角分析框架。
AI.method: 理论三角分析结合1980-2024年的纵向数据比较分析，涵盖OECD和ILO数据。
AI.findings: 识别出三个核心政治经济机制：金融化时间抵押、算法政治经济和生存时间殖民，揭示了数字时间规训的全球化形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了时间作为控制的基础设施的概念框架，为理解数字资本主义政治经济学提供了批判性分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了时间主权斗争作为当代政治挑战的重要性，为理解数字时代劳动时间问题提供了实践启示。

title: 시공간 암흑물질 중력자 블랙홀의 카르마 프랙탈 인과론(KFC)기반 수학적 정의와 의미 (Mathematical Definition and Significance of Spacetime Dark Matter Graviton and Black Holes based on Karma Fractal Causality KFC)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: 시공간 암흑물질 중력자 블랙홀의 카르마 프랙탈 인과론(KFC)기반 수학적 정의와 의미 (Mathematical Definition and Significance of Spacetime Dark Matter Graviton and Black Holes based on Karma Fractal Causality KFC)
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a new paradigm, Karma Fractal Causality (KFC), which asserts that all cosmic structures and phenomena are inevitably induced by a single principle: the Least Action Efficiency (ETA LA). KFC coherently integrates and explains phenomena-including the extreme boundaries of spacetime (ρ max and ρ min gravity densities), the causal symmetry between fusion and black holes, the existence of Dark Matter, and the inherent limits of human perception-by minimizing Causal Inconsistency Noise (N MIS), while encompassing existing General Relativity. We mathematically demonstrate that ETA LA self-regulates the structure of spacetime to maintain Causal Integrity (CI), inevitably leading to the ρ min boundary where coordinates and spacetime itself are dissolved. [Advisory] To understand the advanced mathematical modeling presented in this paper, prerequisite knowledge of the fundamental concepts of Karma Fractal Causal Theory is essential. For related concepts, please prioritize consulting the preceding literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Karma Fractal Causality (KFC)新范式，认为所有宇宙结构和现象都由单一原理——最小作用效率(ETA LA)诱导产生。KFC整合解释了时空极端边界、融合与黑洞的因果对称性、暗物质存在等，通过最小化因果不一致噪声来维持因果完整性。
AI.research_question: 宇宙结构和现象是否由单一的最小作用效率原理统一诱导？
AI.motivation: 整合和解释包括时空极端边界、黑洞与融合的因果对称性、暗物质等宇宙现象，构建统一的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Karma Fractal Causality (KFC)理论框架，基于最小作用效率(ETA LA)原理和因果完整性(CI)概念。
AI.method: 数学建模和推导，证明ETA LA如何自我调节时空结构以维持因果完整性。
AI.findings: ETA LA确实能够自我调节时空结构，导致时空坐标在ρ min边界处溶解，维持因果完整性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一解释宇宙现象的KFC新范式，将广义相对论纳入其中，建立了最小作用效率与因果完整性的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解宇宙极端现象（如黑洞、暗物质）提供了新的理论视角，可能对宇宙学研究和基础物理理论发展产生影响。

title: Mengukur Etika Kerja Sales Telemarketing: Studi Kasus Pelanggaran Privasi dan Frekuensi Kontak Berulang (Measuring the Work Ethics of Telemarketing Sales: A Case Study on Privacy Violations and Repeated Contact Frequency)

detail.title: Mengukur Etika Kerja Sales Telemarketing: Studi Kasus Pelanggaran Privasi dan Frekuensi Kontak Berulang (Measuring the Work Ethics of Telemarketing Sales: A Case Study on Privacy Violations and Repeated Contact Frequency)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or professional relationships with individuals, organizations, or companies that could have influenced or be perceived to have influenced the outcomes, analyses, or interpretations of this study. The research was conducted independently, and the findings reflect objective assessment without any external pressures or conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was conducted as a qualitative case study involving interviews with sales and customers. Written informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to data collection. Ethical guidelines for research with human participants were followed throughout the study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently by the author and did not receive funding from any organization, institution, or external source.

detail.abstract:
Indonesian Abstract: Telemarketing merupakan strategi pemasaran yang efektif untuk menjangkau pelanggan secara langsung dan membangun interaksi personal. Namun, praktik yang tidak etis-seperti menghubungi pelanggan tanpa izin, mengirim pesan WhatsApp tanpa persetujuan, melakukan panggilan di luar jam kerja, dan kontak berulang setelah penolakan-dapat menimbulkan konflik etika, mengganggu privasi, dan merusak citra perusahaan. Penelitian ini menggunakan studi kasus kualitatif untuk mengeksplorasi persepsi pelanggan terhadap praktik telemarketing agresif dan dampaknya terhadap pengalaman pelanggan. Data dikumpulkan melalui wawancara mendalam dengan pelanggan dan sales, serta analisis dokumen internal perusahaan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa praktik telemarketing agresif menurunkan kepercayaan, menimbulkan ketidakpuasan, dan berdampak negatif pada loyalitas serta citra perusahaan. Penelitian ini menekankan perlunya pedoman etika yang jelas, pelatihan sales, dan kebijakan perlindungan data pelanggan. Temuan ini memberikan rekomendasi praktis bagi perusahaan agar dapat menjalankan telemarketing secara efektif sekaligus menghormati hak konsumen, sekaligus membuka peluang bagi studi lanjutan untuk menilai implementasi etika dalam telemarketing.

English Abstract: Telemarketing is an effective marketing strategy for reaching customers directly and fostering personal interactions. However, unethical practices—such as contacting customers without consent, sending WhatsApp messages without approval, making calls outside working hours, and repeated contact after refusal—can lead to ethical conflicts, invade privacy, and damage the company’s reputation. This study employs a qualitative case study approach to explore customer perceptions of aggressive telemarketing practices and their impact on customer experiences. Data were collected through in-depth interviews with both customers and sales representatives, as well as analysis of internal company documents. The findings indicate that aggressive telemarketing practices reduce trust, cause dissatisfaction, and negatively affect customer loyalty and company image. The study highlights the need for clear ethical guidelines, sales training, and customer data protection policies. These findings provide practical recommendations for companies to conduct telemarketing effectively while respecting consumer rights, and open avenues for further research to evaluate the implementation of ethics in telemarketing.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了激进电话营销实践对客户体验的负面影响，发现不道德的电话营销行为会降低客户信任、导致不满，并损害公司形象和客户忠诚度。研究强调需要明确的道德准则、销售培训和客户数据保护政策。
AI.research_question: 客户对激进电话营销实践的感知如何影响客户体验？
AI.motivation: 电话营销是有效的直接营销策略，但不道德实践（如未经同意联系客户、工作时间外致电、拒绝后重复联系）会导致道德冲突、侵犯隐私并损害公司声誉。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户体验理论、道德营销理论、客户信任与忠诚度理论
AI.method: 定性案例研究，通过深度访谈（客户和销售代表）以及公司内部文件分析收集数据
AI.findings: 激进的电话营销实践会降低客户信任、导致不满，并对客户忠诚度和公司形象产生负面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了电话营销道德实践的理论理解，为营销伦理和客户体验研究提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了实用的建议，包括制定明确的道德准则、加强销售培训、完善客户数据保护政策，帮助企业在有效开展电话营销的同时尊重消费者权利

title: From Labyrinth to Resonance: A Theoretical Framework for Leadership Development
affiliations: Applied Organisational Philosopher

detail.title: From Labyrinth to Resonance: A Theoretical Framework for Leadership Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract:
Purpose: This paper addresses the persistent "efficacy paradox" in leadership development (LD) - why hundreds of billions of dollars in annual spending yields minimal measurable impact-by proposing that failure is a systemic architectural problem rather than a programmatic one. 

Design/Methodology: I introduce the Industrial Operating System (IOS) as a heuristic construct for the dominant institutional logic that neutralises LD interventions. I propose: (1) a testable four-quadrant Typology of Organisational Dysfunction, (2) a three-phase Diagnostic-Led Evolutionary Change methodology, and (3) a new pedagogical framework centered on Organoplasticity and three meta-disciplines for the Age of Hybrid Intelligence. 

Findings: Rather than failing due to poor program design, LD fails because it operates within unreformed systems optimised for 20th-century industrial logic. I demonstrate how "best-in-class" principles are systematically co-opted into an "elegant cage". 

Practical Implications: The framework provides CHROs and senior leaders with diagnostic tools to measure the "Dissonance Tax", identify organisational dysfunction type, and design phased evolutionary interventions with measurable returns across human, social, intellectual, and financial capital. 

Originality/Value: This is the first framework to integrate institutional logics theory, organisational neuroscience, and hybrid intelligence pedagogy into a falsifiable model for systemic LD transformation. It repositions LD as the organisation's primary organoplastic mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出领导力发展存在'效能悖论'，即巨额投入却收效甚微，原因是系统架构问题而非项目设计问题。作者引入工业操作系统概念，提出组织功能障碍类型学、诊断导向的进化变革方法，以及面向混合智能时代的新教学框架。
AI.research_question: 为什么领导力发展项目投入巨大却效果有限？如何解决这一'效能悖论'？
AI.motivation: 领导力发展每年投入数千亿美元，但可衡量的影响微乎其微，需要从系统层面而非项目层面寻找根本原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度逻辑理论、组织神经科学、混合智能教育学、工业操作系统概念、组织可塑性理论
AI.method: 提出可测试的四象限组织功能障碍类型学、三阶段诊断导向进化变革方法、以组织可塑性和三个元学科为中心的新教学框架
AI.findings: 领导力发展失败不是因为项目设计差，而是因为在未改革的、为20世纪工业逻辑优化的系统中运作。'最佳实践'原则被系统性地纳入'优雅的牢笼'。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将制度逻辑理论、组织神经科学和混合智能教育学整合到一个可证伪的系统性领导力发展转型模型中，将领导力发展重新定位为组织的主要可塑性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CHRO和高级领导者提供诊断工具，测量'失调税'，识别组织功能障碍类型，设计分阶段进化干预措施，在人力、社会、智力和金融资本方面获得可衡量的回报。

title: Government Spending and Civic Engagement: Exploring the Role of Civil Society Participation and Voting in 28 Democracies
affiliations: University of Turin and University of Urbino Carlo Bo

detail.title: Government Spending and Civic Engagement: Exploring the Role of Civil Society Participation and Voting in 28 Democracies

declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This study offers causal evidence on how distinct forms of civic engagement affect government spending across 28 democracies between 2000 and 2024. Its main innovation lies in disentangling the fiscal effects of two channels of engagement-civil society participation and electoral turnout-through an original identification strategy that exploits exogenous variation in collective versus self-interested motives. Our findings reveal that civic engagement exerts distinct effects on public spending depending on the channel through which citizens participate in democratic life. On the one hand, stronger participation in civil society associations leads to higher government spending, consistent with a publicly spirited and collective mobilization effect. On the other hand, greater electoral participation is associated with lower public expenditure, as more collectiveinterested individuals distance themselves from the traditional electoral channel, and more self-interested individuals ask for less public spending. We explore these underlying mechanisms, propose strategies to address key identification challenges, and further consider the impact of public spending on environmental protection and green politics dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析28个民主国家2000-2024年的数据，发现公民参与的不同形式对政府支出产生相反影响：公民社会参与增加政府支出，而选举参与减少政府支出。
AI.research_question: 不同形式的公民参与（公民社会参与vs选举参与）如何影响政府支出？
AI.motivation: 理解公民参与对政府财政政策的因果影响，特别是区分不同参与渠道的异质性效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体利益动机vs自利动机理论框架，分析公民参与的不同渠道对政府支出的差异化影响。
AI.method: 采用识别策略利用集体利益与自利动机的外生变异，分析28个民主国家2000-2024年的面板数据。
AI.findings: 公民社会参与增加政府支出（集体动员效应），选举参与减少政府支出（自利个体要求更少公共支出）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统区分公民参与不同渠道的财政效应，深化对民主参与机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解公民参与对公共财政的影响提供实证依据，有助于优化民主治理策略。

title: Organizational and Economic Aspects of Ensuring Information Security in Logistics Systems
affiliations: North- West Institute of Management-branch of  RANEPA

detail.title: Organizational and Economic Aspects of Ensuring Information Security in Logistics Systems
detail.abstract:
The article discusses issues of ensuring information and economic security as one of the most important qualitative characteristics of logistics systems that determine the ability to ensure the established parameters of material flows in the process of goods distribution when introducing digital systems and technologies. An analysis of modern risks and threats characteristic of the development of digital ecosystems of transport and logistics services is carried out. The key factors for ensuring economic security and their importance in logistics are examined from the point of view of ensuring operational control over compliance with established key indicators of product distribution. The issues of ensuring the parameters of commodity distribution within the established threshold values are touched upon in order to achieve optimal functioning of the commodity distribution system and ensure the economic activity of the enterprise with all the necessary resources. Logistics systems are studied for the effective organization and management of material flows, aimed at ensuring the reliability of operation and implementation of the strategy of economic entities. The necessity of using modern
digital technologies to increase the level of economic security in logistics systems and ensure transparency, controllability and traceability of material flows in the field of commodity distribution is substantiated. At the same time, the very fact of digitalization of cargo delivery processes is considered from the perspective of the ecosystem paradigm and platform concept. The patterns of transformation of traditional logistics operators into providers of digital logistics services are substantiated. A model of a cyber-physical ecosystem in logistics has been developed, providing end-to-end management of business processes and data exchange in the process of goods distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在数字化系统和技术引入过程中，如何确保物流系统的信息和经济安全，以维持物料流的稳定参数。分析了运输和物流服务数字生态系统的现代风险和威胁，提出了确保经济安全的关键因素，并开发了物流中的网络物理生态系统模型。
AI.research_question: 如何在引入数字系统和技术的背景下，确保物流系统的信息和经济安全，以维持物料流的稳定参数？
AI.motivation: 随着数字技术和系统在物流领域的广泛应用，确保信息和经济安全成为维持物流系统稳定运行的关键挑战，需要研究现代风险和威胁，并开发有效的安全保障模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统范式、平台概念、网络物理系统理论、物流安全理论
AI.method: 风险分析、理论建模、生态系统模式分析
AI.findings: 识别了数字物流生态系统中的关键风险和威胁；确定了确保经济安全的关键因素；开发了提供端到端业务流程管理和数据交换的网络物理生态系统模型；揭示了传统物流运营商向数字物流服务提供商转型的模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了物流网络物理生态系统模型；发展了基于生态系统范式的物流安全理论框架；丰富了数字物流转型的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为物流企业提供了确保信息和经济安全的实用指导；开发的生态系统模型可提高物流系统的透明度、可控性和可追溯性；为传统物流运营商的数字化转型提供了实践路径。

title: The Pignatelli Costing Framework (PCF): Redefining Productivity and Costing in the Age of AI 1

detail.title: The Pignatelli Costing Framework (PCF): Redefining Productivity and Costing in the Age of AI 1
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Pignatelli Costing Framework (PCF), a conceptual model for redefining productivity and cost attribution in an AI-augmented world. Building upon the principles of Multimodal Productivity Costing (MPC), the framework expands the traditional Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) model to include five categories: human (hFTE), machine (mFTE), human-led AI-augmented (aFTE), machine-directed human execute (dFTE), and human-AI symbiotic (sFTE). This typology enables organisations to capture hybrid productivity contributions across human and machine modalities. The research explores how geometric changes in role design and decision-making between these equivalents influence costing methodologies as organisations transition from Narrow AI to General AI and eventually Super AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Pignatelli成本框架（PCF），这是一个在AI增强世界中重新定义生产力和成本归属的概念模型。该框架基于多模态生产力成本核算（MPC）原则，将传统的全职等效（FTE）模型扩展为五个类别：人类（hFTE）、机器（mFTE）、人类主导AI增强（aFTE）、机器指导人类执行（dFTE）和人类-AI共生（sFTE）。
AI.research_question: 在从窄AI向通用AI和超级AI过渡的过程中，这些等效类别之间的角色设计和决策制定的几何变化如何影响成本核算方法？
AI.motivation: 传统FTE模型无法充分捕捉AI增强世界中人类和机器混合生产力贡献，需要新的成本归属框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态生产力成本核算（MPC）原则，扩展传统FTE模型
AI.method: 概念模型开发，提出Pignatelli成本框架（PCF）
AI.findings: PCF框架能够通过五个FTE类别（hFTE、mFTE、aFTE、dFTE、sFTE）有效捕捉人类和机器混合生产力贡献
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个在AI增强世界中重新定义生产力和成本归属的新概念框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在AI转型过程中提供了实用的成本核算工具，帮助理解和管理混合生产力贡献

title: Impacts of Social Entrepreneurial Constructs and the Moderating Role of Social Entrepreneurs on Sustainability of Corporate Organizations in Nigeria in Pre and Post COVID 19 Pandemics
affiliations: Caleb University, Department of Business Administration

detail.title: Impacts of Social Entrepreneurial Constructs and the Moderating Role of Social Entrepreneurs on Sustainability of Corporate Organizations in Nigeria in Pre and Post COVID 19 Pandemics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

publicationDetails.detailsText: Unizik Journal of Entrepreneurship (ENTREP) Vol.6, No.1, 2025

detail.abstract: Social entrepreneurship (SE) has been significantly recognised to be the solution to worsening global pandemic, social issues and economic crises, which were caused by the pre and post era COVID 19 pandemics. The study determined the impacts of social entrepreneurial constructs and the moderating role of social entrepreneurs on sustainability of corporate organizations in Nigeria in pre and post Covid 19 pandemic. Five alternative hypotheses guided the study and were tested at 0.05 level of significance. A descriptive longitudinal-survey research design was utilised in this study. The population of the study comprises of 97,091 Nano, micro, small and medium scale enterprise in Lagos state (NMSMEs) in Lagos State, Nigeria. Random sampling and purposive sampling techniques was employed and a sample size of 146 and 140 of social entrepreneurs was derived during pre and post pandemic. Survey Online Google form of questionnaire distribution was used as instrument administration and data collection for the study. The instrument reliability was assessed with Cronbach's Alpha reliability test of .70. Hence, the data collected was analysed using Partial least square structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM). The analysis of the results showed that SEF, EEF, BEF and GEF has significant impact on sustainability during the pre-covid pandemic. The study also revealed that EES does not impact significantly on sustainability and social entrepreneurs have a significant role to play in the sustainability of NMSMEs.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了社会创业构建对尼日利亚企业可持续性的影响，以及社会企业家在新冠疫情前后的调节作用。研究发现社会创业框架、环境创业框架、商业创业框架和政府创业框架对可持续性有显著影响，而环境创业支持影响不显著。
AI.research_question: 社会创业构建对尼日利亚企业可持续性的影响是什么？社会企业家在新冠疫情前后如何调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 社会创业被认为是解决全球疫情、社会问题和经济危机的重要方案，特别是在新冠疫情前后时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会创业理论、可持续性理论、创业框架理论
AI.method: 描述性纵向调查研究设计，使用随机抽样和目的性抽样，样本规模为146（疫情前）和140（疫情后）名社会企业家，采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析数据。
AI.findings: 社会创业框架、环境创业框架、商业创业框架和政府创业框架在疫情前对可持续性有显著影响；环境创业支持对可持续性影响不显著；社会企业家在NMSMEs可持续性中发挥重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了社会创业理论在危机情境下的应用，验证了不同创业框架对可持续性的影响差异。

detail.abstract: The article discusses the issues of ensuring economic security in the context of the introduction of digital technologies in the activities of enterprises and organi-zations and analyzes the various risks and threats associated with this process. Materials and methods. The main tasks associated with the development and implementation of modern digital technologies and stimulating the innovative development of organizations from the standpoint of active development of the digital economy are studied. Research results. Emphasis is placed on the fact that at present, issues of studying the influence of the effects of the digital economy and directions for neutralizing its risks and threats are considered not only at the state level, but also at the level of individual economic entities. The need to introduce digital economy tools at the micro level is substantiated in terms of increasing the competitiveness of enterprises and organi-zations, which allows increasing the speed of customer service, increasing the efficiency of the goods distribution process and providing a wide range of related services, which, in turn, is the key to the organization's demand in the market and ensures the necessary level of economic se-curity. At the same time, in relation to modern economic conditions, the digital economy is con-sidered not only as one of the factors for strengthening and ensuring the economic security of enterprises and organizations, but also as a subsystem of their digital security, which is an inte-gral element of the comprehensive security of an economic entity, which, in addition, includes personnel, information, technical and technological, legal, environmental and other types of se-curity. Discussion and conclusion. The essence and content of modern digital risks and threats are studied, and they are systematized according to a number of classification features, including by type of risk, by level of occurrence, by probability of risk occurrence, by rate of risk increase, by duration of impact, by degree of loss from risk impact. Attention is paid to the specifics of using digital security tools of organizations.

title: Iron Ladies: Asia's Female Leaders

detail.title: Iron Ladies: Asia's Female Leaders
detail.abstract:
When the conservative-leaning Sanae Takaichi became the first female Prime Minister in Japanese history in October 2025, the parallels between Takaichi and Margaret Thatcher were all too easy to draw. Takaichi herself embraced Thatcher as a role model, and she reportedly admires Thatcher’s “strong character and convictions” as well as “womanly warmth.” Like Thatcher, Takaichi’s relatively humble background as the daughter of a police officer and car company employee stands out given that her political party is studded with the descendants of Japanese political dynasties. Takaichi is also similar to Thatcher in that she is a social
conservative who is skeptical of same-sex marriage and of allowing married women to keep their maiden names. But Takaichi is in fact the exception to the rule for female leaders in Asia, whose political views tend to be scattered across the political spectrum. Instead, what unifies most Asian female leaders is their membership in political dynasties, either hereditary or party-based (with Takaichi being an example of the latter). Thus, it is premature to make inferences about the state of gender equality or politics in Asia from Takaichi's victory.

title: The Double-Edged Role of Direct Selling in Food Waste Reduction under Yield Uncertainty
affiliations: University of Miami - Department of Management and University of Miami - Department of Management

detail.title: The Double-Edged Role of Direct Selling in Food Waste Reduction under Yield Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Food waste is a pressing global challenge. Agri-food supply chains in particular often generate losses at the production stage due to yield uncertainty, demand mismatches, and strategic interactions between channel partners. We develop an analytical model with an upstream farmer and a downstream retailer to study how a farmer's use of a direct selling channel (farmer encroachment) and the timing of the commitment (to direct selling) affect equilibrium production, profits, and food waste. Four scenarios are examined, namely, no direct channel, ex ante commitment (before yield realizes), ex post commitment (after yield realizes), and contingent commitment (at the time of order placement); these scenarios represent settings from long-term planning to agile, platform-enabled sales. We also incorporate farmer and retailer environmental awareness, modeled as disutility from food waste, to assess its influence on operational and environmental outcomes. The impact of direct selling on waste hinges on the balance between a sales expansion effect (diverting unsold produce to consumers directly) and an overproduction effect (incentivizing higher supply). Under ex ante commitment, overproduction dominates, raising waste, while under ex post and contingent commitment, the net effect depends on production and direct selling costs. In addition, commitment timing matters. Shifting from ex ante to ex post generally lowers waste, but delaying commitment further (to contingent commitment) increases it due to retailer's strategic underordering. When incorporating environmental awareness into the farmer's and the retailer's objectives, respectively, we find that farmer awareness consistently reduces waste, whereas retailer awareness may increase it. These findings caution that direct selling and flexibility are not inherently waste-reducing, and that governance of commitment timing, cost structure, and awareness incentives is critical to reducing food waste and realizing environmental gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了农业食品供应链中农民直销渠道的使用和承诺时机对均衡生产、利润和食物浪费的影响。研究发现，直销对浪费的影响取决于销售扩张效应和过度生产效应的平衡。事前承诺会增加浪费，而事后和或有承诺的效果取决于成本结构。农民环境意识能减少浪费，但零售商环境意识可能增加浪费。
AI.research_question: 农民直销渠道的使用和承诺时机如何影响农业食品供应链中的均衡生产、利润和食物浪费？
AI.motivation: 食物浪费是全球紧迫挑战，农业食品供应链在生产阶段因产量不确定性、需求不匹配和渠道伙伴间的战略互动而产生损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于上游农民和下游零售商的分析模型，研究直销渠道和承诺时机的战略互动效应。
AI.method: 开发分析模型，考察四种情景：无直销渠道、事前承诺、事后承诺、或有承诺，并纳入农民和零售商的环境意识。
AI.findings: 1) 事前承诺下过度生产效应主导，增加浪费；2) 事后和或有承诺的净效应取决于生产和直销成本；3) 从事前转向事后承诺一般降低浪费，但进一步延迟到或有承诺会增加浪费；4) 农民环境意识减少浪费，零售商环境意识可能增加浪费。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了直销渠道和承诺时机对食物浪费的复杂影响机制，挑战了直销和灵活性必然减少浪费的直觉。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业食品供应链管理者提供了关于承诺时机治理、成本结构和环境意识激励的关键见解，以有效减少食物浪费。

title: Governance & Governments: The Effects of Shareholder Engagement and Climate Laws on Firm CO2 Emissions Performance
affiliations: , University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and University of Pennsylvania - Management Department

detail.title: Governance & Governments: The Effects of Shareholder Engagement and Climate Laws on Firm CO2 Emissions Performance

publicationDetails.journalName: Northeastern University D'Amore-McKim School of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the combined effects of shareholder engagement—supported by the Climate Action 100+ (CA100+) initiative—and governmental climate regulation on firms’ carbon emissions performance. Our theory and findings support the standalone effects of firms’ responses to normative investor pressure and mandatory coercive pressure from climate regulation. Notably, we find that these two forms of pressure are complementary, with firms facing both shareholder engagement and climate regulation reducing their subsequent emissions intensity on average, which we can attribute to countries where the rule of law is weaker. Furthermore, we test and find supportive evidence for mimetic spillover effects arising from board ties between firms engaged by CA100+ and connected non-engaged firms in the presence of greater government climate regulation. By demonstrating the additive effects of these different sources of institutional pressure on firms’ environmental impacts, we contribute to the corporate governance and stakeholder literatures, while also recognizing the complexity of pressures faced by firms and the interrelationships between actors that are key contributors to climate-related challenges and solutions.

title: The New Marketing Mix in the Digital Age: Introducing the 8E Model

detail.title: The New Marketing Mix in the Digital Age: Introducing the 8E Model
detail.abstract: This paper proposes the 8E marketing mix model as an innovative framework for marketing in the digital age, addressing limitations of traditional models like the 4P and 4C. Unlike the classic focus on product, price, promotion, and place, the 8E model centers on consumer experience and digital transformation dynamics. It replaces products and services with experience and entertainment; price with effort and exchange; promotion with emotions and expression; and place with every time and everywhere access. This paradigm shift reflects the new consumer reality where value is shaped by memorable experiences, emotional engagement, and seamless omnichannel availability. The model recognizes that digital consumers evaluate cost beyond monetary price, factoring in time, effort, and personal data exchange. Communication evolves from one-way promotion to interactive emotional expression, where brands engage in authentic dialogue and support consumer self-expression. The model also emphasizes continuous access across all channels, underscoring the necessity of integrating physical and digital platforms. By framing consumers as active participants in marketing ecosystems, the 8E model offers a robust, consumer-centric approach for research and practice in contemporary marketing. It equips businesses to better navigate digital transformation, fostering connections that drive loyalty and sustainable growth in an era defined by rapid technological and societal change.

title: Optimizing Task Generation and Assignment in Crowdpicking
affiliations: Koç University and Koc University

detail.title: Optimizing Task Generation and Assignment in Crowdpicking

declarations.funderStatement: This study has been supported by the European Research Council (ERC) under grant number 101076231 as a part of the GoodMobility project (https://goodmobility.ku.edu.tr).

detail.abstract: As omnichannel operations become increasingly important for meeting diverse customer expectations in retail, continuous innovation in service and business models is essential to maintain a competitive edge. While effective order fulfillment is key to omnichannel success, the manual picking process in physical stores, one of the major driver of fulfillment costs, still offers substantial opportunities for improvement. This paper focuses on the crowdpicking model as an innovative approach to manage online order picking operations in physical stores by leveraging existing in-store customers, offering a business model with considerable potential. We explore the real-time assignment of orders to in-store customers using ML to identify effective assignment policies. These policies are combined with a task-decomposition strategy to reduce picking costs and enhance crowdpicker participation as a key resource. The proposed crowdpicking model and its real-time management framework are tested on real-world data. Our results show that a well-managed crowdpicking system can lower order picking costs by more than 20% and provide actionable insights for managers in designing such systems.

title: The Machiavellian Evolution of Marketing Thought: A Comparative Framework Analyzing Kotler, Ries, Trout, Godin, Greene, and Stone

detail.title: The Machiavellian Evolution of Marketing Thought: A Comparative Framework Analyzing Kotler, Ries, Trout, Godin, Greene, and Stone

keywords: the 23 laws of marketing master them or die

detail.abstract: This paper examines the evolution of modern marketing thought through a comparative analysis of six influential figures: Philip Kotler, Al Ries, Jack Trout, Seth Godin, Robert Greene, and Hadrian Stone. The study argues that marketing's progression can be understood as a gradual shift from persuasive communication to behavioral orchestration, and evolution aligning with a Machiavellian model of influence. By tracing the intellectual lineage between structural, psychological, and power-based approaches, the paper introduces the Machiavellian Marketing Framework (MMF), a model that interprets marketing as the strategic design of perception, emotion, and behavior. The framework synthesizes Kotler's managerial rigor, Ries and Trout's positioning logic, Godin's tribal engagement, Greene's power dynamics, and Stone's behavioral codification to reveal a unified philosophy of influence. The paper concludes with implications for educators and practitioners operating in AI-driven, attention-scarce markets.

title: An Industry Report on Legal Services in India from a Competition Law Perspective
affiliations: O. P. Jindal Global University, Jindal Global Law School (JGLS) and O. P. Jindal Global University, Jindal Global Law School (JGLS)

detail.title: An Industry Report on Legal Services in India from a Competition Law Perspective
detail.abstract: This report examines the legal services industry in India through the lens of competition law. It defines the relevant product and geographic markets, identifying the industry as fragmented at the individual practitioner level and moderately concentrated in the corporate segment. The analysis finds that no single firm holds a dominant position due to strong client bargaining power, high fragmentation, and low entry barriers. The report evaluates how existing regulations—such as prohibitions on advertising, multidisciplinary partnerships, and restrictions on foreign law firms—affect competition by limiting innovation and market access. It also identifies factors like professional conduct rules, poaching, and client choice that help prevent anti-competitive behaviour. Further, the report highlights potential concerns such as non-compete clauses, fee schedules, and increasing mergers, which may influence future market dynamics. The findings suggest that while regulation ensures professional integrity, reforms are needed to improve competitiveness and efficiency in India’s legal services market.

title: From Guns to Chips: How the War in Ukraine Accelerated the Digital Transformation of Poland's Defense Industry
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: From Guns to Chips: How the War in Ukraine Accelerated the Digital Transformation of Poland's Defense Industry
detail.abstract:
This study examines how the war in Ukraine has acted as an exogenous shock accelerating digital transformation and innovation within Poland’s defense industry. Building on the Crisis-Driven Innovation Theory, the paper investigates whether wartime pressure reshaped firm-level strategies and investment behaviors. Using a mixed-method design, the research combines quantitative panel data (2020–2024) from four major Polish defense firms—PGZ, WB Group, Mesko, and HSW—with text-based analytics derived from press releases, industry reports, and open databases such as EMIS, Eurostat, and SIPRI.

An OLS regression and independent-sample t-tests were conducted to analyze pre- and post-war changes in innovation activity, proxied by R&D investment ratios, collaboration intensity, and digital engagement levels. Results show that while the average R&D ratio increased by roughly 30% after the war, the change was not statistically significant in the short term. However, qualitative evidence and regression trends suggest a gradual shift toward digital technologies and collaborative innovation models. Larger state-owned firms exhibited lower innovation intensity, while smaller private companies demonstrated greater adaptability and investment responsiveness.

These findings indicate that war does not automatically increase innovation expenditure but instead acts as a catalyst for structural digital transformation. The study contributes to management and innovation literature by empirically demonstrating how geopolitical crises reshape industrial innovation ecosystems, providing new insights for both policymakers and defense sector strategists.

AI.tldr: 乌克兰战争作为外生冲击加速了波兰国防工业的数字化转型与创新，但短期内研发投入增长不显著，主要推动结构性数字转型而非自动增加创新支出。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰战争如何作为外生冲击加速波兰国防工业的数字化转型与创新？
AI.motivation: 探讨战时压力是否重塑企业层面的战略和投资行为，基于危机驱动创新理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 危机驱动创新理论（Crisis-Driven Innovation Theory）
AI.method: 混合方法设计：结合波兰四家主要国防企业（PGZ、WB Group、Mesko、HSW）2020-2024年的定量面板数据，以及来自新闻稿、行业报告和EMIS、Eurostat、SIPRI等开放数据库的文本分析。
AI.findings: 战后平均研发比率增长约30%但短期内统计不显著；大型国有企业创新强度较低，小型私营公司适应性更强；战争主要催化结构性数字转型而非自动增加创新支出。
AI.theory_contributions: 为管理和创新文献提供实证证据，展示地缘政治危机如何重塑工业创新生态系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和国防部门战略家提供新见解，理解危机驱动的创新转型模式。

title: Competition Law Enforcement and Sustainability in Developing Countries - Towards a Blueprint?
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Competition Law Enforcement and Sustainability in Developing Countries - Towards a Blueprint?
detail.abstract: Debates on sustainability and competition law have advanced rapidly in high-income jurisdictions, yet less so in developing countries. In developing countries, the focus needs to be broader than the environmental aspects, further highlighting the social and economic dimensions of sustainability. This chapter attempts to outline a blueprint for authorities in developing countries to integrate sustainable development and competition law enforcement. It begins by exploring the context and the specific sustainability and institutional challenges, such as resource constraints, political economy pressures, and the prevalence and policy roles of state-owned or governmentlinked enterprises. It then explores procedural and substantive questions that authorities in developing countries should consider when aiming to integrate sustainability and competition law enforcement. In this regard, the chapter suggests prioritising enforcement in sectors tied to poverty alleviation and essential services (food, water, sanitation, energy, health, and education), and the systematic use of market studies to target high-impact problems. Subsequently, it explores substantive law questions first, how competition authorities can act as guardians of sustainability, then, how they might enable private sustainability efforts. When guarding sustainability through competition law, the 'translation' of sustainability harms into competition harms is crucial. This allows agencies to pursue cartels (including buyer cartels and boycotts), as well as exclusionary and exploitative unilateral conduct. In the cases of IP-related restrictions, the focus will be on laggard, rather than frontier, innovation, as such innovation drives welfare in local markets. The chapter also addresses the competitive effects of environmental and social standards: it highlights the importance of aligning foreign standards with local development needs. Moreover, it emphasises the safeguards for open participation in domestic standard-setting, which can be a tool for using horizontal cooperation to correct market failures while preserving competitive parameters. Finally, it suggests that agencies should assess enforcement outcomes against sustainable development objectives and use advocacy-particularly where state-owned enterprises are central-to minimise distortions while preserving sustainability gains.

AI.tldr: 本文为发展中国家竞争执法机构提供了一个整合可持续发展与竞争法的蓝图，重点关注贫困缓解和基础服务领域，通过将可持续发展损害转化为竞争损害来执行竞争法，同时平衡环境社会标准与本地发展需求。

title: Between Free Press and Fake News: Reimagining Platform Responsibility Under the DSA and the New Code of Conduct on Disinformation in the Age of AI
affiliations: Stockholm University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Between Free Press and Fake News: Reimagining Platform Responsibility Under the DSA and the New Code of Conduct on Disinformation in the Age of AI
detail.abstract: This paper examines the regulation of social platform content under the EU's Digital Services Act (DSA), comparing the regulatory framework for digital platforms with self-regulation systems governing traditional mass media. While platforms and traditional media differplatforms rely on user-generated content and algorithmic curation rather than editorial creation-they increasingly compete for the same advertising revenue under vastly different regulatory regimes. The DSA and the new official 2025 Code of Conduct on Disinformation impose obligations on "very large platforms" to conduct risk assessments, moderate illegal content, and mitigate systemic risks to fundamental rights and democratic processes. Yet, the paper critically evaluates the 2025 Code of Conduct on Disinformation, arguing it remains inadequate compared to the ethical frameworks governing traditional journalism. The Code focuses on ex post moderation rather than establishing positive editorial principles of objectivity, balance, and truthfulness. The author's central thesis is that technological advances in AI and algorithmic moderation now make it feasible for platforms to assume greater editorial responsibility similar to traditional media. Platforms should develop comprehensive ethical guidelines ensuring algorithms provide benevolent, balanced information rather than prioritizing engagementdriven content that promotes disinformation. This would create a level playing field while better protecting democratic values, with immunity provisions reformed to incentivize effective content moderation aligned with principles of human dignity and non-manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了欧盟《数字服务法案》对社交平台的监管与传统媒体的自律体系，认为虽然平台与传统媒体在内容生成方式上不同，但应承担相似的编辑责任。作者主张平台应制定全面的伦理准则，确保算法提供平衡信息而非优先推送促进虚假信息的参与驱动内容。
AI.research_question: 在欧盟《数字服务法案》框架下，社交平台内容监管与传统媒体自律体系的比较及其对民主价值观的影响是什么？

title: Antitrust's Consumer Tradeoffs
affiliations: Yeshiva University - Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law

detail.title: Antitrust's Consumer Tradeoffs
detail.abstract: In modern antitrust law, courts are required to ask only one question: does the challenged action harm consumers? This Article asks a different question: which consumers? Over the last few decades, the Supreme Court has increasingly required antitrust plaintiffs to prove not only that they were harmed, but also that their harm outweighed any other consumers’ gains. The doctrine forces courts to pit groups of consumers against each other. In Amex, it was merchants against credit card holders. In Brooke Group, it was consumers buying a product during predation against consumers buying it during recoupment. In cases involving aftermarkets for durable goods, it was sophisticated consumers against less sophisticated consumers. And when it comes to antitrust remedies, it was direct purchasers against indirect purchasers. These tradeoffs follow a pattern: the consumers who lose often are poorer and less powerful than the consumers who win. Consumer tradeoffs like those in Amex and Brooke Group also raise significant barriers to recovery for plaintiffs, even in cases where there is demonstrated consumer harm. And these tradeoffs undermine the democratic appeal of the consumer welfare standard—that everyone’s rights matter equally. This Article shows how courts got into the business of making consumer tradeoffs, how it is harming consumers today, and how to get us out of it.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了现代反垄断法中法院如何在不同消费者群体之间进行权衡的问题，指出这种权衡往往导致弱势消费者群体受损，并提出了解决方案。
AI.research_question: 现代反垄断法中，法院如何在不同的消费者群体之间进行权衡？这种权衡对消费者福利标准产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 当前反垄断法仅关注是否损害消费者整体，但忽视了不同消费者群体之间的利益冲突，导致弱势群体利益受损。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者福利标准、反垄断法理论、消费者群体利益冲突理论
AI.method: 案例分析法和法律文本分析法，通过分析Amex、Brooke Group等典型案例来论证观点
AI.findings: 法院在反垄断案件中经常在不同消费者群体之间进行权衡，且这种权衡往往导致较贫穷和弱势的消费者群体利益受损
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了消费者福利标准在实践中的局限性，提出了关注消费者群体间利益分配的新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断法改革提供了理论依据，建议重新审视消费者权衡的做法，保护弱势消费者群体的权益

title: Digitalization in Public Administration: What Factors Influence Employee Interest?
affiliations: Berlin School of Economics and Law, Berlin School of Economics and Law and Institute for Innovation and Technology (IIT Berlin)

detail.title: Digitalization in Public Administration: What Factors Influence Employee Interest?
detail.abstract: Despite political initiatives, digitizing public administration remains challenging in Germany. This study focuses on public administration employees and their potential interest in digitalization. It also examines the factors that can influence this interest. Based on an online survey of 461 administrative staff, the study reveals a generally positive attitude toward digitalization. Interest in digital support for one's own work is particularly strengthened by the perceived future importance of digitalization, experienced efficiency gains, positive emotions, and self-assessed digital competence. Managers, however, express less interest, while age and gender have no significant influence. The results suggest that digital transformation is hindered less by administrative staff's lack of interest and more by inadequate framework conditions. Finally, ideas for potentially conducive framework conditions are presented.

AI.tldr: 德国公共行政数字化面临挑战，但行政人员对数字化持积极态度。研究发现，对数字化未来重要性的认知、效率提升体验、积极情绪和数字能力评估是影响数字化兴趣的关键因素。管理者兴趣较低，年龄和性别无显著影响。数字化转型的主要障碍是框架条件不足而非员工兴趣缺乏。

title: Lessons from Lewis: Equal Protection and the Constitutional Horizons of State Preemption
affiliations: Boston College - Law School

detail.title: Lessons from Lewis: Equal Protection and the Constitutional Horizons of State Preemption
detail.abstract: This Article analyzes some of the central ramifications of Lewis v. Governor of Alabama, a recent case in which the Eleventh Circuit addressed the constitutional limits of state preemption under the Equal Protection Clause. Situating Lewis within a broader wave of state laws that preempt progressive local regulations—ranging from minimum wage ordinances to anti-discrimination protections—the Article argues that preemption can serve as a vehicle for intentional discrimination when deployed to suppress minority political power. Drawing on the Arlington Heights framework, the Article explores how equal protection analysis can illuminate discriminatory motives behind facially neutral preemption statutes. It revisits questions of intent, structure, and history to assess when preemption laws cross the line from legitimate governance to constitutionally suspect interference with local autonomy. In doing so, it highlights the emerging constitutional horizons of state preemption, emphasizing the need for courts to recognize that formal state supremacy may mask substantive inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Lewis v. Governor of Alabama案的核心影响，探讨州级优先权法律如何可能成为故意歧视的工具，特别是当这些法律被用来压制少数族裔政治权力时。文章运用Arlington Heights分析框架，研究表面中立的优先权法规背后的歧视动机。
AI.research_question: 州级优先权法律在什么情况下会从合法治理转变为宪法上可疑的对地方自治的干涉？
AI.motivation: 针对当前州级法律优先权压制进步地方法规（如最低工资条例和反歧视保护）的趋势，探讨优先权如何可能成为故意歧视的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: Arlington Heights分析框架，用于识别表面中立法规背后的歧视动机；平等保护条款分析。
AI.method: 法律案例分析，特别是Lewis v. Governor of Alabama案；运用意图、结构和历史分析来评估优先权法律的合宪性。
AI.findings: 优先权法律可能成为压制少数族裔政治权力的工具；形式上的州级至上可能掩盖实质性的不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了平等保护条款在州级优先权背景下的应用；提出了识别优先权法律歧视动机的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院提供了评估优先权法律合宪性的分析工具；强调了需要识别形式州级至上背后的实质性不平等问题。

detail.title: Return on Physical Capital: Insights from Firm Level Data

publicationDetails.detailsText: RBI Monthly Bulletin in October 2021 edition

detail.abstract: The article explores the patterns in return on physical capital (RoPC) in manufacturing sector using the firm level Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) data for 2017-18. The aggregate RoPC is estimated at 19.5 per cent which seems comparable to the returns observed in other developing countries. The government (public) firms showed marginally higher returns than their non-government (public) counterparts. However, the average return of Non-Government (private) entities is significantly higher than Government (private). Amongst the regions, the northeast outperforms others primarily due to Pharma industry in Sikkim and Petroleum industry in Assam.

AI.tldr: 本文使用2017-18年企业级年度工业调查数据，分析了制造业实物资本回报率模式。总体RoPC为19.5%，与其他发展中国家相当。政府企业回报率略高于非政府企业，但非政府私营企业平均回报显著高于政府私营企业。东北地区表现最佳，主要归因于锡金邦的制药业和阿萨姆邦的石油业。

AI.motivation: 了解制造业资本回报率的分布特征，为投资决策和政策制定提供依据，特别关注不同所有制和地区间的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资本回报率理论，分析不同所有制结构（政府vs非政府）和地区因素对制造业资本效率的影响。
AI.method: 使用2017-18年企业级年度工业调查（ASI）数据，计算和分析实物资本回报率。

title: Ensuring Compliance in the Digital Age: A Data-Driven Approach to EU Consumer Contract Law

detail.title: Ensuring Compliance in the Digital Age: A Data-Driven Approach to EU Consumer Contract Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: in Veldt, Heidary, and Mak (eds), Empirics and Consumer Law in Changing Markets (Edward Elgar, 2025).

detail.abstract: The e-commerce landscape within the European Union (EU) has undergone significant transformation due to technological advancements and shifting consumer preferences. This Chapter examines the criteria for good evidence and data use within EU consumer law and policy, focusing on the evolving dynamics of e-commerce compliance. As digital transactions increase, ensuring consumer protection and trader compliance becomes increasingly complex. Consumer trust in e-commerce hinges on the effectiveness of legal frameworks. Over the past 30 years, EU consumer law has rapidly evolved, beginning with the Unfair Terms Directive 93/13, which addressed fairness in consumer contracts. Recent advancements, such as the Digital Content and Services Directive 2019/770 and the Sale of Goods Directive 2019/771, reflect a shift towards enhancing consumer rights in the digital age. The analysis focuses on whether the current legal framework adequately addresses e-commerce compliance nuances and how the evolution from the Unfair Terms Directive to the 2019 Directives has shaped the legal landscape. It delves into the deficiencies in understanding e-commerce compliance and how evidence and a data-driven approach can enhance the legislative quality and efficiency. The Chapter subsequently argues for an evidence-based and data-driven approach to EU consumer contract law.

detail.abstract: This paper studies the impact of beneficial ownership transparency in the British real estate market. In an effort to reduce illicit investment following the invasion of Ukraine, the UK government announced a new law in 2022 requiring offshore companies that owned domestic real estate to identify their ultimate owners in a public register. Using a difference-indifference framework, we find that new property purchases by companies registered in tax havens fell relative to those made via non-havens, a result consistent with transparency raising the costs of illicit investment. These declines persist even after dropping tax havens favored by Russians, suggesting that the reform drove the decline, rather than sanctions. We do not find strong evidence of price effects nor substitution into ownership through suspicious domestic companies. While the policy does appear to have been effective at deterring some anonymous investment into the British property market, incomplete implementation led some clients to still successfully shield their ownership information, implying scope for better design and enforcement in the future.

detail.abstract: One of the main challenges when analyzing multinational firms (MNEs) is that this group is comprised of a rich variety of firms engaged in a spectrum of activity. In response to the separate models describing one type of MNE or another, the Knowledge Capital model was developed in order to provide a unified framework. Although this did yield many empirically supported insights, it nonetheless had difficulty explaining to coexistence of FDI and trade among similar countries, a particular issue given that most FDI and trade takes place between such nations. While this can be resolved by adding in additional factor-capital-this raises several questions on how best to match the expanded theory to the data. In this paper, we provide an overview of the development of this literature, illustrate some of the difficulties in mapping the models to data, and provide several suggestions for future research including a need to model capital markets and taxation.

detail.abstract: We develop a method to measure ambiguity—uncertainty about the distribution of out-comes—in asset markets, using the volatility of the empirical distribution of unpredictable components in transaction prices. For comparison, we measure risk as the volatility of the unpredictable price component itself, following the conventional practice of using the cross-sectional standard deviation. Applying this framework to 22 million secured lending transactions in the EU, we estimate ambiguity and risk perceived by major money market lenders. Unexpected monetary policy tightening raises both measures.

title: Credit Substitution in Sustainable Finance: An Achilles Heel?
affiliations: London School of Economics - Law School

detail.title: Credit Substitution in Sustainable Finance: An Achilles Heel?
detail.abstract: Sustainable finance has become mainstream, with governments and stakeholders relying on financial players/channels to prod real economy firms into addressing environmental and social issues. An overlooked, yet significant problem with this idea is credit substitution-where firms replace their 'exiting' creditors or investors. This significantly weakens the effect of 'exit' and results in the migration of problems or risks associated with lending and investment to new entrants. This article examines credit substitution in theory and practice, focusing on its implications for sustainable finance. It argues that the current regulatory framework and broader ecosystem for financial institutions worldwide create conditions highly conducive to credit substitution. Key factors include substantial cross-jurisdictional differences in approaches towards sustainable finance among major financial centres and cross-sectoral differences within jurisdictions-particularly in the EU-where sustainable finance regulations vary between bank-based and market-based financing. These conditions undermine the effectiveness of sustainable finance policies. If the aim is to address environmental and social impacts in the real economy, such policies are diluted; alternatively, if focused on managing financial risks associated with lending to and investing in firms causing these impacts, the result is only migration, rather than mitigation, of risks. The article concludes with policy implications.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了可持续金融中一个被忽视但重要的问题——信贷替代，即企业替换退出的债权人或投资者，这会削弱"退出"效果并导致风险转移。文章分析了信贷替代在理论和实践中的表现，指出当前全球金融监管框架和生态系统为信贷替代创造了有利条件，包括主要金融中心在可持续金融方法上的跨司法管辖区差异以及欧盟内部银行融资与市场融资之间的跨部门差异，这些都削弱了可持续金融政策的有效性。

publicationDetails.journalName: CEIS: Centre for Economic & International Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a quantitative heterogeneous-bank model to study how interestrate risk transmits through the financial sector. Banks optimally choose their leverage and maturity structure in the presence of limited equity issuance, default risk, and partial deposit insurance. Long-maturity assets carry a premium because they expose banks to valuation losses when interest rates rise. To preserve their franchise value, banks with low net worth relative to risky assets take on less interest-rate risk, despite the presence of risk-shifting incentives associated with deposit insurance. Applying the model to the 2022-2023 monetary tightening, I show that a rapid increase in interest rates can generate large declines in asset prices and equity values even though banks have access to shortterm assets that provide insurance against interest-rate risk. Under the lens of the model a substantial share of the losses in 2022 was predictable, whereas the losses in 2023 were largely unexpected. A shift toward long-term assets during a period of unusually low rates amplified the initial tightening, but a rebalancing toward shorter maturities dampened the transmission of later hikes.

detail.abstract: We study heterogeneity in households’ credit across nine European countries (Belgium, Spain, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Portugal, and Slovakia) during 2022-2024 using granular credit register data. We first document substantial between- and within-country variation in mortgage and consumer lending by borrower age, loan maturity, and interest rate fixation. We then quantify the passthrough of the ECB’s recent tightening cycle to household borrowing costs, and assess its heterogeneous impact across households. Pass-through is nearly complete for mortgages (around 0.9) but considerably weaker for consumer credit (around 0.4). While mortgage pass-through is relatively homogeneous across countries, consumer credit shows pronounced cross-country differences that cannot be explained by borrower or loan characteristics. Younger households face stronger mortgage pass-through but weaker consumer credit pass-through relative to older borrowers, and longer maturities are associated with stronger pass-through in both credit markets.

detail.abstract: The 2010 sovereign crisis in the euro area brought to light the depth of the monetary union’s structural weaknesses. In particular, it highlighted the dangers of the sovereign-bank nexus – the amplification effect resulting from sovereign debt being held primarily by domestic banks. In response, important changes have been put in place. From a crisis management perspective, new institutions were created, such as the European Stability Mechanism which acts as a lender of last resort for euro area countries in difficulties. From an ex ante perspective, the crisis led to the launch of the banking union, which comprises the Single Resolution Mechanism – including the Single Resolution Fund – and the still-pending European Deposit Insurance Scheme. In addition, a wide array of regulation has been put in place, including Basel III and MREL/TLAC requirements to reduce the need for bailouts during financial crises and therefore limit the use of public funds in resolution processes. Despite this, the regulatory debate on how banking regulation should address this sovereign-bank interdependence continues today. In this paper we review the main regulatory proposals aimed at curtailing both exposure to sovereign risk and ownership concentration - two factors often associated to the broader sovereign-bank nexus. We assess their impact on bank capital and risk-weighted assets and simulate banks’ responses to these measures. We find that these solutions could entail significant side effects for both banks and bond markets, highlighting the importance of completing the monetary union and, in particular, issuing a European safe asset as key measures to mitigate this vulnerability.
