detail.abstract: The article analyzes the concept of “management”, identifying the essence and development of managerial thinking through the lens of philosophical-theoretical analysis and conceptual generalization. Management is considered as a process of transforming the current state in accordance with goal-oriented thinking. Two well-known schools of public administration are identified: the British and the German. The British school emphasizes the protection of individual freedom and the rational activities of the government, which have roots in the well-known political traditions of the United Kingdom. The German school reflects the continental European tradition and is based on Max Weber’s concept, in which public administration is equated with the state bureaucratic mechanism.The aim of the article is to assess the concept of “management” through the prism of philosophical-theoretical analysis, to reveal scientific approaches to defining the concepts of state administration, public administration, and public governance.The theoretical basis of the research consists of works by domestic and foreign scholars, as well as scientific studies on the correlation between “state administration” and the concepts of “public administration” and “public governance”.The terminological aspects are disclosed, including the problem of translating and understanding the concept of “public administration”, establishing the key differences between the terms “state administration” and “public administration”. It is found that the current state of state administration in the context of globalization and informational transformations requires the development of public governance, which entails the implementation of the “open government” concept, democratization of power, and increased citizen participation in governance processes.

title: The Uneven Economics of Protests: Understanding Social Unrest and Income Dynamics in Pakistan
affiliations: and Government College University Lahore

detail.title: The Uneven Economics of Protests: Understanding Social Unrest and Income Dynamics in Pakistan
detail.abstract: This paper examines how social unrest in Pakistan reflects underlying income dynamics and uneven patterns of urban development, offering insights into the nexus between cities, conflict, and growth. While the literature suggests that economic growth can help reduce unrest, it is equally critical to understand how protests themselves interact with income distribution and urban inequality. Using district-level panel data for Pakistan from 2011 to 2021, the study combines household income data from the PSLM survey with protest and unrest data from the ACLED database. Persistent income inequality and uneven urban expansion highlight structural weaknesses often overlooked by policymakers. Conventional estimation approaches such as fixed effects, random effects, and cross-sectional FGLS capture effects only at the mean, which can be misleading in the presence of skewed income distributions. To address this, the study applies a Quantile Regression Model (QRM) for panel data to capture effects across different points of the income distribution. The results show that protests significantly and positively influence average monthly incomes in more urbanized and developed districts, while the effect is weaker in lower-income regions. These findings underscore how social unrest is both a symptom and a consequence of Pakistan's uneven urbanization trajectory, linking the debate on conflict and inequality with the broader question of what has gone wrong in the country's urban growth model.

title: Integrating stochasticity into epidemiological-economic models and its implications for welfare analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Interuniversity Institute for Biostatistics and statistical Bioinformatics (IBioStat) - Data Science Institute and University of Antwerp - Centre for Health Economics Research and Modelling Infectious Diseases (CHERMID)

detail.title: Integrating stochasticity into epidemiological-economic models and its implications for welfare analysis
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the implications of incorporating stochasticity into epidemiological-economic (epi-econ) models for evaluating welfare. While deterministic models result in a completely predictable epidemic unfolding, infectious disease dynamics are inherently stochastic in nature, which is most pronounced and important to account for when case numbers are low. We adapt an existing epi-econ framework to include discrete-time stochastic transitions based on chain binomial processes. The inclusion of stochastic effects systematically reduces both health-related and activity-related costs as compared to deterministic model results. This discrepancy is primarily driven by the possibility of epidemic fade-out at the end of the outbreak, when case numbers are low and stochastic fluctuations in new cases or the absence thereof can eliminate the disease entirely. In such cases, subsequent infections and associated costs are avoided, and individuals return to normal activity sooner. As a result, deterministic models tend to overestimate expected welfare losses in cases where the impact of this epidemic fade-out is pronounced, potentially leading to overly conservative policy recommendations. Based on our work, it is clear that the economic consequences of stochastic effects are substantial and welfare assessments should accommodate such stochasticity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在流行病-经济模型中引入随机性对福利评估的影响。研究发现随机模型相比确定性模型会系统性地降低健康相关和活动相关成本，主要原因是随机模型考虑了疫情消退的可能性，而确定性模型倾向于高估福利损失。

AI.motivation: 传染病动态本质上是随机的，特别是在病例数较低时，这种随机性尤为重要，而传统的确定性模型无法捕捉这种特性。

AI.method: 将现有的流行病-经济框架改编为包含基于链二项过程的离散时间随机转换

AI.theory_contributions: 证明了在流行病-经济模型中考虑随机性的理论重要性，特别是在病例数较低时
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供了更准确的福利评估，避免因确定性模型导致的过于保守的政策建议

title: The Machiavellian Marketing Framework (MMF): A Paradigm for Control, Perception, and Psychological Strategy in the Algorithmic Era

detail.title: The Machiavellian Marketing Framework (MMF): A Paradigm for Control, Perception, and Psychological Strategy in the Algorithmic Era

keywords: the 23 laws of marketing master them or die

detail.abstract: The Machiavellian Marketing Framework (MMF) is introduced as a post-persuasion paradigm of market influence designed for algorithmic economy. Integrating insights from behavioral psychology, narrative theory, and power philosophy, MMF proposes that dominance in modern markets emerges not through persuasion but through the orchestration of psychological inevitability. It redefines marketing as a system of psychological governance in which context, scarcity, and perception are deliberately engineered to create alignment between audience and brand that appears self-originated. Drawing on philosophical antecedents from Machiavelli, Nietzsche, and Foucault, MMF situates influence as an act of control over social belief systems rather than mere communication. This framework contends that in an era governed by algorithms and attention scarcity, competitive advantage stems from a brand's capacity to architect belief, manipulate perception, and manufacture inevitability. MMF expands marketing scholarship by reframing influence as an emergent from of strategic psychology, one that exposes the moral neutrality of control in digital commerce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了马基雅维利营销框架(MMF)，这是一个后说服范式的市场影响力框架，旨在通过心理必然性的编排而非传统说服来实现市场主导地位。

AI.theory_contributions: 将影响力重新定义为战略心理学的涌现形式，扩展了营销学术研究，揭示了数字商务中控制的中立性。

title: Dual-Representation Shape Completion with Uncertainty Quantification for Robotic Fruit Harvesting
affiliations: University of Buea, University of Douala, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC) - School of Computer Science and Engineering and Chengdu University of Technology

detail.title: Dual-Representation Shape Completion with Uncertainty Quantification for Robotic Fruit Harvesting
detail.abstract: Autonomous robotic harvesting in agricultural environments requires accurate three-dimensional shape estimation of fruits despite substantial occlusions from leaves, branches, and overlapping produce. Existing shape completion methods employ single representation strategies exhibiting limitations in topology preservation and lack principled uncertainty quantification required for reliable autonomous decision-making. We present a dual-representation architecture combining templatebased mesh deformation with neural signed distance fields, enhanced by geometric attention mechanisms incorporating spatial relationships and local surface structure. Our approach integrates Bayesian uncertainty quantification through variational inference, decomposing prediction confidence into epistemic and aleatoric components. Evaluated on a dataset of 6947 annotated sweet pepper and strawberry samples with high-precision ground truth, our method achieves 3.24 millimeter Chamfer distance and 78.42 percent F-Score at five millimeter threshold, representing improvements of 22.7 percent and 19.5 percent respectively over prior state-of-the-art approaches. The system generates watertight meshes in 96.7 percent of cases while maintaining real-time performance at 142 milliseconds per inference, with calibrated uncertainty estimates enabling grasp planning for robotic manipulation in cluttered agricultural settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合模板网格变形和神经符号距离场的双表示架构，用于农业环境中水果的3D形状补全，通过贝叶斯不确定性量化提升机器人采摘的可靠性。
AI.research_question: 如何在严重遮挡的农业环境中实现准确的水果3D形状估计，并量化不确定性以支持可靠的自主决策？
AI.motivation: 现有形状补全方法在拓扑保持和不确定性量化方面存在局限，无法满足农业机器人采摘对可靠性的要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双表示架构（模板网格变形+神经符号距离场）、几何注意力机制、贝叶斯不确定性量化（变分推理）、认知不确定性和偶然不确定性分解。
AI.method: 结合模板网格变形和神经符号距离场的双表示方法，使用几何注意力机制，通过变分推理进行贝叶斯不确定性量化。
AI.findings: 在6947个甜椒和草莓样本数据集上，Chamfer距离达到3.24毫米，5毫米阈值下的F-Score为78.42%，相比现有方法分别提升22.7%和19.5%。96.7%情况下生成水密网格，实时性能142毫秒/推理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了双表示形状补全架构，发展了结合几何注意力的不确定性量化方法，为机器人感知提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了农业环境中水果的实时3D形状补全，校准的不确定性估计支持机器人抓取规划，提升了农业机器人采摘的可靠性。

title: How Does Agricultural Sector Dynamics Influence Economic Growth in Kenya? An Empirical Investigation of Key Drivers

detail.title: How Does Agricultural Sector Dynamics Influence Economic Growth in Kenya? An Empirical Investigation of Key Drivers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Okoth, E. (2025). How does agricultural sector dynamics influence economic growth in Kenya? An empirical investigation of key drivers. Turkish Journal of African Studies, 2(2), 107-127.

detail.abstract: Kenya's agricultural sector, renowned for its tea and horticultural exports, is pivotal to the nation's economic development. This study investigates the effects of agricultural sector variables on Kenya's economic growth from 1995 to 2021, with a particular focus on agricultural export-led growth. Findings challenge the conventional support for agricultural exports as a primary driver of economic growth in Kenya, as exports show a positive but statistically insignificant effect on GDP per capita under the FMOLS and CCR models. This weak evidence for export-led growth suggests that potential gains from exports may depend on broader factors such as value addition, export diversification, and better access to international markets. Additionally, agricultural imports had a positive but insignificant impact on economic growth, indicating potential contributions through access to vital inputs and technology. In contrast, agricultural employment exhibited a significant negative relationship with growth, implying an economic shift from agriculture toward industrial and service sectors, which can foster higher productivity. Government spending on agriculture, however, negatively impacted growth, indicating inefficiencies in resource allocation. The study recommends that Kenya enhance export competitiveness, improve government spending efficiency, and focus on value addition in agriculture. Strategic interventions to address structural inefficiencies, support sectoral transformation, and elevate productivity are essential to harness the agricultural sector's potential for sustained economic growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究挑战了农业出口作为肯尼亚经济增长主要驱动因素的传统观点，发现农业出口对人均GDP的影响虽为正但不显著，表明出口收益可能依赖于附加值、出口多样化和国际市场准入等更广泛因素。

AI.theoretical_framework: 农业出口导向型增长理论，结合结构转型理论。
AI.method: 使用FMOLS（完全修正最小二乘法）和CCR（典型相关回归）模型分析1995-2021年的时间序列数据。

title: Geoeconomics and the Trump Shock-Implementing Canada’s Indo-Pacific Strategy in Turbulent Times (Part One)
affiliations: and Sasin School of Management, Chulalongkorn University

detail.title: Geoeconomics and the Trump Shock-Implementing Canada’s Indo-Pacific Strategy in Turbulent Times (Part One)
detail.abstract:
Trump’s tariffs are the tip of the iceberg to a broader goal: rewiring the world’s economic, political, and security architecture. 

It’s part of the new global reality Canadians are facing. The United States has been the cornerstone of Canada’s external economic relations. That’s served Canada well, and will continue to do so. But the world order is shifting, shaped largely by geoeconomics – state use of economic policy to achieve geopolitical objectives. Trump’s strategy is the most extensive example. It has a particular focus on China, given its global role and extensive impact on the US. 

Canada must respond with a robust economic strategy. It should include calculated economic diversification with a focus on the Indo-Pacific region. This article, the first in a two-part series, focuses on the return of geoeconomics, and the related Trump strategy. Canada’s challenge is to develop an effective economic strategy in response.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了特朗普关税政策背后的地缘经济战略，探讨了加拿大如何应对全球秩序变化，建议通过经济多元化特别是加强与印太地区的联系来制定有效的经济战略。

detail.title: Paths Forward in a Changing Region-Implementing Canada’s Indo-Pacific Strategy in Turbulent Times: (Part Two)
detail.abstract: This is the second article in two-part series about the return of geoeconomics. Part one looked at United States President Donald Trump's strategy as the most extensive example of this return. A condensed version of parts of this article was published in The Hill Times on March 26, 2025. The return of geoeconomics has been a key factor reshaping the global system, with the Trump strategy presenting a singular challenge to rewire the global economic, financial, political, and security architecture. In this context, Canada is facing an uncertain, volatile, and complex global environment compounded by internal economic weaknesses accumulated over time. It requires rethinking Canada's economic strategy to strengthen national competitiveness in turbulent times. Canada's domestic economic challenges are well known. Options for addressing them have received considerable attention-if limited effective action-to date. There are a number of comprehensive analyses and recommendations by, among others, the C.D. Howe Institute, RBC Economics and Financial Times. There are also assessments and recommendations with respect to specific issues, for example by the Macdonald-Laurier Institute on interprovincial trade barriers, capital investment, and tax reform; and a thorough Parliamentary analysis of the innovation and productivity challenges. While the United States will continue to be the dominant, critical economic and security relationship for Canada, rethinking Canada's economic strategy should include focused and pragmatic trade and investment diversification. In this, an evolving Indo-Pacific region can play an important role.

detail.title: Developmental State and Colombian Constitutional Rights
detail.abstract: This article analyzes the relationship between Joseph Stiglitz's analytical framework of the developmental state and Title II-On Rights, Guarantees, and Duties-of the 1991 Colombian Political Constitution. It examines whether the constitutional articles enshrined therein offer institutional mechanisms to correct market failures, achieve a pragmatic balance between efficiency and equity, and build a hard (physical) and soft (educational and financial) infrastructure that supports sustained and inclusive development. It also assesses whether these articles allow for the design of deliberate public policies aimed at redistribution, competitiveness, and strengthening workers' bargaining power, rewriting the rules of the market under principles of social justice and collective well-being.

title: Capital Is King - Leveraging Crowdfunding in Trading and Aviator: A Literature Review
affiliations: Mirracle Consultants

detail.title: Capital Is King - Leveraging Crowdfunding in Trading and Aviator: A Literature Review
detail.abstract: Millions of people, particularly in developing countries, are losing money on a daily basis to forex and crypto trading, and recently to Aviator. Various reasons have been cited for this appalling situation, and lack of capital is among the most prevalent reasons. Although these seemingly lucrative options have claimed lives of many, many people are still hoping their financial situations will be positively turned by them. Thus, the aim of this study was to raise awareness with regards to the power of crowdfunding, in relation to trading and Aviator. To achieve the above, a systematic literature review was conducted. From the results, it was affirmed that indeed crowdfunding, coupled with financial prudence, has the potential to positively impact the masses of people in developing countries. Furthermore, it was noted that combining crowdfunding and the novel concept of professional aviator pilots in Africa, has the potential to create a sector with significant potential to eradicate poverty and inequality.

title: A Critical Analysis of Plastic Island Documentary in 2019

detail.title: A Critical Analysis of Plastic Island Documentary in 2019
detail.abstract: This paper presents a critical analysis of Plastic Island (2019), a documentary directed by Dandhy Laksono and Rahung Nasution, which explores Indonesia’s escalating plastic pollution crisis within the context of global environmental injustice. The critique examines the film’s content, narrative structure, and technical elements to evaluate its effectiveness in conveying its environmental message. The analysis reveals that the documentary successfully combines investigative journalism with compelling storytelling, using credible data, interviews, and authentic visuals to expose the interconnected systems of consumption and waste management that contribute to the crisis. Thematic organization, deliberate pacing, and strong editing techniques allow the film to maintain clarity and emotional resonance, while its restrained use of sound and narration enhances realism and credibility. Ultimately, the study concludes that Plastic Island is not only an informative and visually engaging documentary but also a socially relevant work that challenges viewers to confront the global consequences of plastic dependency and take responsibility for environmental sustainability.

title: The Cost-Effectiveness of Neoadjuvant and Adjuvant Novel Cancer Therapies in Stage II-III Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: Insights for Low and Middle-Income Countries from Sri Lanka
affiliations: District General Hospital Matara, Queensland University of Technology and National University of Singapore (NUS) - Duke-NUS Medical School

detail.title: The Cost-Effectiveness of Neoadjuvant and Adjuvant Novel Cancer Therapies in Stage II-III Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: Insights for Low and Middle-Income Countries from Sri Lanka

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: This work did not receive any specific funding from any governmental non-governmental or private agency.

detail.abstract:
Background: Newer cancer treatments such as small molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitors and monoclonal antibodies that restore anti-tumor immunity, lead to improved survival when delivered as adjuvant or neoadjuvant treatments with surgery or chemoradiotherapy for early and locally advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). However, these novel drugs are costly, posing a funding challenge for most health systems. A Markov modeling-based cost-utility analysis was conducted to determine their cost-effectiveness in Sri Lanka from a health system perspective.

Methods: A decision-analytic model, adopting a health system perspective, was developed to evaluate the incremental costs and quality-adjusted life years associated with treating patients diagnosed with stage II-III NSCLC in Sri Lanka for the following treatments: adjuvant osimertinib following surgery and after curative chemoradiotherapy, adjuvant alectinib after surgery, neoadjuvant nivolumab prior to surgery, adjuvant pembrolizumab and atezolizumab after surgery, perioperative durvalumab and pembrolizumab and consolidation durvalumab after chemoradiotherapy. The study employed one-year simulation cycles over a 20-year period, with patients progressing through various health states. To ascertain the reliability of the findings amidst uncertainty, a probabilistic sensitivity analysis was conducted using Monte Carlo simulation. A willingness-to-pay threshold (WTP) of USD 6700 was utilized in the analysis.

Results: Neoadjuvant nivolumab in resectable stage II-III NSCLC and adjuvant osimertinib delivered after surgery and following curative chemoradiotherapy were found to be cost-effective at the defined WTP with incremental cost effectiveness ratios of US$ 5501, US$4131, US$2165 per quality adjusted life year respectively. Rest of the treatments were not found to be cost-effective and required substantial price reductions to be competitive.

Conclusion: Our work provides a framework on which health policy makers can make robust decisions on which treatments to select for initial funding when considering expansion of indications beyond what is currently available in the state health sector in Sri Lanka. Although the analysis was conducted from the perspective of Sri Lanka’s state health sector, these findings would resonate across healthy systems in many low-middle income economies.

title: The Practical Model and Evidence of Organic Evolution Opposite to Darwin’s Theory of Natural Selection and Sexual Selection (Human Evolution)
affiliations: 2Professor, Dept. of Entomology, Faculty of Agriculture Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University, Dinajpur-5200, Bangladesh.

detail.title: The Practical Model and Evidence of Organic Evolution Opposite to Darwin’s Theory of Natural Selection and Sexual Selection (Human Evolution)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: There is no unethical information in this published work.
declarations.funderStatement: The author himself funded it.

detail.abstract: Hybridization (breeding) is practical evidence and a model of Darwin’s theory. But it would be true, if hybridization between two plants or animal species is possible and produced a fertile, reproductively isolated offspring. However, hybridization between two plants or animal species is not possible due to structural, behavioural differences, and seasonal isolations. If imposed, the fertilization fails, if the fertilization is successful, the embryo may abort, or the young may die. If the hybrid is survived up to maturity, it must become sterile. However, a very rare case the hybrids become fertile but those produce so-called varieties / races only; those species that produce fertile hybrids (e.g. Indian cattle Bos indicus and European cattle Bos taurus) must merge into a species.to satisfy the modern definition of species. Moreover, the artificial selection is also a skilled sexual selection, as the breeders choose the fittest, most vigour, and most fertile/productive, beautiful, colourful ornamented organism. But breeders also failed to develop a reproductively isolated species/variety/race by Johnson’s pure line selection, cloning, genetic engineering and mutation breeding. Even, a new species is not evolved by the natural hybridization. Consequently, there is no evidence of evolution of a new species either artificially or naturally. So, recent research claims that sexual selection theory is fundamentally f lawed and simply wrong. Hence, evolutionary biologists rejected the sexual selection. Thus, sexual selection is opposite to the evolution of humans from the lower animal like a chimpanzee. It is assumed that macroevolution occurs through hybridization; so, such an assumption is not valid.

title: Real Freedoms and Human Development in Colombia
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Real Freedoms and Human Development in Colombia
detail.abstract: This article examines Title I of the 1991 Colombian Political Constitution in light of Amartya Sen 's thinking , particularly his conception of freedoms as both an end and a means of human development. It analyzes how the fundamental principles-dignity, participation, solidarity, work, sovereignty, and justice-relate to Sen's notion of real freedom and to the capacity for citizen agency. From an interdisciplinary (economic, legal, and cultural) perspective, it is evident that, although the 1991 Charter proclaimed freedom as the core of the social rule of law, its practical application reveals deep structural gaps between formal and effective freedom. The study concludes that Colombian development continues to be limited by institutional and territorial inequalities that restrict the expansion of human capabilities.

title: Welfare Implications of Increased Retailer Participation in SNAP
affiliations: Cornell University, Government of the United States of America - Federal Trade Commission, University of Pennsylvania, The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania, University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and University of Pennsylvania

detail.title: Welfare Implications of Increased Retailer Participation in SNAP

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Governments often rely on private vendors to deliver in-kind benefits, yet little is known about how vendor participation affects markets and welfare. We study a sharp rise in retailer participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) during the Great Recession, driven largely by non-grocer formats. Linking administrative, retail, and household data, we find that sales increased 6% and variety 4% at adopting stores, with no price effects and only modest spillovers to local competitors. A revealed-preference framework shows that, while consumers value adoption at some chains, overall welfare gains for SNAP households were modest-equivalent to a 1.8% reduction in travel costs-with little effect on non-SNAP households.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: The Coasean Singularity? Demand, Supply, and Market Design with AI Agents
affiliations: , Harvard University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Boston University and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: The Coasean Singularity? Demand, Supply, and Market Design with AI Agents

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
AI agents—autonomous systems that perceive, reason, and act on behalf of human principals—are poised to transform digital markets by dramatically reducing transaction costs. This chapter evaluates the economic implications of this transition, adopting a consumer-oriented view of agents as market participants that can search, negotiate, and transact directly. From the demand side, agent adoption reflects derived demand: users trade off decision quality against effort reduction, with outcomes mediated by agent capability and task context. On the supply side, firms will design, integrate, and monetize agents, with outcomes hinging on whether agents operate within or across platforms. At the market level, agents create efficiency gains from lower search, communication, and contracting costs, but also introduce frictions such as congestion and price obfuscation. By lowering the costs of preference elicitation, contract enforcement, and identity verification, agents expand the feasible set of market designs but also raise novel regulatory challenges. While the net welfare effects remain an empirical question, the rapid onset of AI-mediated transactions presents a unique opportunity for economic research to inform real-world policy and market design.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: AI代理通过降低交易成本将改变数字市场，从需求侧看用户权衡决策质量与努力减少，供给侧企业设计代理并决定其平台内或跨平台运营，市场层面带来效率提升但也引入新摩擦，需要新的监管框架。
AI.research_question: AI代理如何通过降低交易成本来改变数字市场的经济格局？
AI.motivation: AI代理作为能够感知、推理和行动的自主系统，有望通过大幅降低交易成本来彻底改变数字市场，这需要从经济学角度评估其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本经济学、代理理论、市场设计理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于经济学原理对AI代理在需求侧、供给侧和市场层面的影响进行系统性分析
AI.findings: AI代理在需求侧体现为派生需求，用户权衡决策质量与努力减少；供给侧企业设计代理并决定其运营模式；市场层面带来效率提升但也引入新摩擦；通过降低偏好获取、合同执行和身份验证成本，扩展了可行的市场设计范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了AI代理经济学的理论框架，分析了代理在数字市场中的多维度影响，为理解AI驱动的市场转型提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场设计者提供指导，帮助应对AI代理带来的监管挑战和市场设计机会，促进福利最大化的市场结构发展。

title: The Sovereign Acre
affiliations: St. Mary's University - School of Law

detail.title: The Sovereign Acre
detail.abstract:
What if the next constitutional crisis is not declared from a presidential podium but tyranny forged into a deed? Not a contested election. Not a rogue legislature. Not even a runaway court. This time, it is quieter—with a deed signed and title passed, a new sovereign is crowned in private ink. Across the country, billionaire land grabs are redrawing the map of municipal governance itself. As wealthy elites and corporate oligarchs carve out private enclaves—from the privatized contract city of Sandy Springs, Georgia, to the unsettling governance of The Woodlands, Texas—we bear witness to public sovereignty giving way to oligarchic rule. Slowly. Quietly. Deed by silent deed.

These private states are not simply gated communities policed by overzealous HOA boards. They are full-fledged jurisdictions ruled by those whose power derives not from public consent but from private wealth. Billionaires and corporate oligarchs impose their own rule of law—zoning, taxing, regulating, and even policing—without bearing the constitutional obligations and accountability that once constrained public power. Due process becomes optional, and equal protection descends to little more than a fluid formality. In these private states, ownership no longer secures liberty; it demands allegiance to oligarchic power. As billionaires and corporate elites advance their march against public governance, the judiciary and legislatures continue to turn a blind eye. The public function doctrine lies in tatters, and the nondelegation doctrine is but a whisper of days gone by. Courts and lawmakers, charmed by promises of “efficiency” and “innovation,” have willingly ceded traditional safeguards, allowing constitutional protections to decay under the weight of privatized rule. In the meantime, the American vision of common governance—once indivisible, public, and accountable—is being parceled out, one sovereign acre at a time.

The largest billionaire land grab since the Great Depression adds urgency to this conversation. The acquisition of entire towns and vast rural tracts by the likes of Elon Musk and Marc Cuban makes clear that private sovereignty is no longer a theoretical risk but a reality to be enjoyed by the highest bidder. Let us not be naïve—these projects are not mere anomalies of eccentric titans of industry; they are blueprints for a dystopian future where public governance retreats, constitutional obligations unravel, and democracy survives only beyond the gates of billionaire control.

This Article introduces the concept of deed-based sovereignty, defined here as privatized governance constructed not through elections or public charters, but through property law’s oldest devices—restrictive covenants, easements, and development agreements. Situating these micro-sovereignties within the longer arc of American land power—from feudal manors to company towns—this Article asks what happens when ownership, not citizenship, becomes the defining metric of lawful authority. It argues that legislatures and the judiciary must end the indulgence that wealthy elites and corporate oligarchs are merely private actors engaged in private conduct. Where private hands govern as the state, constitutional limits must follow. Reforging sovereignty in property law demands both a revival of the public function doctrine and a renewed commitment to enforcing nondelegation principles, actions that are necessary to prevent the covert transfer of public power beyond the reach of constitutional accountability. Only by restoring these safeguards can courts fulfill their duty to ensure the principles of public sovereignty—and the democratic principles anchored to it—are not surrendered to the silent ledgers of private deeds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"基于地契的主权"概念，分析亿万富翁和公司寡头通过私有土地收购建立私人治理体系的现象，认为这威胁了公共主权和民主原则，呼吁恢复公共职能原则和非授权原则来约束这种私有化治理。
AI.research_question: 当所有权而非公民身份成为合法权力的定义标准时会发生什么？私有治理如何威胁公共主权和宪法问责？
AI.motivation: 亿万富翁和公司寡头通过大规模土地收购建立私人治理飞地，逐渐侵蚀公共主权，而司法和立法机构对此视而不见，导致宪法保护在私有化统治下衰退。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地契的主权概念、公共职能原则、非授权原则、财产法与主权的关系、从封建庄园到公司镇的美国土地权力历史脉络。
AI.method: 概念分析、历史比较分析、法律原则分析，通过案例研究（如乔治亚州桑迪斯普林斯、德克萨斯州林地）说明私有治理现象。
AI.findings: 私有治理体系正在通过限制性契约、地役权和开发协议等财产法工具建立，这些私人行为者实际上行使着国家职能，却不受宪法约束，导致正当程序和平等保护原则被削弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"基于地契的主权"这一新概念，重新构建了财产法与主权的关系理论，为理解当代私有化治理现象提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法和司法机构提供了应对私有治理威胁的具体建议，包括恢复公共职能原则和加强非授权原则的执行，以保护公共主权和民主原则免受侵蚀。

title: A Model of Monopolistic Competition
affiliations: and Göteborg University - School of Business, Economics and Law

detail.title: A Model of Monopolistic Competition
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the aggregate equilibrium approach (AEA)-a novel analytical framework for deriving the Nash-Cournot equilibrium in industries characterized by differentiated products, cost asymmetries, and interdependent demand conditions. Unlike the traditional Cournot approach, which relies on individual reaction functions, AEA first determines the aggregate equilibrium quantity and price, and then derives the output of each firm. While equivalent to the classical Cournot model under linear demand and constant marginal costs, AEA provides a more tractable framework for analyzing asymmetric monopolistic industries, particularly when firms exhibit initial cost differentials and interdependent, firm-specific demand curves. Moreover, this theoretical framework can be applied to the study of market concentration, market entry, and collusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了聚合均衡方法（AEA），这是一种用于分析差异化产品、成本不对称和需求相互依赖行业中纳什-古诺均衡的新分析框架。与传统方法不同，AEA先确定总均衡产量和价格，再推导各企业产量。在线性需求和恒定边际成本下与经典古诺模型等价，但在分析不对称垄断行业时更易处理。
AI.research_question: 如何在差异化产品、成本不对称和需求相互依赖的行业中推导纳什-古诺均衡？
AI.motivation: 传统古诺方法依赖个体反应函数，在分析不对称垄断行业时计算复杂，需要更易处理的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 聚合均衡方法（AEA）、纳什-古诺均衡理论、差异化产品市场理论
AI.method: 提出AEA框架：先确定总均衡产量和价格，再推导各企业产量；与传统古诺方法对比分析
AI.findings: AEA在线性需求和恒定边际成本下与经典古诺模型等价，但在分析不对称垄断行业时更易处理；适用于市场集中度、市场进入和合谋研究
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的分析框架AEA，扩展了古诺均衡理论在复杂市场结构中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析不对称垄断行业提供了更易操作的工具，可应用于市场集中度、市场进入和合谋等实际问题研究

title: Misspecified Fear or Model Choice? Evidence from Financial Markets
affiliations: Texas Tech University, Texas Tech University and Texas Tech University

detail.title: Misspecified Fear or Model Choice? Evidence from Financial Markets
detail.abstract: We develop and estimate a dynamic model of financial-market learning in which traders can endogenously switch between correct and misspecified models. Unlike frameworks that impose behavioral biases exogenously, our traders rationally choose to deviate from the correct model when short-term gains outweigh informational accuracy - a mechanism we term greed-driven model choice. This switching behavior generates persistent wedges between subjective and objective beliefs, producing volatility smiles, return predictability, and pricing-kernel distortions as equilibrium outcomes. Using option-price data and a structurally estimated binomial tree model with path dependence and informed traders, we identify belief-switching thresholds that quantify how greed and fear jointly shape learning and risk premia. We document economically significant welfare and performance costs of misspecification, expressed in certainty-equivalent losses and Sharpe-ratio reductions. Our results reveal how heterogeneous information processing and learning frictions jointly shape equilibrium pricing kernels, offering new empirical evidence on misspecified learning in dynamic models and the behavioral foundations of rational asset pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个金融市场学习动态模型，交易者可以在正确和错误模型之间内生切换。当短期收益超过信息准确性时，交易者会理性选择偏离正确模型，这种贪婪驱动的模型选择机制产生主观与客观信念之间的持续差距，导致波动率微笑、收益可预测性和定价核扭曲等均衡结果。
AI.research_question: 交易者如何在正确和错误模型之间内生切换？这种贪婪驱动的模型选择如何影响资产定价和风险溢价？
AI.motivation: 传统框架外生强加行为偏差，而本文探讨交易者理性偏离正确模型的机制，揭示贪婪和恐惧如何共同塑造学习和风险溢价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贪婪驱动的模型选择理论、主观与客观信念差距理论、内生模型切换动态模型
AI.method: 结构估计的二项树模型，包含路径依赖和知情交易者，使用期权价格数据识别信念切换阈值
AI.findings: 贪婪驱动的模型选择产生波动率微笑、收益可预测性和定价核扭曲；错误设定导致显著的经济福利和绩效成本；异质信息处理和学习摩擦共同塑造均衡定价核
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了贪婪驱动的模型选择理论，为理性资产定价提供新的行为基础，发展了动态模型中错误设定学习的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了贪婪和恐惧对学习和风险溢价的共同影响，为理解市场异常现象提供了新视角，识别了错误设定的经济成本

title: Instrumental Freedoms and Constitutional Reform in Colombia
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Instrumental Freedoms and Constitutional Reform in Colombia
detail.abstract: This article analyzes the relationship between Amartya Sen's theory of instrumental freedoms and the constitutional framework for reform in Colombia, established in Title XIII of the 1991 Constitution. It examines whether constitutional amendment and reform mechanisms effectively guarantee the five instrumental freedoms-political, economic, social, transparency, and protective security-as essential conditions for democratic development and human agency. The study argues that, although political freedoms are formally protected, socioeconomic inequalities, institutional rigidities, and low citizen participation limit the real expansion of substantive freedoms and the collective capacity to influence constitutional change.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了阿马蒂亚·森的工具性自由理论与哥伦比亚1991年宪法第XIII编确立的改革宪法框架之间的关系，探讨宪法修正和改革机制是否能有效保障五种工具性自由（政治、经济、社会、透明度和保护性安全）作为民主发展和人类能动性的必要条件。研究发现，虽然政治自由在形式上受到保护，但社会经济不平等、制度刚性和低公民参与限制了实质性自由的真正扩展和影响宪法变革的集体能力。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚的宪法修正和改革机制是否能有效保障阿马蒂亚·森提出的五种工具性自由，作为民主发展和人类能动性的必要条件？
AI.motivation: 分析宪法改革框架与工具性自由理论之间的关系，探讨哥伦比亚宪法机制在保障实质性自由方面的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阿马蒂亚·森的工具性自由理论，包括政治自由、经济自由、社会自由、透明度自由和保护性安全自由。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合对哥伦比亚1991年宪法第XIII编改革框架的实证分析。
AI.findings: 虽然政治自由在形式上受到宪法保护，但社会经济不平等、制度刚性和低公民参与限制了实质性自由的真正扩展和影响宪法变革的集体能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将森的工具性自由理论应用于宪法改革分析，为理解宪法机制与实质性自由保障之间的关系提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了哥伦比亚宪法改革机制在保障实质性自由方面的局限性，为宪法改革实践提供了政策启示。

title: Trump's Tariffs and the Ghost of Keynes: 81 Years Later, Vindication or Repetition?
affiliations: The Planning Commission of Pakistan

detail.title: Trump's Tariffs and the Ghost of Keynes: 81 Years Later, Vindication or Repetition?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no personal or financial relationships that are associated with this research paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: There are no ethics issues associated with this research paper.
declarations.funderStatement: There are no funder(s) linked to undertaking this research paper.

detail.abstract: This paper revisits the Trump administration's imposition of tariffs-branded as "Liberation Day" tariffs-as a watershed moment in the long arc of American trade exceptionalism and a vivid manifestation of unresolved global economic contradictions first identified by John Maynard Keynes over eight decades ago. Far from being a radical departure, Trump's tariff strategy is situated within a historical continuum in which the United States has repeatedly recalibrated global economic rules in response to domestic vulnerabilities and shifting geopolitical conditions. The paper draws a parallel between past crises-such as the Roosevelt administration's 1933 gold suspension and Nixon's 1971 abandonment of the gold-dollar standard-and the contemporary retreat from multilateral trade norms. Using this long-wave historical lens, the paper argues that the breakdown of symmetrical adjustment mechanisms, especially in the U.S.-China trade relationship, has exposed the fragility of the current international economic order. China's persistent surpluses and the United States' structural deficits are not merely technical imbalances; they are the outcome of deeper institutional and strategic divergences between financial capitalism and state-led industrialism. The paper offers a critical reassessment of the Bretton Woods framework, emphasizing Keynes original insight that global economic stability requires shared responsibility for adjustment by both surplus and deficit countries. It critiques the failure of key multilateral institutions-particularly the IMF and WTO-to enforce this principle, arguing that the erosion of their authority has allowed imbalances to persist and become structurally entrenched resulting in geopolitical tensions to escalate. Through an examination of recent IMF External Sector Reports and bilateral surveillance assessments, the study reveals both diagnostic clarity and procedural impotence. As a concrete reform proposal, the paper recommends the creation of a "Policy Coordination Action Matrix," rooted in IMF assessments and integrated into the G20 process, to enhance accountability and ensure symmetry in global adjustment efforts. The paper further advocates for a new approach to global governance that restores the centrality of the state, prioritizes democratic legitimacy, and recalibrates economic multilateralism to accommodate in a multipolar world. Ultimately, the paper contends that the Trump-era tariffs, while disruptive, have reignited necessary debates about fairness, adjustment, and institutional reform-demonstrating that Keynes's vision remains both relevant and unrealized. Eighty-one years later, the ghost of Keynes haunts a global system still grappling with the same fundamental asymmetries.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视特朗普政府的关税政策，将其置于美国贸易例外主义的历史延续中，认为这暴露了当前国际经济秩序的脆弱性，并呼吁基于凯恩斯原则建立更对称的全球调整机制。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府的关税政策如何反映了国际经济秩序中长期的调整不对称问题？
AI.motivation: 重新审视特朗普关税政策的历史根源，揭示当前全球贸易体系的结构性缺陷和凯恩斯未实现的愿景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凯恩斯主义国际经济学理论、历史制度主义、贸易例外主义理论、全球治理理论
AI.method: 历史比较分析、制度分析、IMF外部部门报告和双边监督评估的实证分析
AI.findings: 特朗普关税政策并非激进背离，而是美国历史上反复调整全球经济规则的模式延续；美中贸易关系中的调整机制崩溃暴露了当前国际经济秩序的脆弱性；多边机构未能执行对称调整原则导致失衡结构固化
AI.theory_contributions: 将特朗普关税政策置于长期历史脉络中分析；重新激活凯恩斯关于对称调整的理论框架；提出国家中心主义的全球治理新方法
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"政策协调行动矩阵"改革方案；建议将IMF评估纳入G20进程；为多极世界中的经济多边主义重新校准提供具体路径

title: Critical Review of the Netflix Documentary Plastic Island (Pulau Plastik)
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: Critical Review of the Netflix Documentary Plastic Island (Pulau Plastik)
detail.abstract:
Netflix's documentary Plastic Island (Pulau Plastik) provides a compelling and insightful 
look at the plastic pollution crisis in Indonesia. Combining investigative journalism and 
environmental advocacy, the film explores how plastics—from single-use products to imported 
waste—are making their way into rivers, oceans, and even human bodies. Through powerful 
cinematography and personal stories, the documentary highlights the urgent need to address the 
global problem of plastic overuse.

AI.tldr: Netflix纪录片《塑料岛》通过调查性新闻和环境倡导，揭示了印尼塑料污染危机，展示塑料从一次性产品到进口废物如何进入河流、海洋甚至人体，强调解决塑料过度使用全球问题的紧迫性。
AI.research_question: 塑料污染如何影响印尼的环境和人类健康？
AI.motivation: 揭示印尼塑料污染危机的严重性和紧迫性，提高公众对塑料过度使用问题的认识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境传播理论、可持续发展理论、环境正义理论
AI.method: 调查性新闻报道、纪录片拍摄、个人故事访谈
AI.findings: 塑料从一次性产品和进口废物进入印尼的水体和食物链，对环境和人类健康构成严重威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了环境传播理论在纪录片中的应用，深化了对塑料污染跨国界影响的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提高公众环保意识，推动政策制定者采取行动解决塑料污染问题，促进可持续消费行为改变。

title: Redistribution, Distortions, and the Welfare Effects of Social Security
affiliations: , University of Georgia and National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies (GRIPS, Tokyo)

detail.title: Redistribution, Distortions, and the Welfare Effects of Social Security

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: What is the best way to reform Social Security? Academic literature offers diverging advice. There is a well-known result that the optimal size of Social Security is zero, implying it is best to phase the program out. Other studies argue that much can be gained by redesigning the program, given its current size. We provide a unified analysis that examines how the optimal size of Social Security depends on the key features of its design. We first develop a theoretical decomposition tracing the program's welfare effects to (i) income redistribution, (ii) distortions on the annuitization level, and (iii) intertemporal distortions. We then quantitatively assess the role of these channels. We show that the zero-optimal-size result arises because Social Security is too distortive and not redistributive enough. Once these design flaws are corrected, it is even optimal to increase the size of the program.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个统一分析框架，研究社会保障最优规模如何取决于其设计特征。研究发现，社会保障最优规模为零的结果源于该制度扭曲性过高且再分配不足，一旦纠正这些设计缺陷，反而应该扩大项目规模。
AI.research_question: 社会保障的最优规模如何取决于其设计特征？
AI.motivation: 学术文献对社会保障改革提供了分歧的建议——有的认为最优规模为零应逐步淘汰，有的则认为在现有规模下重新设计可获得很大收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理论分解框架将社会保障的福利效应归因于三个渠道：(i)收入再分配，(ii)年金化水平的扭曲，(iii)跨期扭曲。
AI.method: 首先开发理论分解框架，然后定量评估这些渠道的作用。
AI.findings: 社会保障最优规模为零的结果源于该制度过于扭曲且再分配不足。一旦纠正这些设计缺陷，反而应该扩大项目规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的分析框架，将社会保障的福利效应分解为三个关键渠道，解释了为何不同研究得出矛盾结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会保障改革提供了具体方向：通过减少扭曲性和增强再分配功能，可以优化项目设计，甚至扩大规模。

title: Cryptocurrencies: Potential and Risks in the Path Toward Integration
affiliations: University of Padua

detail.title: Cryptocurrencies: Potential and Risks in the Path Toward Integration

declarations.funderStatement: The research is made by personal interest in the issues related, through the research techniques learned during the studies at the University of Padua in Political Science, International Relations and Human Rights.

detail.abstract: This paper explores the evolution, potential, and inherent risks of cryptocurrencies, focusing on their increasing relevance within the contemporary digital and financial landscape. The study examines how technological innovation, particularly the development of blockchain, has enabled the emergence of decentralized digital assets such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and XRP. The analysis highlights decentralization as the core attribute of cryptocurrencies, promoting financial autonomy, transparency, and democratization of money. However, it also considers the sector's volatility, security vulnerabilities, and growing use in illegal activities, including money laundering and terrorism financing. Additional attention is given to emerging technological threats, such as quantum computing, that may compromise blockchain integrity. On the regulatory side, the paper compares the European Union's MiCA Regulation with the United States' GENIUS Act, assessing their complementary efforts to establish a clear and balanced legal framework for digital assets. Ultimately, the research concludes that while cryptocurrencies represent a rapidly expanding and economically significant sector, their sustainable integration into the global financial system will depend on achieving equilibrium between innovation, security, and effective regulation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨加密货币的演变、潜力和风险，分析区块链技术如何推动去中心化数字资产发展，强调去中心化带来的金融自主权和透明度，同时关注其波动性、安全漏洞和非法使用问题。研究比较欧盟MiCA法规与美国GENIUS法案的监管框架，认为加密货币的可持续发展需要在创新、安全和有效监管之间取得平衡。
AI.research_question: 加密货币如何在当代数字金融环境中发展演变？其潜在价值和固有风险是什么？如何通过监管框架实现创新与安全的平衡？
AI.motivation: 随着加密货币在数字金融领域的重要性日益增长，需要系统分析其技术基础、经济潜力、安全风险和监管挑战，为这一快速扩张领域的可持续发展提供见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链技术的去中心化金融理论、数字资产经济学、金融监管理论以及技术创新与风险管理框架。
AI.method: 采用文献分析、案例研究（比特币、以太坊、Solana、XRP等主要加密货币）和比较分析方法，对比欧盟MiCA法规与美国GENIUS法案的监管策略。
AI.findings: 加密货币的核心特征是去中心化，促进金融自主和透明度；但存在高波动性、安全漏洞和非法使用风险；量子计算等新兴技术可能威胁区块链完整性；欧盟和美国正通过互补的监管框架建立数字资产法律体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对去中心化金融系统的理论理解，扩展了数字资产经济学的研究范畴，为技术创新与金融监管的平衡提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供监管框架设计的参考，为投资者和从业者识别加密货币的风险与机遇，为金融机构整合数字资产提供实践指导。

title: Decomposing the Welfare Gain from Banking in Models with Idiosyncratic Liquidity Risk
affiliations: Swiss National Bank

detail.title: Decomposing the Welfare Gain from Banking in Models with Idiosyncratic Liquidity Risk
detail.abstract: An important strand of the theoretical banking literature regards banks as arrangements that insure households against idiosyncratic liquidity preference shocks. This paper identifies the different sources of the welfare gain from banking in such environments and clarifies the exact nature of the liquidity insurance that banks provide in different settings. Special attention is given to the comparison of banking models in the tradition of Diamond and Dybvig (1983) with those based on monetary frameworks. Decomposing the welfare gain from banking helps to gain a deeper understanding of banks’ insurance function, and to determine the conditions under which banking is equivalent to eliminating uncertainty about liquidity preferences or letting households trade with each other in an asset market.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了银行作为流动性保险安排的理论基础，分解了银行提供的福利收益来源，并比较了Diamond-Dybvig传统银行模型与基于货币框架的银行模型。
AI.research_question: 银行在不同环境中提供流动性保险的确切性质是什么？银行福利收益的不同来源是什么？
AI.motivation: 理论银行文献的一个重要分支将银行视为防范家庭异质性流动性偏好冲击的保险安排，需要澄清银行在不同环境中提供的流动性保险的确切性质。
AI.theoretical_framework: Diamond和Dybvig（1983）的银行模型传统，基于货币框架的银行模型，流动性保险理论。
AI.method: 理论分析和模型比较，分解银行福利收益的来源。
AI.findings: 银行福利收益可以分解为不同组成部分，银行在不同环境中的保险功能具有不同性质，在某些条件下银行等同于消除流动性偏好不确定性或让家庭在资产市场中交易。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对银行保险功能的理解，澄清了银行在不同理论框架下提供流动性保险的确切机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解银行在金融体系中的作用提供了理论依据，有助于政策制定者评估银行监管和金融稳定政策。

title: Collateral Easing in Non-standard Times: A Review of the Role of Additional Credit Claims in the Eurosystem Collateral Framework
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), , European Central Bank (ECB), ,  and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Collateral Easing in Non-standard Times: A Review of the Role of Additional Credit Claims in the Eurosystem Collateral Framework

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Occasional Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: In this paper we explore the role of the temporary and country-specific Additional Credit Claims (ACC) frameworks as a monetary policy implementation tool. We discuss their evolution and provide a novel and detailed description of all ACC measures adopted by the different euro area NCBs since 2012. Reviewing the literature, we document the channels through which ACCs contributed to liquidity distribution during the euro area sovereign debt crisis, the negative interest rate period and the pandemic. Drawing on panel data on the use of collateral and securities holding statistics, we document novel stylised facts about ACC mobilisation patterns during these episodes. A number of conceptual contributions and empirical findings emerge. While ACCs started out as a crisis instrument, the historical review highlights that ACCs constitute a policy tool that is suitable for enhancing monetary policy implementation. Empirically we find that pledging ACCs was not systematically associated with more concentrated collateral pools. Banks pledging ACCs were mostly universal banks and diversified lenders of varying size and were associated with higher funding costs for their short-term secured debt instruments, though the causality is unclear. Finally, drawing on the implementation and risk management experience with ACC frameworks as well as our empirical findings, we establish five lessons to inform future policy discussions on collateral

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了欧元区各国央行采用的临时性附加信贷债权(ACC)框架作为货币政策实施工具的作用，分析了其在主权债务危机、负利率时期和疫情期间的流动性分配功能，并基于实证研究提出了五个政策启示。
AI.research_question: 附加信贷债权(ACC)框架作为货币政策实施工具的作用机制和效果如何？
AI.motivation: 理解ACC框架在欧元区不同危机时期作为货币政策工具的功能演变和实际效果，为未来政策制定提供经验借鉴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策实施理论、流动性分配机制、危机应对工具理论
AI.method: 文献综述、面板数据分析(抵押品使用和证券持有统计数据)、历史回顾
AI.findings: 1) ACC从危机工具发展为增强货币政策实施的政策工具；2) 使用ACC并未系统性地导致抵押品池集中化；3) 使用ACC的银行多为全能银行和多元化贷款机构；4) 这些银行短期担保债务工具融资成本较高但因果关系不明
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对临时性货币政策工具在危机应对中作用机制的理解，扩展了货币政策实施工具的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 基于ACC框架实施和风险管理经验，提出了五个政策启示，为未来抵押品政策讨论提供实证依据

title: Estimating the Shadow Economy in India: A MIMIC Model Approach
affiliations: B.Borooah College Autonomous

detail.title: Estimating the Shadow Economy in India: A MIMIC Model Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This is an independent research, No funding was obtained for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding, all resources were allocated personally.

detail.abstract: The shadow economy encompasses unregistered or informal economic activities that, while contributing to national output, operate outside the purview of official regulation and taxation. This study quantifies the size and trajectory of India's shadow economy from 2011 to 2022 using a Multiple Indicators Multiple Causes (MIMIC) model estimated through fullinformation maximum likelihood (FIML). The model integrates macroeconomic time-series data with institutional and non-traditional indicators such as nighttime light intensity, labor force participation, and financial inclusion disparities. Findings indicate a persistently large but fluctuating informal sector, peaking during the COVID-19 period and stabilizing thereafter. In 2022, the shadow economy accounted for approximately ₹1,076.82 lakh crore, equivalent to 41.1 percent of India's GDP, highlighting the continued structural entrenchment of informality despite formalization efforts. The study's results underscore that informality in India is a systemic outcome of institutional frictions, regulatory burdens, and uneven financial inclusion, calling for multidimensional reforms encompassing digital integration, tax simplification, and inclusive credit access.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用MIMIC模型量化了2011-2022年印度影子经济的规模，发现影子经济占GDP的41.1%，在疫情期间达到峰值后趋于稳定，表明非正规性是制度摩擦和监管负担的系统性结果。
AI.research_question: 印度影子经济的规模和发展轨迹是什么？其背后的驱动因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 影子经济作为未注册或非正规经济活动，虽然为国家产出做出贡献，但处于官方监管和税收体系之外，需要量化其规模以制定有效政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多指标多原因(MIMIC)模型，结合宏观经济时间序列数据与制度和非传统指标。
AI.method: 使用全信息最大似然法(FIML)估计的MIMIC模型，整合夜间光照强度、劳动力参与率和金融包容性差异等指标。
AI.findings: 印度影子经济规模庞大但波动，在COVID-19期间达到峰值后稳定。2022年约为1076.82万亿卢比，占GDP的41.1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了印度非正规经济是制度摩擦、监管负担和不均衡金融包容性的系统性结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化依据，建议通过数字整合、税收简化和包容性信贷获取等多维度改革来应对影子经济问题。

title: Does a Larger Population Facilitate a Weak Dominator in the Difference-form Contest?
affiliations: University of Macau

detail.title: Does a Larger Population Facilitate a Weak Dominator in the Difference-form Contest?
detail.abstract: The Hirshleifer contest with more than two heterogenous contestants, under certain circumstance, admits the Nash equilibrium in pure-strategies with precisely one active contestant. This is referred to as the one-sided dominance equilibrium in Ewerhart and Sun (2024, Games and Economic Behavior), in which the one-sided dominator is not necessarily the strongest contestant. It is shown in the present study that there exists a threshold value of the population of contestants such that a larger population facilitates (hinders) the one-sided dominance by a contestant that is weaker than the strongest opponent when the population is below (above) the threshold. This finding presents an interesting dimension of "the paradox of power" (Hirshleifer 1991, Economics and Politics), which has hitherto been entirely overlooked: a moderately enlarged population may encourage the aggressive behavior of a disadvantaged participant in contests, but too large a population stifles it instead.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在Hirshleifer竞赛中，当参赛者数量超过特定阈值时，较弱的参赛者反而可能成为单边主导者，这揭示了"权力悖论"的新维度。
AI.research_question: 在异质参赛者的Hirshleifer竞赛中，参赛者数量如何影响较弱参赛者成为单边主导者的可能性？
AI.motivation: 探索竞赛理论中"权力悖论"的新维度，即参赛者规模变化如何影响弱势参与者的竞争行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hirshleifer竞赛理论、单边主导均衡、权力悖论理论
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，建立参赛者数量阈值模型
AI.findings: 存在一个参赛者数量阈值，当参赛者数量低于该阈值时，扩大参赛者规模有利于较弱的参赛者成为单边主导者；当超过该阈值时，则抑制这种行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Hirshleifer竞赛理论，揭示了参赛者规模对单边主导均衡的非单调影响，丰富了"权力悖论"的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实竞赛中弱势参与者的竞争策略提供了理论指导，有助于预测不同规模竞争环境下的行为模式。

title: Impact Evaluation on Mobile Access Infrastructure of the Regional Broadband Projects in Apurimac, Ayacucho, and Huancavelica (Peru)
affiliations: Universidad Nacional de Ingeniería

detail.title: Impact Evaluation on Mobile Access Infrastructure of the Regional Broadband Projects in Apurimac, Ayacucho, and Huancavelica (Peru)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author works at the Ministry of Transport and Communications of Peru. However, this article was prepared in an academic and independent capacity. The views and conclusions expressed are solely those of the author and do not necessarily reflect the official position or policies of the institution. The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding and was conducted with the author’s own resources.

detail.abstract:
This article, using a fixed-effects panel data methodology for the period 2017–2020, provides evidence that, on average, the districts treated by the regional broadband projects in the regions of Apurimac, Ayacucho, and Huancavelica (Peru) experienced a significant 17.2 % increase in the number of base stations with 4G or higher technology compared to control districts after the projects began operation. Likewise, in relative terms to the population, the treated districts recorded an additional and statistically significant increase of 3.25 base stations with at least 4G per 10,000 inhabitants compared to control districts after the intervention.

The results confirm a significant causal relationship between the regional broadband projects and the growth of 4G mobile access infrastructure in the regions of Apurimac, Ayacucho, and Huancavelica.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2017-2020年面板数据，发现秘鲁阿普里马克、阿亚库乔和万卡韦利卡地区的区域宽带项目显著增加了4G及以上基站数量，处理区域相比对照区域基站数量增加17.2%，每万人口基站数增加3.25个。
AI.research_question: 区域宽带项目是否对秘鲁三个地区的4G移动接入基础设施增长产生因果影响？
AI.motivation: 评估宽带基础设施投资对偏远地区移动网络覆盖的实际效果，为政策制定提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于基础设施投资与区域发展的理论框架，关注宽带网络对数字鸿沟的缩小作用
AI.method: 固定效应面板数据方法，使用2017-2020年数据，比较处理区域与对照区域
AI.findings: 处理区域相比对照区域：基站数量显著增加17.2%；每万人口基站数显著增加3.25个
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了宽带基础设施投资对移动网络发展的因果效应，为发展经济学提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府宽带投资政策提供效果评估，支持在偏远地区继续推进宽带基础设施建设

title: Policy Design Matters: Heterogeneous Impacts of Ecological Fiscal Transfers on Budgets, Basic Services, and Conservation in Brazil
affiliations: , Mauro Borges Institute, Mauro Borges Institute, Mauro Borges Institute and Mauro Borges Institute

detail.title: Policy Design Matters: Heterogeneous Impacts of Ecological Fiscal Transfers on Budgets, Basic Services, and Conservation in Brazil

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No interests to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa do Estado de Goiás (FAPEG).

detail.abstract: We show that policy design matters: state-level allocation rules for Brazil's Ecological Fiscal Transfers (ICMS-E) generate heterogeneous impacts on municipalities' budgets, basic services, and conservation. Using a panel of 5,570 municipalities (with outcome-specific coverage) and the dynamic Difference-inDifferences estimator of Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021) to handle staggered adoption and heterogeneous effects-avoiding the negative-weighting bias of TWFE-, we define treatment as the first year each state reallocated ICMS revenue using ecological criteria. On budgets, adoption raises state-to-municipality transfers by about R$100 per capita initially, stabilizing between R$170-R$240 per capita five to ten years later, reflecting redistribution toward smaller, non-metropolitan municipalities. On basic services, health and sanitation spending increases by about R$190 per capita and environmental spending by R$60 per capita, both peaking around year seven; access to water services improves and sewerage expands more modestly. On conservation, the share of municipal land in protected areas rises by 0.23 percentage points on average. Deforestation exhibits an anticipatory spike around adoption, followed by declines of roughly 2.8-6.8 km from years four to ten. Heterogeneity analyses highlight strong environmental gains in the 2002 cohort (Rondônia, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul) and 2009 cohort (Rio de Janeiro, Ceará), while Goiás (2012) stands out for converting transfers into service improvements despite limited protected-area growth. Overall, not all EFTs are created equal: outcomes vary with allocation-rule design and implementation, so no single state model should be uncritically exported.

AI.tldr: 巴西生态财政转移支付(ICMS-E)的政策设计对市级预算、基础服务和环境保护产生异质性影响。采用动态DID方法分析发现，政策实施初期人均转移支付增加约100雷亚尔，5-10年后稳定在170-240雷亚尔，主要惠及小型非都市城市。基础服务支出增加，环保支出增长，保护区面积扩大，毁林率在政策实施初期上升后下降。不同州因分配规则设计和实施方式不同，政策效果存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 州级生态财政转移支付(ICMS-E)分配规则如何影响市级预算、基础服务和环境保护？
AI.motivation: 理解政策设计在生态财政转移支付中的重要性，以及不同分配规则如何产生异质性影响，为政策优化提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态财政转移支付理论、政策设计异质性理论、地方政府财政行为理论
AI.method: 使用5,570个市的面板数据，采用Callaway和Sant'Anna(2021)的动态DID估计方法，处理交错采用和异质性效应，避免TWFE的负权重偏差。
AI.findings: 1)预算：政策实施初期人均转移支付增加约100雷亚尔，5-10年后稳定在170-240雷亚尔；2)基础服务：健康卫生支出增加约190雷亚尔，环保支出增加60雷亚尔；3)环境保护：保护区面积平均增加0.23个百分点，毁林率在初期上升后下降2.8-6.8平方公里。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策设计在生态财政转移支付中的关键作用，证明了分配规则设计对政策效果的异质性影响，丰富了政策实施效果评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于生态财政转移支付分配规则设计的实证证据，强调不应盲目套用单一州模式，应根据地方特点优化政策设计。

title: Design and implementation of data collection and linkage of electronic health records in a large UK cluster-randomised trial of asthma management (ARRISA-UK)
affiliations: University of East Anglia, University of East Anglia, University of East Anglia, University of East Anglia, University of East Anglia, University of Aberdeen, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of East Anglia, University of Exeter, University of Exeter and University of East Anglia

detail.title: Design and implementation of data collection and linkage of electronic health records in a large UK cluster-randomised trial of asthma management (ARRISA-UK)
detail.abstract: Electronic health record data holds great potential for conducting large, efficient randomised controlled trials. Despite progress towards greater availability of linked NHS datasets, the use of routine clinical data remains challenging for trialists. In this paper we describe the design, adaptations and implementation of methods for data collection and linkage in ARRISA-UK: a cluster-randomised controlled trial of a complex asthma management intervention involving 275 primary care practices across England, Wales and Scotland.Our methods were designed to build a dataset of linked primary care and secondary care data for approximately 10,000 ‘at-risk’ asthma patients to measure the trial’s primary outcome (asthma crisis events comprising respiratory-related hospital admissions, A&E attendances and/or death for ‘at-risk’ asthma patients) and secondary clinical outcomes including the impact of the intervention on ~180,000 asthma patients at participating practices.A high level of practice attrition (33%) was observed due to data extraction delays and technical barriers, patient identification errors, and concerns about the processing of patient identifiable data for the purpose of record linkage. We highlight the technical achievements, barriers and lessons learned from ARRISA-UK and propose recommendations to facilitate future data-enabled trials, including greater resourcing in recognition of their complex nature, improved systems of support and training in primary care, and the need to maintain and improve clinician and public trust in research data use for long term sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了ARRISA-UK试验中数据收集和链接方法的设计、调整与实施，这是一个在英国、威尔士和苏格兰进行的复杂哮喘管理干预的集群随机对照试验。研究发现33%的实践流失率，主要由于数据提取延迟、技术障碍、患者识别错误以及对患者身份数据处理担忧。文章提出了促进未来数据驱动试验的建议。
AI.research_question: 如何在大型随机对照试验中有效设计和实施电子健康记录数据的收集与链接方法？
AI.motivation: 电子健康记录数据具有进行大规模、高效随机对照试验的巨大潜力，但在实际应用中仍面临挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于电子健康记录数据在临床试验中的应用理论，重点关注数据链接和提取方法。
AI.method: 采用集群随机对照试验设计，涉及英国、威尔士和苏格兰的275个初级保健实践，构建约10,000名高危哮喘患者的链接数据集。
AI.findings: 观察到33%的实践流失率，主要障碍包括数据提取延迟、技术障碍、患者识别错误以及对患者身份数据处理的担忧。
AI.theory_contributions: 为电子健康记录在临床试验中的应用提供了方法论框架和实践经验。

title: Peer vs. Network Effects: Microfoundations, Identification, and Beyond *
affiliations: Monash University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Peer vs. Network Effects: Microfoundations, Identification, and Beyond *
detail.abstract: This paper reviews the theoretical and empirical foundations of peer and network effects, aiming to bridge insights from both literatures. We first examine the main identification challenges in linear-in-means models-reflection, correlated effects, and sorting-and show how introducing explicit network structures can help address them. We also review reduced-form strategies based on withinschool cohort composition, exposure to peers' shocks, random assignment, and exogenous variation in network links. The analysis then develops the microfoundations of peer effects through linear-quadratic network games, linking equilibrium behavior to network centrality and highlighting the role of key players. Using this framework, we discuss how structural models of network formation and individual effort choices can resolve endogeneity concerns. The paper concludes with recent advances on non-linear and multiplex interactions, where individuals respond to specific peers and operate across multiple, interdependent layers.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了同伴效应和网络效应的理论与实证基础，通过引入显式网络结构解决识别挑战，发展了基于网络博弈的微观基础，并讨论了网络形成和个体选择的结构模型，最后探讨了非线性和多重网络交互的最新进展。

title: The Media as a Catalyst for Human Development: Awakening Minds and Shaping Lives
affiliations: Srinivas University

detail.title: The Media as a Catalyst for Human Development: Awakening Minds and Shaping Lives

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No financial relationship
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding

detail.abstract: Media is a major factor in how people grow and change throughout their lives, affecting their cognitive, emotional, and social growth. Exposure to many types of media, such TV, digital platforms, social networks, and interactive technologies, can change how people see themselves and the world around them from early infancy to maturity. Positive media interaction can improve learning, empathy, and global awareness, but too much or negative exposure can lead to problems like concentration deficits, body image issues, and feeling alone. This study investigates the evolving interplay between media consumption and human development, analysing theoretical frameworks, empirical data, and developing trends in digital media. It also shows how important it is to be media literate and utilise media responsibly in order to support healthy psychological and social growth in the digital age.

title: Denoising Multiple Time Series: Evidence of a Negative Greenium in German Twin Bonds
affiliations: Grenoble Ecole de Management, University of California Santa Barbara, Grenoble Ecole de Management and

detail.title: Denoising Multiple Time Series: Evidence of a Negative Greenium in German Twin Bonds

declarations.funderStatement: C. Bernard gratefully acknowledges funding from the FWO (grant FWOG015320N).

detail.abstract: We begin by introducing a new method for trend extraction in univariate time series, which we call Spline trend filtering. This method combines two established approaches, l1 trend filtering and graduation techniques based on cubic and penalized Splines. The introduced estimator mitigates the ill-conditioning issues associated with the two mentioned methods. We then extend both l1 trend filtering and Spline trend filtering methods to multiple time series regression frameworks, introducing two novel methods that simultaneously denoise multiple interconnected time series while capturing their underlying structural relationships. To manage the computational challenges of large-scale datasets, we implement the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) as an efficient optimization strategy. In our empirical study, we apply the proposed methods to estimate the greenium in the German federal bond market, and we show that investors in Germany are indeed willing to sacrifice part of their profit to support environmental objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的单变量时间序列趋势提取方法——样条趋势滤波，该方法结合了l1趋势滤波和基于三次样条的平滑技术，解决了现有方法的病态问题。随后将方法扩展到多变量时间序列回归框架，提出了两种同时去噪多个相互关联时间序列并捕捉其结构关系的新方法。使用ADMM算法解决大规模数据集的计算挑战，并在德国联邦债券市场的实证研究中验证了投资者愿意为环境目标牺牲部分利润的"绿色溢价"现象。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种有效的时间序列趋势提取方法，既能解决现有方法的病态问题，又能扩展到多变量框架以捕捉多个时间序列之间的结构关系？
AI.motivation: 现有l1趋势滤波和样条平滑方法存在病态问题，且缺乏处理多个相互关联时间序列的有效方法，需要开发更稳健的趋势提取技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合l1趋势滤波和基于三次样条的平滑技术理论，构建样条趋势滤波框架；扩展到多变量时间序列回归理论。
AI.method: 提出样条趋势滤波方法，使用ADMM算法进行优化，并将其扩展到多变量时间序列回归框架。
AI.findings: 提出的方法有效解决了现有方法的病态问题；在德国联邦债券市场的实证研究中发现了绿色溢价现象，表明投资者愿意为环境目标牺牲部分利润。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合l1趋势滤波和样条平滑的新方法样条趋势滤波；将单变量方法扩展到多变量框架；开发了基于ADMM的高效优化策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为时间序列趋势提取提供了更稳健的方法；在金融领域验证了绿色溢价的存在，为可持续投资提供了实证依据；开发的计算方法可处理大规模数据集。

title: Spatial Inequalities in U.S. Electric Vehicle Infrastructure
affiliations: and University of Georgia - Warnell School of Forestry and Natural Resources

detail.title: Spatial Inequalities in U.S. Electric Vehicle Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no financial or other conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the University of Georgia’s E-Mobility Seed Grant program and the National Science Foundation (grants 2343136 and 2420985).

detail.abstract: Equitable decarbonization depends not only on technology adoption but also on how infrastructure is deployed. Because infrastructure is fixed in space and path dependent, new investments can lock in advantage or exclusion for decades. We examine this dynamic in the case of federal electric vehicle infrastructure, where equity shortfalls are not merely local disparities but structural outcomes of spatial interdependence. Using geospatial analysis and spatial econometric models across 15,566 census tracts in ten southeastern U.S. states, we find that disadvantaged communities are on average 53% farther from federally designated Alternative Fuel Corridors, and that spillovers from neighboring burdens add an additional 10% disadvantage. To test whether inequities are inevitable or policy-contingent, we simulate a counterfactual reallocation aligned with Justice40 mandates. This scenario reduces the average distance gap by 40% and spillover disadvantage by more than 60%. Equity shortfalls in infrastructure transitions thus arise structurally from legacy siting and spatial spillovers, but they are not immutable. Targeted interventions can realign outcomes, showing how network-aware equity frameworks can make the clean energy transition both more just and more effective.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过空间分析和计量模型发现，美国东南部弱势社区距离联邦电动汽车充电走廊平均远53%，且存在10%的空间溢出效应。通过模拟符合Justice40政策的重新分配方案，可将距离差距减少40%，溢出劣势减少60%以上。
AI.research_question: 基础设施转型中的公平差距是不可避免的还是政策可改变的？
AI.motivation: 公平脱碳不仅依赖技术采用，还取决于基础设施部署方式。由于基础设施具有空间固定性和路径依赖性，新投资可能锁定数十年的优势或排斥。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间相互依赖理论、路径依赖理论、网络意识公平框架
AI.method: 对美国东南部10个州15,566个人口普查区进行地理空间分析和空间计量经济模型
AI.findings: 弱势社区距离联邦替代燃料走廊平均远53%，邻居负担的溢出效应增加10%的劣势
AI.theory_contributions: 提出基础设施公平差距是空间相互依赖的结构性结果，而非仅仅是局部差异
AI.practical_contributions: 证明有针对性的干预措施可以重新调整结果，为清洁能源转型提供更公平有效的政策框架

title: Analytical Study of Artificial Intelligence Integration in Indian Banks and Its Implications for the Future of Banking and Financial Services in India
affiliations: NESS Wadia College of Commerce Pune

detail.title: Analytical Study of Artificial Intelligence Integration in Indian Banks and Its Implications for the Future of Banking and Financial Services in India
detail.abstract: The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has transformed the operational and strategic landscape of the global banking industry, with Indian banks increasingly adopting AIdriven technologies to enhance efficiency, innovation, and customer engagement. This study analytically examines the integration of Artificial Intelligence in Indian banking institutions and evaluates its implications for the future of banking and financial services in India. The research focuses on the adoption patterns of AI technologies such as machine learning, natural language processing, predictive analytics, and robotic process automation across both public and private sector banks. Using secondary data from reports published by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), NITI Aayog, and major financial institutions, the study explores how AI contributes to improving operational efficiency, risk management, fraud detection, and personalized service delivery. The paper also investigates the challenges associated with AI implementation, including data privacy concerns, skill gaps, regulatory compliance, and ethical considerations. The findings indicate that while AI integration has significantly improved service quality and decision-making processes, its long-term sustainability depends on robust digital infrastructure, regulatory frameworks, and workforce upskilling. The study concludes that Artificial Intelligence will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of the Indian banking sector by promoting financial inclusion, enhancing competitiveness, and fostering a more resilient and customer-centric banking ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了人工智能在印度银行业的整合情况，评估了其对印度银行业未来的影响，重点关注AI技术在提高运营效率、风险管理和客户服务方面的作用，以及实施过程中面临的挑战。

AI.findings: AI整合显著提高了服务质量和决策过程，但其长期可持续性取决于强大的数字基础设施、监管框架和劳动力技能提升。

title: The Language of a Place
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Duluth - School of Medicine

detail.title: The Language of a Place

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
Chapter Excerpt:
...In recent years, I have conducted formal, one-on-one interviews on a folding chair next to a cow pasture and worn t-shirts and shorts for semi-structured focus groups. I mention these things not as indicators of “rural” but because I think this is what happens when people are after the same things together for a relatively long time. In other words, when people are invested in your research and want to get the story right—i.e., as nuanced and multidimensional as possible—there is very little pretense. After seven years, people know that I have the training, resources, and networks to amplify their expertise and the work they’re doing. It doesn’t matter that the air conditioner at the Tribal housing authority is broken and we’re all in shorts; it matters that we all showed up. What is potentially “rural” about it, then, is me: I desperately don’t want to recreate the experience Kathy Cramer recounted, of the distanced, “liberal elite,” researcher who could’ve just asked.  

But there is something more, which is the matter of love. I have invited collaborating judges to co-author articles and participate in academic conferences, and they have invited me to concerts and pow wows. My daughters call one Tribal court judge “auntie,” and this winter a district court judge invited me to her wedding. When I went through my divorce, two separate judges called me almost monthly to check in. Through my research on rural access to justice, I, and my family, have become deeply enmeshed in the lives of others.

AI.tldr: 研究者通过长期参与式田野调查，与农村司法系统人员建立了深厚的人际关系，反思了传统学术研究中"精英距离"问题，强调真实参与和情感连接在研究中的重要性。
